When mixed with gatorade or powerade it's not too overpowering.  You will sweat out A LOT of salt but that's to be expected.  If you have cramping problems due to being a salty sweater this product will work.

A perfect half-time refreshment. The product is amazing, but there are several house hold remedies to treat dehydration (i'll spare you the nutrition lesson, do your research). The difference is these electrolyte packets provide the sodium & potassium you need to revitalize your energy much faster with less 'filler' ingredients, such as what you may get from mustard or alka-selzer. Bananas & sweet potatoes are great sources for potassium, but they're heavy on your belly (especially if you're a soccer player, like myself, or an endurance athlete).**Avoid choosing special delivery options, just go standard. i paid an extra $11 for a 2 day delivery. It took 5+ days--rip-off.**

I bought this electrolyte powder to add to my water bottles for a road race as it was a hot day and I was concerned about cramping.  However, I do not recommend this product and I will be quite honest in that I cannot believe this stuff made it through Gatorade's product testing.  It tasted absolutely disgusting.  The salty flavor was so strong it overpowered the flavored sports drink I also mixed with it.  It actually made me more thirsty and by the end of the race I felt sick to my stomach.  I had trouble forcing myself to drink it but had to as it was all I had for a 62 mile course.  I paid $1.50 for a tiny little packet of salt.  Save yourself some money and just use table salt or try another brand of endurolytes such as Hammer or Camelback - which actually taste good.

column9: Peanut Butter Pretzels - Tasty and Alliterative Too
column10: Who'd've thought (notice the double contraction!) that peanut butter pretzels could taste so good?  Yes, one serving of 9 sandwiches contains 7g of fat (but no trans fats) and 140 calories, though few could possibly stop at just one serving.Despite the dietary red flags, I've got to give these pretzel sandwiches five stars, just because they taste so good.On the positive side the first ingredient is not ordinary wheat flour, but unbleached wheat flour. Less processing with the unbleached. The peanut butter inside the pretzels is just sweet enough and moist enough to be delightful.If one keeps his or her appetite in check, these can be quite the enjoyable and special snack.Warning: This product does contain peanut products and is processed on equipment that makes dairy products.

These snacks are great!  We like them while travelling since they do not make a mess while eating them.  Buying through Amazon turns a great snack into a great value (better than sale $ even with coupons).

These taste pretty good. A nice snack to throw in the lunchbag. Unfortunately the bags only have about a dozen pretzel sandwiches in each one. They are pretty cheap though so the small amount isn't a real problem.

If these make it longer than five minutes in my house, well, then it's a miracle!  They just have a fabulous taste to them, they're light, not salty at all, and just are a great snack, especially for children.  Warning though - it's next to impossible to eat just a couple.  They're very addicting!  Highly recommend!

These are our favorite pretzel sandwiches and very difficult to find locally but the item is listed as 10 oz packages (12 packs) but what we received was 8 oz packages (12 packs). We are missing 24 ounces. It makes the price a little high but they are hard to find. We notifed Amazon about the issue and are waiting for a resolution.
These are very crisp with just the right amount of peanut butter.  Perfect size for a light snack.
YUM!!!  YUM!!!  Snyder's of Hanover pretzels with peanut butter!!!  Get some milk to with these. Highly recommended. Excellent price by the case.
Hard to find locally but keeps well in bulk over time. Great snack, full of flavor. Not too hot.

column9: Chocolate, PB and Pretzels, Oh My!
column10: A friend saw these on a late-night food show, did some investigating and ordered a box.  She and her husband hid some of the bags so they didn't eat them all at once.  Her enthusiasm convinced me to order a box.  Upon arrival, we opened a bag.  Let's just say chocolate, peanut butter and pretzels never tasted so yummy.  I knew we couldn't keep all those bags in the house so I tucked one in several Christmas gifts.  It was the first thing mentioned in the thank you notes!  Some even asked for a "refill."  I'll be ordering again next year.
I love the jalapeno cheese and the taste of the pumpernickel pretzel is wonderful!

great! The pretzels are so buttery soft--they are sandwiched together between a very cheezy creamy filling (tastes a lot like the coating on cheetos, but in a creamy form). My kids absolutely LOVE these as a snack and they don't last very long!!
We love these!!  I am back for a second order.  Great when you are looking for chocolate and salt at the same time!!

What a perfect combination - pretzles and peanut butter.  It is one of the best tasting snacks I have eaten for a long time.  I like the size of the bag also.  Crunchy and salty.  I could not find anything about product that I did not like or want to change.  It is a top notch treat!

Love these. Got the peanut butter variety and they're a great snack in a perfect package size to leave you fulfilled. Also, they are UNSALTED which is even better since they won't clog your arteries with salt. I order them from amazon on subscription every month and they always taste fresh.

We love these!  We get the peanut butter variety.  They taste great and are wonderful for keeping in the car.  My kids know the serving size (which is 9 sandwiches) and also ask for the appropriate amount.  They are a great, healthy, quick snack and they work to keep the toddler quiet to boot!The subscribe and save is by far the best deal I've seen.  And it just shows up at my door when I need more!  Gotta love it!

With subscribe & save as well as free shipping/no tax the price through amazon.com per bag is a great savings compared to Publix. This is a great tasting snack, and has significantly less sodium per serving than any of the other peanut butter/pretzel combinations I could find. My 3 y.o. loves to munch on them, and I use them as a snack or a quick/light breakfast as well.

The Snyder's Cheddar Cheeze Pretzel Sandwiches I oredered through Amazon are wonderful. Very tasty and great as an individual snack or for serving at parties.They are small (about the size of a quarter) and are so easy to seve and eat. I prefer them over "chips and dips". I love them!

stores here in DooDah stopped carrying this product after we got hooked on them. One day I thought "hey check out Amazon" and low and behold TaDah! These are some of the best snack crackers you'll taste. Just enough jalapeno to spice them up. Only bad thing is it is hard to stop throwing handfuls back and the sack is just too small to share!  Try them you will like them!
Little cheese flavor, little pretzel flavor and crunch, greasy texture. Not really a snack, because it doesn't satisfy that urge.

I ordered 1 case (12 bags) of the Pumpernickel and Jalapeno Cheddar sandwiches to give to a friend who who is going through Chemo/radiation, as these are his favorite.  I was amazed that I put the order in yesterday afternoon and they arrived this morning.  That was great!  However, I was disappointed that the expiration date on all of the bags is Feb 13, 2011.  6 weeks from now.  BOO on this from a quality perspective.

As far as a pretzel goes, these have the great taste of snyders pretzels, but as far as "cheddar cheese" goes there is so little in the sandwich, cant even notice it.  The picture on the front of the bag looks like there is a lot of cheese, but the actual pretzels have a minute amount of filling.

These things are great, it would be nice if they had a bit more cheese in them, but they are still really good as it is. Getting them from Amazon ends up being a little cheaper than from my local stores.
These crackers are hard to find in stores in the Dallas area so I'm glad to be able to order them online.

I just LOVE these Jalapeno Cheddar Pumpernickel Pretzel Sandwiches!  I discovered them a few years back, but I haven't seen them in the grocery store for quite a while now.  I was very excited that I found them here.  I always come to Amazon first, when I'm looking for anything that isn't exactly mainstream, because I can almost always find what I want!!  Thanks, Amazon!

These snacks are totally tasty and satifying!  I take them to my beach volleyball tournaments and EVERYONE wants them.  I've started giving them to my friends as birthday gifts....they love them so much.  I have serious trouble finding these in my local stores, so I turned to Amazon to find them and VOILA!!  I bought a case of them to last me a while!  The pumpernickel is a great pretzel flavor and the jalepeno cheddar adds a nice light spicy touch. I eat them like Oreos; I split it open and lick the cheddar in the middle, then eat the pretzel ends!! :) Kinda fun to eat! Trust me when I say they are delicious.  Oh....and don't just buy one bag, you will definitely want more!!!  Enjoy!!
It is a quick snack to take away the hunger and easy to share with everyone.

The product is great.  However, I, too, received 12 - 8 oz. packages instead of12 - 10 oz. packages as advertized.  So, as long as you don't mind getting ripped by 20% ...... keep this in mind when ordering.

column9: Great snack in a small package
column10: The flavor and freshness of these individual packages is perfect for school lunches or a kid's after-school snack. It's only about half of what I consider to be an adult-sized snack, but maybe this is a good thing... Enjoy!

We LOVE these pumpernickel and jalapeno pretzels.  You cannot find them where we live in Indiana so we bought them from Amazon.  The only negative thing we can share is that they are advertized as a 10 ounce bag-the bag is only 8 ounces.

I met these cheese pretzel sandwiches two weeks ago and already 30 of the one oz packages are gone.Of course, my wife loves them too. They are delicious, provide a quick between meal snack. How great it is that Amazon has them at a price close to the big box price.

column9: Amazing, tastes like a jasmine dream
column10: I love jasmine tea in Chinese restaurants.  I bought a box of Coffee Bean Dragonwell tea, and a bag of jasmine tea had found its way into my Dragonwell box by mistake.  I am so glad it did.  It was beautiful to look at and just indescribably perfect to taste.  It made me dump out all of my Dragonwell tea in the hope that another jasmine mistake could be found.  I picked up other-brand jasmine tea boxes in the grocery store and read the fine print...they are not true jasmine teas!  They are jasmine tea "blends"!!  Because Coffee Bean packages their tea in a clear, see-through tea bag, I can tell you for certain that this is 100% jasmine pearls.  Not a blend!  I am hooked.
I love this tea. The taste is full but delicate. Very fragrant. Much cheaper than buying direct from the Coffee Bean site.
I love green jasmine tea, and Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf has the best I have found. I try new brands when I find them, but nothing ever comes close to the wonderful flavor of this tea!

If you love hot chips, this is a great variety pack.  All of the chips in the pack are very good which includes hot cheetos, hot limon cheetos, hot funyuns, hot fries, and hot chip mix (cheetos, doritos, pretzels, spicy sunchips in one bag).  Of course these are not for you if you are on a diet, but if you want to splurge and give yourself a treat, try this variety pack.

For less than 1/2 the price, you can buy hand picked farm direct Kona coffee straight from Hawaii. You can find them on Amazon also.One is Blue Horse Kona Coffee....they grow and pick the beans themselves, they even roast them AFTER you order and ship them priority. You know exactly when your coffee was roasted and where it came from and who picked it....and it'll only cost you $25-$30 for regular Kona, and $30-$40 for premium Peaberry Kona coffee.Why pay over $50 for subpar coffee? I'll buy a cup of Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf coffee when I'm around a cafe, but this here on Amazon is just a bad buy.

My eyesight has been deteriorating with age (67 now) and it has been very difficult to see closeup without reading glasses.  I have glasses for driving but they are a nuisance and always dirty.  One day I read a column by Susie the Pharmacist who was recommending Saffron pills to somebody and I thought they might help me (out of desperation).  My eyesight has improved, especially for reading, and I no longer use glasses while driving.  Really!! Over-all, my mental outlook seems to be better and things don't look as bleak.  It didn't happen overnight but took about 6 months of taking 3 pills daily (with meals).  I don't take anything else except a low-dose aspirin.  I gave up the Saffron recently to save money, and within 2 weeks I was having to squint (again) while reading.  That convinced me to restart the pills and in a few days my good vision and improved outlook had returned.  No, this isn't a joke.  I am now a Saffron user for life!  YEA!!

I drink at least 1 gal. of water a day. I've tried sooo many brands. Some are impossible, many are acceptable but very few are exceptional...Glaceau Smartwater with electrolytes tops the charts! This water is great with meals, during & after exercise, just because you're thirsty or if dieting, it helps fill you up if you drink a bottle 20 minutes or so before eating while helping to keep your electrolytes in balance! This is of great importance. When your electrolytes are "off", it can affect your heart as well as other important medical conditions. This is why scientists came up with Gatorade for pro athletes 25 yrs. or so ago. Look what we've learned since then! Thank you for a superior product!

I tried Smart water as an alternative to the more popular brands alias i did not go wrong.  This is the first trully aftertaste-free water i have ever had.  i beg of you one day this summer try it you'll see for yourself.

It's bottled water.It's got electrolytes.The taste is good and not too expensive.Granted the plastic bottle is horrible for the environment so please recycle.Otherwise...its water, it's good for you...recommended.

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column10: Whenever I have a bottle of Glaceau SmartWater, that's one of the main things people ask me: does this actually work or make a difference? To ultimately tell you'd have to do a batter of tests & such, but for me I'm just judging by the way I feel during & afterwards.Taste-wise, you can't tell that this drink has any electrolytes or anything in it, which is a good thing. Water shouldn't taste like anything other than water (unless you are buying something that is supposed to be flavored). It does taste better than some of the other brands out there such as Dasani, so that's a plus.But does it work? I can't give you a scientific show of proof, but I can tell you that I feel better when I drink it. It just seems to give me energy, something that is a plus when you work 2 jobs & go to college at the same time. I feel more hydrated for a longer period of time.This is something nice that I get on occasion when I need a little boost. It's not going to replace my tapwater at home (I need the fluoridated water), but it is something that I'll buy to take to work.

The price is fair considering the process in which this water is made. A friend recommended this product and I loved it. Its odd to say this but it almost felt like the water was sweet in a non taste way because of its purity. I think because many other brands of water I've tried are too mineral-y tasting that this smart water came to a pleasant surprise. Do buy!

This water tastes good and in theory should absorb faster. It's a fact that you can die from drinking too much water without electrolytes, due to (reverse?) osmosis. Hopefully this water counters that.As for one reviewer's claim that the electrolytes gives them energy, that is false since the drink has zero calories (just read the label). However, maybe being properly hydrated allows one to properly digest or use other sources of energy.I am not a biologist, just my two cents.

column9: I don't even LIKE water.. but I LOVE smartwater!!
column10: I'm one of those tea/coke/wine/milk/beer type people... basically, I just really don't like drinking water. It's more of a chore than anything, and 8-glasses?! who do they think they're kidding? but smartwater... it goes down easily and tastes good afterwards... crisp, cool even (how can something taste cool? i don't know.. just try it.. b/c it does!)That said, i may turn out to be one of those water-drinking people, after all.

This is by far the best water I have ever tasted. Not only that, it gives me the energy and wellness feeling I need to get through the day. After only 3 days of drinking 2 bottles of 24 oz. smart water, it cleared up a possible sinus infection, and I had more energy. BUT!!!!! DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT ONLINE! You can find 1 liter bottles at Kroger for a 1.59 a piece. If you have a Kroger card, only a buck! They are now selling 10 for 10 dollars of the 1 liter smart water bottles. I just bought 20!!! Haha, but if you buy this water, seriously, don't waste your money on these ridiculously overpriced sellers. Buy it at a local store.
This is so good and has spoiled me so badly that I am barely able to drink water if it isn't Smart Water.

column9: Waste of Money, Waste of Resources
column10: I tried this product out of curiosity since it was new.  It tastes like all the others but with a much higher price tag.  I am now at the point where I think bottled water is such a waste of money and natural resources - clogging landfills with all the bottles that no one recycles - that I am going to buy a water filter for my sink and just use that.  You can also buy packets of electrolytes from companies like Emergen-C and add them to your water.  I used those when I ran a marathon and they worked wonders!  Save a buck and save the environment...use filtered water in a bottle you can reuse.

column9: Stop shopping in your supermarket for this item!
column10: Lipton Lipton Diet Iced Tea Mix, Decaffeinated Lemon, 3-Ounce (Pack of 4)I have bought this product in supermarkets and discount stores for many years, but notice than it is getting increasingly difficult to find it either because many stores have discontinued the product or have failed to restock it.Now Amazon has made it easy for me and I am extremely pleased to be able to order 4 jars at a time at a reasonable price which saves me time and effort in making the rounds of food stores only find that it's no longer carried.
This item USED to be a good buy on Amazon, now they have made the price to high.  Will try to find another place to buy.

I have been buying this product for many years and now I see where Amazon has decreased their quantity from a 6-pack toa 4-pack and leaving the price about the same. This is a 50% increase in cost since the last time I bought them. I calledUnilever who makes this product and they told me they have not had a price increase recently. I can not afford to pay thismuch for my tea anymore.

column9: Same as the store, better prices!
column10: I love Lipton's Diet Iced Tea.  Problem is my store does not seem to ever have it in stock!!This fit my needs entirely.

We have been using this product for years.  Having a decafinated diet cold beverage in So. FL is a neccesity.  We can't always get it at the local markets so we get it by the case on Amazon. We only wish we could find the larger size bottles.

column9: If you like "diet" iced tea but don't want caffeine, buy this now
column10: Even major supermarkets don't regularly sell artificially-sweetened decaffeinated iced tea, and they almost never have it "out of season", i.e., when it isn't summertime.  Unfortunately, Amazon doesn't even always have it, so if you are an iced tea drinker who wants your iced tea throughout the day and into the evening, buy this when it is available.

If you like instant iced tea, but want decaf, this is it.  Hard to find where I live, so Amazon was the answer.  This tea has a great lemon flavor and just the right amount of sweetness.  Without the aftertaste some sweetners have.  Will order this again.

My doctor said I couldn't have caffeine so I started drinking this Ice tea and I love it.  I make myself a huge container of it before I go to work so I have something to drink all day.  I highly recommend this product if you have to stay away from caffeine.
We enjoy this wonderful tea - lemon, diet,decaffinated,instant and always fresh.  We order several at a time because it is sealed and keeps it strength without a worry.

column9: Grew fine, but cats not interested
column10: I followed the instructions on the back of the bag and these grew just fine. It took nearly a week for them to start poking through the soil, but they have grown up well and are a very attractive shade of green and are healthy.I grew the seeds in a shallow pot for my two cats, but neither of the cats has shown much interest yet. I also grow wheatgrass, and there's a flat of that going right now. The cats seem slightly more interested in the wheatgrass than the cat grass. I have made some attempts to show the cats the cat grass and get them interested, but so far they're not impressed.

My cat enjoyed this grass very much. She's an indoor/patio only cat, and she seemed to really like the new stimulation. I also potted some to take over for my parent's cats. One of my folk's cats was constantly trying to get into my mother's house plants, and this ended up being a much better alternative for both the cat and my mom. One of my parent's cats stays indoors all the time, while the other makes frequent trips outdoors, and they both seemed to equally enjoy the sweet grass treat.After seeding the pots, and setting them on a window sill (winter in Michigan)there were two days of nothing (as expected). On the third day I gave the pot a little light watering and when I came home that night there were sprouts a 1/2 inch high. After that they took off and grew to a height of about 5-7 inches in two days. I was a bit surprised at just how fast they ended up growing! I would recommend only seeding a little amount of it though. I seeded about a tablespoon and a half in 4 inch diameter pots, and it ended up being too much even for my folk's two cats to get through in almost two weeks (which is when the grass started to get weepy and die off). All of the cats nibbled on the grass every day, but it's not like grass is a major part of their diet, and it was just too much. I think I'll cut the amount of seeds roughly in half next time. I should also mention that the grass was really low maintaince, needing barely any watering after the initial growth (and even then I only gave a couple very light waterings). I'd buy it again, although I'm sure I won't have to for a very long time given how well it grows, how little is needed, and the amount that comes in the bag!

This item is 10 times better then the cat grass you get at Pet-Smart or any other pet store. Grows well & lasts 3x or 4x longer then the very small cat grass those stores sell. Alao the price is about 300x less then the store bought grass......

My first purchase of this brand of oat grass was from a local pet goods store. The seeds were easy to grow in the little cup and soil that came with the kit.  When I saw the seeds offered on AMAZON, I decided to buy the seeds without the container and soil. What a pleasant surprise. There are at least 5 times as many seeds for less money than the kit I purchased locally. My indoor cat loves this tasty treat.
The seeds sprouted in a couple days, and my kitty devoured it in a week.  A great value.  A must have for any indoor kitty!
I didn't realize there were different types of cat grass.  Grows well, but my cat who loves Burpee brand of cat grass doesn't really like this product.

These seeds have a nice, high sprout rate. My cats didn't take to it, but they're finicky. I'm not sure if I agree with the value of this product based on the price, but the seeds were of high quality.

I emptied out an old jar, filled it with questionable quality soil (left over from a basil plant i killed) and popped in a spoonful of seeds. Within a few hours I saw some white fuzzy roots start growing on those seeds that were upside down. The next day I had sprouts just above the soil. Day 3 there were grass shoots just to the top of the jar...and on a whim i popped the jar outside for a day while i was at work - there is nowhere in my house i could have left this inside in the sun without my cat finding it (and she was already curious). When I came home, the jar height sprouts had flourished about 4-5 inches above the jar! Simply, easy and the cat is munching on this happily in front of her favorite sunning spot. The only problem (not worth downrating) is that it grew so dense...some of the stalks poke her in the face when she's trying gnaw on stuff in the middle...but it hasn't really stopped her. Great product, simple product!
Used most of the pack and about three sprouts came up.  I have been planting for years and I have a green thumb but I could not get this product to work.

this product performed well as far as growing fast; within a week. the product with a lush grass that died soon after it reached peak height. I had even tried to cut it, which was an attempt to curve the final flowering stage of the grass, yet this did not work and only lengthened it by a week.

My picky cat loves the grass!! I put them next to a south facing window in the apartment and they have been growing well, even during the winter. The grains that do grow are pretty hearty. Just don't expect more than 60% of the seed to grow.Also, The cat loves them so much he jumped up on the window sill to get to them and knocked the pot to the floor in order to get to them better. So if you cat is very inquisitive I suggest placing them in a location that is hard to reach. I found out the hard way.
Everything was just great, the product arrived right on time, was just what we ordered and they are terrific, thanks.

i surly bought it for the sake of a good sprayer but this is a spitter when you press it slow... it spit a strong shot of oil just like a water gun. but when u press it fast and hard it spread little bit good. the best thing in it that it is a glass.i give oil - 1-5spitter  2-5glass 4-5

This coffee has an extremely rich taste without the bitterness that some darker roasts exhibit. Beans have a nice color and sheen from the roasting process. On a side note, due to the oily nature of these beans, my burr grinder requires a little more attention for cleanup to keep the beans flowing.Great coffee.
This coffee was superb! It was very flavorful without being overly intense. The beans were perfectly roasted and oily, etc. Highly recommend. Not much more to say than that!
This is a terrific price for excellent coffee. Delivery took a little longer than we'd hoped (we did use Super Saver, however) but the beans seem to be fine.

This company goes on and on about how fresh their beans are. Well, the beans I received certainly were not. On the exterior of the package is a five-digit label that shows the Julian date and year the coffee was roasted. My label read 17811 - meaning the 178th day of the year 2011. This translates to June 27th, 2011. I received my coffee on August 30th, 2011 - more than two months after it had been roasted. The bag is sealed with a sticky label saying "Fresh Roasted". Right - it was fresh when it was roasted, TWO MONTHS AGO. Do your own homework and Google the subject of fresh roasted coffee beans. You will often find information stating that roasted coffee loses much of it's flavor after seven days. Is Coffee Bean Direct dumping its stale inventory on Amazon?
THIS IS A VERY GOOD COFFEE AT A VERY GOOD PRICE. I SENT IT AS A GIFT AS I HAVE TO USE DECAFE NOW. GREAT FLAVOR.
Not much more you can say besides this is a great tea. It has a nice fruity apricot flavor and is very smooth.

Iced tea is a favorite of mine so I splurged a little and bought this. It has a wonderful flavor and I use an iced tea maker to make apricot iced tea almost every day.  I prefer to use half flavored tea bags and half regular tea bags so the apricot flavor isn't super strong.

column9: Great crunch and not too oily
column10: It seems that  a little oil is necessary to get the flavor correct in shoestring potatoes.  Cracklesnax gets the combination just right every time.  These are especially good with a bit of ketchup!

I was given a genuine jasmine flower tea and loved it, so was looking to buy some.  Thought I found it based on this picture and description.  However, this is not a flower.  It is tea and some pedals, stitched together with thread... not a genuine blooming flower.
This was given as a gift. My sister had never tried Blooming Tea and love it.

My dogs love these little bones. Every morning my Yorkie comes to me and barks for his mini bone.  The one complaint I have about them is that they are really mini small and the dogs can chew through them too fast. They chew up the middle and leave the ends so little I am afraid they will choke on them. I have ordered the "small" size to see if they last any longer.  I  bought the medium size and they are way too big for little dogs.

When they say "mini" they really mean it!! I can hold bones from one package (priced at almost $9)in my right hand. Even with the free shipping, I could have bought 2-4x this quantity at Walmart for the same price.
Our dogs love their chewies!  These were a little smaller than others of this type, but overall a good value and well-liked.

column9: love these, but what's with the rippoff price?
column10: I buy these at my local Indian grocer for  under $2. The are just the right balance of spicy, sweet and savory and I destest potato chips. I wanted to order some for my daughter at college.  This price is CRAZY!
tastes awesome! if you like it...BUT, you can get it in most local indian grocery stores for fraction of the price here!...if you are near a big enough indian store...it will cost less than a dollar!

I ordered these from Frito Lay India, they were stale. They also didnt taste that great otherwise. If your a fan of Indian food as I am, you may like these, but I guess I just expected more. My Indian buddy also broke the news to me that you can get these at certain Indian stores anyway, and ordering them online isnt necessary.

column9: Good deal, but not much flavor
column10: This tea doesn't really taste like much of anything. Maybe a teeny hint of spearmint but otherwise, I don't taste the lemon flavors.  Even tried leaving it in for 10 minutes and still nothing. Next time, I'll try the orange spice spearmint version.

column9: At least it's available, BUT WAY too COSTLY - please lower the price!
column10: Our family LOVES this cereal. I used to buy it regularly at the local Safeway. Unfortunately, as with the experience of many others, the local grocery store no longer carries it.When buying it at Safeway, I could find it quite often "on sale" for $2 per box - and that box was larger than the paltry 14-ouncers Amazon is peddling here (can't recall, but I believe it was an 18 oz size)A LITTLE ARITHMETIC:1.  If I was buying 18 oz for $2, the price was 11 cents an ounce (even if the boxes were 14 oz, the price still would have been 14.3 cents per oz).2.  Amazon is selling us 6 14 oz boxes (84 oz) for $25.14 (and telling us it is "discounted" from $28.89!). This amounts to 30 cents an ounce. You can get it down to 25.4 cents an ounce IF you agree to regular interval deliveries - something I'd be GLAD to do for the RIGHT PRICE!NOTE: At 30 cents an ounce, we are paying $4.80 per pound - I can buy several punds of chicken, hamburger, or even a pretty good steak for that per-pound price.CONCLUSION:  this great product seems to have disappeared from the local store shelves and, in order to get it, we now have to pay 2 to 3 times as much making grape nut flakes more costly than many meats. I suspect that this is very profitable and I'd rather be a seller than a buyer!!If anyone know of better pricing options, please post them!Also, POST and AMAZON, if you are listening, PLEASE see if you couldn't provide this absolutely great product at a little better price. Many thanks for reading.

I always liked Grape-Nuts Flakes better than Grape-Nuts.  The regular Grape-Nuts are too much like chewing gravel to me. The flakes have a great nutty flavor. column9: I love Grape Nuts Flakes cereal!!
column10: It is downright criminal that Post Cereals went and discontinued a perfectly good cereal!!! I mean I love it,but doesn't make sense to charge a fortune to buy it online. Oh well!!

This cereal is perfect.  Just a tiny bit sweet, made mostly of whole grains, and the flakes are light-thin-crispy.  The flakes do dissolve quickly which is why they are great for using in recipes.  I stir a cup of them in with one can of Farmer's Market Foods Organic Canned Pumpkin, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12), add some ginger and cinnamon, and set it, covered, in the 'fridge for a thick cold healthy snack.  In the cooler months I bake the concoction.  From random in-store label comparisons I have concluded that Post uses better quality ingredients than the other big name cold cereal companies.  I was shocked at the pricing here at Amazon though.  My small grocery store, where generally the prices are rather high, charges less than four dollars for one fourteen ounce box.  So paying nearly ten dollars per box, which is what Amazon is currently charging, is pretty outrageous.  Boxes of the original Grapenuts can be had for a fraction of what the flakes are going for.  I'm glad I came here to read the reviews because it looks like possibly Grapenuts Flakes are becoming less available in stores.  I plan to stock up now while I can.
An old favorite that's become hard to find.  I like the flavor, the consistency, the adequate amount of fiber and protein without a lot of added sugar.
i have one opened box left going to order more in the future.i'm glad they still make it

grape-nuts flakes have always been one of my favorite cereals.  I love the taste and I guess I'm weired because I like my flakes soggy, always have. I ordered some for me and some for my daughter, who also loves them.  The give me everything I am looking for in a cereal and I would reccommend them to anyone looking for a change instead of the same old, same old.

column9: My favorite cereal of all time
column10: Only one thing to say about Grape-Nuts Flakes ... Yum! This is my all-time favorite cereal. Just sweet enough, not too sweet. Crispy flakes. Much better than those sweeter Honey Bunches. Sadly, my local supermarket stopped carrying this. Thanks Amazon!
Grapenuts Flakes is not longer available in stores, as far as I know. This was a life saver as it's a favorite of my husband and so easy to obtain...fresh and in perfect condition. Thank you!

Post Grape Nuts Flakes are a great-tasting "adult" (not sugar-coated) cereal. The flakes are small-ish and tender, not like the huge, hard, milk-proof fodder that cereals like Wheaties and Bran Flakes have become, nor is the whole-grain flavor masked by sprayed-on vitamins. Adding some Sunmaid Zante Currants creates a light, sophisticated "raisin bran,"  and dried cranberries (such as Ocean Spray "Craisins") will tantalize your taste buds, too.  Mixing the Grape Nuts Flakes with Wheat Chex or Rice Chex adds even more variety.  I was glad to find that Grape Nuts Flakes were available at Amazon.com, as they are no longer available where I live.  I wish Amazon would stock the larger 18 oz. boxes as well.

I don't care for regular Grape Nuts but I can eat Grape Nuts FLAKES for breakfast every single day & never get sick of it! Though I wasn't expecting a lot from a soft toy, I was hoping that this would be able to provide a little more relief for my teething pup.  While the bone is easy to use and freeze, the actual 'enjoyment' time is limited and not worth the time it takes to refreeze.  After about 5 minutes, the bone was thawed to the point it was dripping and could easily have holes chewed in the fabric.  When I went to refreeze it, my poor pup didn't understand why I was taking her toy and ended up becoming disinterested very quickly the next time I brought it out.Another issue I hadn't thought about until after freezing is how hard and heavy the bone becomes.  If you have a puppy that likes to 'throw' their toys or pounce on them, this can become a flying projectile.Though it did seem to help with the soreness of teething, and provide a cool treat, the overall experience left a lot to be desired.

My puppy loved this product...for about 3 minutes.  Thats how long it lasted before he had chewed a hole in it and pulled out the stuffing, rendering it useless.  Way over priced for the quality.  I wish I had come here and read reviews first, a $2 walmart towel soaked in water and frozen has been a way more durable option, which my puppy loves.

This is a good but unremarkable toy for the very light chewer in your life.  It's basically just a fabric bone that you soak in water.  The bag you're supposed to store it in broke when we tried to take the bone out after freezing it. It doesn't have any vanilla smell as they claim.  And after the first use our moderate, non-teething dog had ripped out most of the stuffing, rendering it useless.The idea of a frozen toy is a good one, but freezing some knotted up towels would be just as effective. Don't waste your money.

We bought one of these when our corgi Faye was teething. She was chewing on everything, the couch, dvd boxes, the windowsills! She took to the Chilly Bone immediately. You could tell by watching her how much it soothed her poor gums. We actually bought two, and kept one in the freezer at all times.  She is now three, and we still will pull one out occasionally, when she is bored.

column9: Destroyed in 5 mintues by a 4-month old puppy
column10: Don't waste your money on the Chilly Bone.  I thought it would help my 4 month old welsh corgi with teething.  He liked it, but chewed a hole in it within 5 minutes.  I would have been better off soaking a clean wash cloth and freezing it to let him chew on.

This sounded like a great idea for a teething dog, but it didn't work for either of mine. As another reviewer said, it's basically a fabric toy that you soak in water and freeze - but the plastic bag ripped after being frozen, it thawed quickly leaving a wet mess, and most significantly, neither of my dogs were the slightest bit interested in it. I too would freeze an old wet sock instead.
Awesome for teething. My puppies love them and it helps relieve their pain. also good for cooling down after strenuous activity Great product!

I have a German shepherd mix that isn't a heavy chewer but he's going through a faze of chewing so instead of losing my clothes to his teeth I got this. I got it locally but when I read the reviews on here I thought I would write my own. The fact is I love this I can freeze it over night and it will last for an hour or two or him just chewing on it, or I can freeze it for an hour or two and it will last about 15-20 minutes. It all depends on if I'm home or not. The point of this story is that I like this toy because he has stopped chewing on my clothes and started chewing on this and his kongs. (Which he wasnt before). I would definitely recommend this product to anyone who has a dog going through a chewing faze.

I wish I had read the reviews before I purchased.  Pup chews on it a few minutes andthen it starts to thaw and you have a wet spot on carpet or in my case a puddlein the middle of your couch or wood floor.  Not worth time or money.

My puppy really loves this toy. I'm surprised to see all the negative reviews.I'd call him a heavy chewer, but he has not ripped the bone apart, and we've had it for a few weeks. He's little though (4 months old, 5.5 lbs) so maybe that's why.It's true that the bone doesn't stay frozen for very long. He likes it even after it's begun to thaw, though. He likes it when it's frozen, and he likes it when it's not frozen but cold and wet.Also, to the person who complained that the plastic bag broke: it's just a Ziploc bag. They're not supposed to last forever, and you can easily get another one.Many of the reviewers on here suggested using a frozen washcloth instead. I'm hesitant to do that because I don't want him to learn that it's ok to chew on towels.Bottom line: my puppy loves this toy, so I do too.

I bought this bone at Petco to help my pup keep cool on hot days. Not only did she chew a hole in it in the first few minutes, but it thaws out very fast and is just a soggy dog toy. Because it doesn't stay frozen long in 80 degree weather, it is easier to chew and tear holes in. I am just glad I bought it at half price and didn't waste a ton of money on it.If you are looking for something cool for your pup you are better off giving it an Ice Cube

column9: Good product as long as it's frozen!
column10: I got this for my dog during the heat of summer since she loves eating ice so much! She likes this toy, although she gets bored with it very easily (I guess it's the crunch factor of ice she's missing) so it normally sits on the floor until it melts. Word to the wise, don't let your dog have this toy once it's thawed out - at least not if they're an extreme chewer like my dog. She put a hole in one of the corners within a few minutes since it's just canvas and stuffing. Probably my fault, but at least I was able to sew it up and she doesn't mess with the patched corner when it's frozen. I've learned my lesson to pick it up if she stops playing with it to avoid her destroying it completely. Overall, she seems to like it and it freezes pretty quickly!

column9: A popular product from a major movie
column10: Although these delicious delicacies can stand on their own merit, they have a know reputation.  Everyone remembers the red stapler from "Offices Space" (1999). But only a connoisseur would associate gummy bears with "Ferris Bueller's Day Off" (1986). You can just suck on them in that case.

for the money i spent on them i got exactly what i should have, i believe i spent about 27 dollars on them, they are put together cheaply, i used two of them to pick up truffels and they promptly broke.

column9: Tremendous price but weak lapsang souchong
column10: I couldn't believe the price on this tea, especially for lapsang souchong, my favorite black tea.  I read the other reviews on it and decided to give it a try.  My mistake; I now have a "ton" of tea (2 lbs) that, to my taste, has almost none of the l.s. smokey character.  If you want the distinctive smokey, almost peat-like flavor of l.s., don't bother with this one.  With some sugar, it was slightly reminiscent of l.s. (the only reason for my 2-stars instead of 1), so I guess I haven't totally wasted my money.  Honestly, I'm not even sure someone who only wants to sample the lightest l.s. flavor would feel rewarded with this brand (Coffee Bean Direct).  I won't buy it again, needless to say.

Like many others, I couldn't believe the price of this tea given that lapsang souchong are usually fairly expensive. I can't say that it's the best souchong I've ever tasted but it wouldn't be fair to compare it to tea from a local gourmet tea shop selling LS 4-5$/oz, just like it's not fair to compare a Mercedes-Benz C330 to a Toyota Corolla. It is a great everyday tea.That being said, I'm not sure if it's a genuine LS tea since it almost taste like artificial smoke flavor was added to regular tea as opposed to drying tea over burning pine logs. The smokiness is subtle but strong enough to my liking. The aroma is also pleasant. And when you try a second brew, the smokiness really fades and the result is a standard black tea with a hint of smoke.

When I saw the price of all this tea I thought it was worth a chance purchasing it but that it probably wouldn't be very good.  I am happy to report that it's pretty flavorful - not as smoky as some Lapsang Souchong, but very good tea and a great bargain.  I'd definitely buy it again.

This is a great value lapsang souchong tea. It has a good smoky flavor and aroma - not too strong but not too weak. I was a bit skeptical about the cheaper price, but I must say it was more than worth it. I drink it daily and will purchase it again when my bag is gone.
Good value, reasonable quality.  I will buy it again.  Not as strong a smoke flavor as I prefer but it will probably have a wider appeal for others who are not as keen on this tea variety.
This is very low quality tea. Barely even tastes like lapsang  souchong . I would recommend staying away from this product. Wonder if their coffee is as bad.

When I buy tea I don't expect to pay for all the extra little twigs, stems and sticks that my shipment contained. I guess this is a neat way to add bulk to a product that is being sold by weight. Perhaps my experience was just an anomaly so I'm prepared to give them a second chance.

I bought the lapsang souchong & the sechung oolong tea from COFFEE BEAN DIRECT and was absolutely thrilled with them both. Great value. super fast shopping. But above that the tea is excellent. The oolong is delicate and beautiful. the lapsang is strong and vibrant. I'm looking forward to ordering more just as soon as i get more room. 2 pounds of tea is a lot. As to the nay sayers who did not like this company's tea I say "rubbish" this tea is fantastic. ESPECIALLY at the price. What world do you live in that you can gourmet tea for around a dollar an ounce? These are perfect workaday teas. I do not not want  a tea that the price makes me wince when  I make a cuppa. So in summation brilliant teas from one of my new favorite tea houses.

Turns out it's a combination of this black tea and Yerba Mate. If you're inclined to mix up your own for that delicious smokey flavor, this is the tea for you.Thanks to the seller for the great service!

Make it as strong as you like. A wee drop of honey and a fresh hot scone.A great combination. The smokey flavor reminds many of the Scottish Highlands.A wonderful smokey taste reminiscent of Laphroig or Lagavulin.

At a time when 1/4 lb of this type of tea from some "gourmet" shops will cost you just about as much as this 2 lb bag, this is a real bargain. It's not the most flavorful smoked tea I've ever had, but it's way more than acceptable. I'm now on my second 2 lb bag. Good stuff!

I love this flavor of tea. I am only buying the Lapsang Souchong, all the time.  Nothing else will do.  When you have it with pleanty of honey, and a crisp bread and provolone with butter sandwich to dip in it... (use the Siljans crisp bread) <<< MMMMMMMMMM  The only thing I noticed is I had to use twice as much as what my other teas required.  Once my husband figured that out it was great.

column9: Decent alternative to Billy Tea - when you live in middle of nowhere
column10: On a recent trip to Australia, my husband discovered Billy Tea with its lovely smokey flavor.  Unfortunately we live in the middle of nowhere & to get this tea loose-leaf you either have to drive 4 hours, or pay and arm & a leg for shipping.We decided to give this tea a try after googling "smokey flavored tea".  With subscribe & save and an additional $10 redemption code, we scored 2 pounds for $7 delivered.  Not too shabby for a shot in the dark.We brew this in our Keurig, and it has a nice flavor - but is on the weak side.  This could be due to the brewing in the Keurig vs. a teapot.  The smoke flavor is nice - noticable, but not too strong.  For the price - this was right.  But the quality has inspired us to try out different brands (higher quality) of Lapsang Souchong even if at a higher price.I would recommend this tea at the price of $17/2 pounds as a good value if you want to try out the Lapsang Souchang style of tea.
These macaroons are the best! I don't think I could pick a favorite flavor because all of them are delicious!!! Definitely worth it and super delicious.

one of the 3 bottles was broken when i received the package. the bubble wrap was not sufficient to keep the bottles from hitting each other during shipping. one of the glass bottles was broken on the side and there was syrup all over the inside of the bubble wrap. the syrup in the remaining bottles is very tasty. too expensive to pay for only 2/3 of my order.

I love chocolate Necco Wafers.  I liked the four-chocolate flavored variety more but can't find them anymore.  But these are delicious. column9: Fun to make, but too dry
column10: When I saw this product at one of my favorite kitchen stores, I just had to try it out, especially since I love this coffee cake and the Barefoot Contessa show.  I figured it would be a great mix.  I was very disappointed after baking the product that the cake itself was very dry and the crust was very hard.  The flavor was there, but might need to add pudding to the mix or something else to add moisture to it.  For the price of $14.95 that I had paid, it's probably worth it to just buy one already made from a local bakery.  Definitely not worth the price paid.  Sorry, Ina!

This is my sister's favorite type of cake. As teenagers we would make the Betty Crocker cinnamon swirl cake, which looked just like this one, and she was hoping for something similar.  After she tried to make this mix a couple times without success, she asked me to try.  I will say the overall flavor of this cake is really good, BUT it's very dense.  The crust is thick and hard for a cake and the crumb is very dry.  I tried using Plugra high fat butter, then substituting some of the butter with oil, and I even tried switching pans. I just could not get a moist cake from this mix.

We have bought this mix and enjoyed it several times...it's one of our favorites.  Delicious with coffee or tea in the morning, this is a great mix.  When we first started making it, we had an old inexpensive bundt pan; and, like the other reviewers, we thought the coffeecake was tasty, but a little dry.  After making it in a new higher quality bundt pan that we received for Christmas, the outcome improved 100%.  I guess it's true what they say about having the right "tool" for the job.  I have also noticed that I get a better result when I reduce the cooking time slightly on all of the Barefoot Contessa mixes.  We'll keep buying this as long as they offer it.
Sorry, never got a chance to use it.  When opened, was buggy, so tossed it.  Advise to store in fridge when you get it to avoid this.  Looks yummy.

column9: Americans have got to try this!
column10: Milo is like Hershey's powder, except it stays crunchy on top! So you mix it with cold milk, you let the crunchy part soak in the milk for a minute, then eat the crunchy part with a spoon, then drink the chocolate milk!  I tried it in Australia 30 years ago and can't believe it has never been introduced in the U.S.!!
By far, the best sparkling water I've ever had (and I've tried them all!). Very carbonated, flavored just right. PERFECT!

Later when it was cold I tried it and it was very refreshing. Just the right amount of bubbles and lemon lime flavor. This is a healthy alternative to soda. I look forward to trying TalkingRain's other flavors of sparkling water.
Perfect.  Just a touch of lime/lemon taste - all that is needed.  The "sparkle" is also just right.  Goes down easily and is more enjoyable than basic water.

If you want the opinion of someone who makes several pounds of jerky a week I'd suggest going with the Nesco brand of seasoning. They're messier because you have to make a marinade with them, but the flavor is fantastic, and in my opinion, unbeatable.

I have been making beef jerky for 20 years, and in that time I have tried every brand of jerky cure, and this is by far the best. This is better than the other brands, and is better than the other Hi Mountain flavors. You will get perfect jerky every time with this cure. It has the traditional salty, peppery flavor, without a lot of extra (in my mind unwanted) flavors.There are some secrets to getting perfect beef jerky with this seasoning.Tips:1) Use lean meat. Fat does not cure, and if you have fat in our jerky, the jerky goes rancid pretty quickly. I have found a London Broil is the best cut to start with. Trim the fat off the outside.2) The meat needs to be cut into uniform slices. Go ahead, bite the bullet, and buy a nice meat slicer. You will be glad you did. By having each slice the same thickness, they will dry uniformly, and be ready at about the same time. You will have to experiment a little to get the perfect thickness, but with a meat slicer, they will all be uniform.3) Almost freeze the meat before slicing. If the meet is almost frozen, it slices precisely, and does not tear.4) The biggest mistake I see beginners make is to over-dry the jerky. It should not be shoe leather. If you bend a piece in half it should not break. At the same time, there should not be even a hint of moisture on the finished product. Know that a batch of jerky can go from under-dry to over-dry very quickly, so watch your batch pretty closely. Also know you must go by look and feel, not time. Some days it takes longer some days shorter. You are looking for that dry to the touch but not dried out point of jerky perfection.5) The key element to good jerky is smoke. If you use a smoker, make sure you keep the temperature cool. You are trying to DRY the meat, not COOK the meat. You can give the meat a good smoking in a cold smoker, and then move it to a dehydrator to finish drying. Sometimes my smoker has a tendency to heat up, so I often give the batch 30 minutes in the smoker and then move to the dehydrator. Also, the best wood to make jerky over is hickory, which you can get at walmart.

column9: A welcome addition to my kitchen
column10: If you watch Emeril Lagasse's Food Channel show, you know that he routinely uses what he calls "Essence." I use it on everything but ice cream."The bottle itself does not list all the ingredients.  However, if you check out "Emeril's Delmonico," you get the full recipe.  The nice thing here is that it is very easy to make; most amateur cooks have most or all of the ingredients right at hand (for instance, I do have them all, so I could make my own and save some money over Emeril's bottled version!).When he says "kick it up" or "bam," Essence can help out. The cayenne pepper component will kick things up.  However, the combination of ingredients balance one another nicely, and this ends up being a useful product in the kitchen (at least for me).  I don't overdo amounts, but used moderately, this adds a nice taste to food.Anyhow, this is a nice addition to my kitchen.

Emeril's Original Essence is a combination of salt, paprika, pepper, granulated garlic, spices and onion powder. This mixture is perfect for chicken, fish, meats and even veggies. You can use it to enhance the flavor of anything savory and as Emeril says: "I use it on everything but ice cream."I can truly see why he does because this is especially convenient for anyone who loves using garlic and paprika. It also saves you lots of time not having to reach for the salt and pepper. You can skip lots of steps like crushing garlic cloves, although you may want to add even more garlic flavor with fresh garlic.Lately I've been using this essence along with parsley flakes, basil and a mixture from Dean & Deluca called: Herbes de Provence. I sprinkle this over steaks when I fry them in olive oil and then finish the dish with a tablespoon of butter and a ¼ cup Cabernet Sauvignon to make a delicious sauce. Adding in a little fresh or dried basil is optional, but delicious.Emeril's Original Essence frees up some of your time in the kitchen, which allows for more creativity and uniqueness in your cooking. Sprinkle a little of this essence on all your savory dishes and see what happens. The new depth of flavors will amaze you and tantalize your taste buds!~The Rebecca Review

column9: Keep it in the freezer, not the 'fridge
column10: I make bread in the bread machine all the time, and the individual packets are very expensive.  So first I tried buying in big bulk, all in one big packet - Fleishmann's - but found that the yeast didn't last more than a few months, so had to throw most of it out.  So then I tried a compromise, buying these jars. It says either refrigerate or freeze...I thought the 'fridge would be OK, but was very disappointed by how short a time the yeast lasted when stored that way - I had to throw out more than half a jar.  I know I'm not giving precise times/dates - sorry, I'll keep a record next time.  But I have found keeping a jar in the freezer, it has been OK down to the last small amount I still have in there...so I'll probably give it a second chance, just make sure to freeze it (in its jar, no need to decant it).

When I opened my last jar, I sent for replacements since the jars are glass and I was afraid of dropping it and  having none in the pantry.  The yeast in the jars is good for only 4 months after opening so I take a sharpie and write on the label the date I opened it and the date in 4 months; I throw out any that is left past that date.  I keep the yeast stored in my freezer on the door rack.  It's stays in separate granules and is just as easy to measure as it would be in any other less favorable location.  I was very pleased that the yeast I received has a long expiration date so I can be sure that it will stay fresh long enough that I can use all 3 jars.  The yeast came promptly during a very hot spell and the jars were toasty warm, but I'm sure the yeast is just fine.  However, next time I will try to order during cooler weather, just for my peace of mind.
