I was expecting these to be gum, my mistake. But I still like candy. I tried one, and they tasted horrible!
I strongly recommend Amazon.com to order any type of product. I trust them fully with any purchase order, and was very pleased with mine!
We all love this candy although it is addictive. Once you have some you want more.

Not what I expected. First of all, high shipping cost, about 5.45$ for shipping and handling. THESE ARE NOT BUBBLE GUM CIGARRETTES!!!! These are little sticks of sugar!!! Do not be decieved. You cannot blow sugar out of the end like the bubble gum ones.

I WAS EXPECTING A GREAT COLOMBIAN COFFEE BUT THIS ONE DOES NOT HAVE AOMA AND FLAVOR FOR ITS PRICE. I ALWAY BUY COFFEE WITH ARABIC BEANS THEY ARE THE BEST FOR MY TASTE. THIS ONE DID NOT CLASSIFIED TOP NOOTCH.

While working in South America I came to enjoy Colombian coffees over any others I drank. Juan Valdez Coffees represent some of the best of thst Colombia has to offer. It is competitively priced with Colombian coffees you can purchase in the United States but has better aroma and taste.

I love Wheat Nuts but they're getting harder and harder to find locally!!  I would suggest buying them directly from AnaCon's web site, however.  They are $15 plus $7.95 shipping for a 6 pack of 7 oz jars, as opposed to $26.99 and $10 shipping here.

I start eating these things; I can't stop. They have a unique taste and a hard-to-describe but pleasant (kind of "squeaky") texture. Just the right amount of salty-ness.Second the other suggestions that they're cheaper purchased via AnaCon Foods website. [Amazon: Can't you strike some kind of volume deal with them, so we can buy them here with Prime and/or Subscribe and Save.]Warning: although they're touted as low fat, they're not low calorie.
I looove wheat nuts!  And wheat nuts are so healthy! They are not marketed in this area so I was really glad to get them from my amazon source!
What a great find! Although, now I can't find them in the grocery .. Anacon is an alternative to the price found here.  Try these in a trail mix, they're fantastic!

I've loved these things for decades and for some reason no one in my area carried them. For 15 to 20 years (yes I'm serious) I've been looking for them in ever food store I've been to. I was SO excited when I found them here from an Amazon Seller! I was so excited and even more pleased when they arrived quickly and were fresh and wonderful.

column9: Taste Great & no problem with my nut allergy
column10: I have a severe nut allergy, but it came on when I was a teenager so I still remember the taste of nuts from when I was a kid. These taste a lot like walnuts. I tried to make some brownies with these in them, but it did not work out so well (they got soft when cooked).

The product tastes good but i think the price can be a little lower given the volume of contents in each bottle. Wheat nuts seem very nutritious too and remains crunchy even if we have left it outside the ref. We live in the Philippines and you can imagine our humid environment.

I remembered these from the 70's.  We used to buy these for snacks and they were good.  This is a product that has been able to stand the test of time.  I ordered these last year and was a little worried that I would remember them better then they are.  Nope just as good.  They are for people who can't have nuts but want a nut flavor in a snack.  Crunchy, salty and nutty describes these.  I ordered for a friend at work and we split.  She shared her's with others but I kept mine and snacked when I was temped to reach for the chips.  They are easy to carry in a baggie in your purse so you can have them around when the urge strikes.  If you remember these from years ago they haven't changed, just as good.  You won't be dissappointed.

column9: Amazon came to the rescue of a church dinner...
column10: My wife Carlene and I have known about Wheat Nuts for many years, but we have not seen it on our grocer's shelves for a long time.  We cook for a church function, and Carlene wanted to make a cold salad that had chicken, fruit, mixed greens, and nuts.  We know that at least one person who would be attending has a nut allergy, and we had decided to leave out the nuts.Carlene thought of Wheat Nuts - a nut free food that tastes a lot like pecans.  But where to buy it?  When three special shopping trips failed to find any, well, what else was there to do but turn to Google.  Sure enough, there they were on Amazon.  The jar pictured looked like we remembered, and the price was certainly reasonable, so I placed an order for 6 jars.I am pleased to report that the shipment arrived in good time, and was well packed.  Best of all, the product was exactly what we remembered.  The taste went well with the rest of the ingredients.  I would recommend Wheat Nuts as a substitute for nuts in a recipe - and they are great eaten out of hand.

column9: Pet Green Treat are amazingly good!!!
column10: Ask my boy how good they are.....he is absolutely crazy about them..they are gluten free and made of great ingredients. A lot of the pet stores in South Florida don't carry their brand but you can order through Amazon or the manufacturer. Your dog is going to love all their products, you will see, try them

I tried the Lay's Limons while working in Colorado & I was hooked!!! I too contacted Lay's (via e-mail) to see if they could begin selling the item in my region (the South) or if I could purchase them from them(Lay's) . Unfortunately, it wasn't possible for Lay's to do such a thing so...curiosity advised that I check Amazon and I did!!! I'm glad that I did. I ordered on the 31st of July, I received them by the 6th of August (from Cheapees). My chips were boxed perfectly! I was worried that they'd be crushed & crumbled, but they weren't!!! So...kudos to Cheapees!!!

I agree with the previous reviewer; these are the best chips on the planet, but there's got to be a better way of shipping them then stacking them in a bare cardboard box!  I guess I should be happy to get them at all -- I couldn't believe these fabulous treats weren't available in stores east of Texas.  I will keep ordering them (can we put them on Subscribe & Save?), but I'll also keep hoping they find a better way to ship them to me so I have fewer crumbs and more chips!

Amazing to find these online - This is the best potato chip flavor on the planet, and I haven't been able to buy them since leaving texas... however they are expensive, and were shipped in a crappy box which was squashed en-route... 12 of the bags were popped when the box arrived... sigh...

column9: My wifes favorite candy of all time!
column10: Our costco doesnt carry this anymore, and its a few bucks over their price but these are yummy.  Caramel, chocolate and macadamia nuts.  Press them into a little ground kosher salt and they're perfect!
I usually love chocolate covered macadamia nuts, but these are too salty. I don't care for them at all. Also, I ended up paying $24 for these. They should be more like $10.
Total rip off. If you go to get them at Costco, the are about $12-$13, not $22 like on here.

These are sooooooo good. Seriously yummy. Even my 13yr old daughter loves these and she hates nuts....or she did until she snagged a few of these lol. They are the perfect mix of chocolate/caramel/nuts. I love that the nuts are whole and not pieces like some brands that do "turtles" candies. The only draw back was the price but since I can't find these at our local Costco I deal with it.
These are the best macadameia clusters.  They have lots of nuts and the salted caramel is terrific.  We couldn't find them locally, so we were glad to find them on Amazon.
Of all the good things to eat that can be purchased at Costco, this is my all time favorite.  They have a perfect balance of taste and texture that is wonderful, you can't stop with just one.

I could have actually enjoyed this product if it didn't have this gross musty smell and all of the pieces weren't stuck together in one melted lump. I guess the last part was the fault of humid weather, though. But I seriously couldn't get past the smell. Plus, I heard it was overpriced, so don't really like the idea of that.

I bought these because my brother LOVES them and they stopped selling them at our Costco.  So, since they were a gift, it was important that at least look okay... they looked terrible!  I understand that they were shipped, but the chocolate was cracked in places and chunks of it had stuck to the container.  Ah, well... I'm sure he'll still be excited because he likes them so much, but still pretty disappointing since I paid over twice what they used to cost at Costco.

I live outside of the U.S. where this seasoning is sold usually.  I haven't seen this sold anywhere in the community here and I still had some when I moved.  I pretty much put this stuff on everything, meat, popcorn, veggies...it's great.  I'm glad I can still order it and have it shipped overseas!

I absolutely LOVE this seasoning! It is the best I have ever had. It gives your standard more popularly known seasoning a serious go on tastes. Do yourself a favor and try it for yourself. I make it my business to purchase this seasoning whenever I am lucky to come across it so you know it must be worth it.

I bought this in Florida and brought it back to Canada.  I used it camping this weekend.  We put it on a chicken that we roasted on the fire, on our eggs in the morning, everything!  All our friends loved it.  It was the hit of the weekend, our little spice mix.  :)
The product arrived as described and within the time predicted. We are happy with the purchase and will re-order in the future.
If you haven't tried this Cajun seasoning, you're missing something very special.  The price is affordable and you receive a large container.

This product should have been called "Cajun Salt" because it is mostly salt crystals with a little spice mixed in. If you want to control your own salt content and get more flavor, get the Louisiana Fish Fry Products Cajun Blackened Seasoning instead. Loved that one from the same company.

I have been going to multiple stores to find this stuff since I could not find it where I usually shop.  Will not live without it.  Absolutely wonderful on steak with a little worchestire sauce.  We also use it on chicken.  I could see it great on fish too or burgers to but we have not tried that yet.  Not really hot, but just great!  If the next store does not have it, I will be ordering it from amazon and stocking up!

I was unable to tell if this price os for a single bottle or a case.  The single bottles of this product are under $2 on the Louisiana Fish Fry website, but this would be a great price for a case.  Needs clarification.
This is a spiced tea. Cloves and cinnamon makes it similar to chai. It needs a bit more brewing time than other herbal teas, but overall a great herbal drink.
This tea is the best mint loose leaf I've found. It has great flavor and is tasty hot or cold!
This stuff is tasty, gives you energy, is caffeine free, and organic - i drink several large mugs a day and it keeps me nicely hydrated. :-)

I vowed to give up coffee for water, but it wasn't working.  Then someone educated me on the virtues of teas -- and I have a cabinet full of about 20 different varieties to prove it!  Octavia's Rainforest Mint Yerba Mate was my first foray in to loose tea, which I brew exactly as the tin instructs (boil water, but cool slightly to pour over tea infuser, cover, steep 3-4 minutes).  I LOVE IT!  With summer here, I use 2 infusers  with 8-9 ounces of hot water, then add ice for a mid-day pick me up.  Its perfect as is, just the right hint of mint and something else that keeps me from needing sweetener or having a bitter aftertaste.  Now if only I could figure out how to make it 2 quarts at a time to serve to family and guests...I don't know about the metabolism/weight loss aid it touts.  It would be a great side perk, but for now I'm just happy to have a pleasant way to increase my "water" intake!

I have tried different sugar substitutes.  This one is terrible.  If anyone had given me a clue as to how bad this is I would not have purchased it.  I can only use Xylitol or Stevia as a sweetner.  Now that I have tried both I can only say DO NOT BUY this product if you want to sweeten anything.  It just does not work.  I  cannot give this away.  No one wants it.  Sorry but a review should be honest.

My second purchase of this product was unsatisfactory. This sweetener was "chrystalized" in small pieces and did not sweeten at all.  I called to complain and was sent a replacement to no avail. Same situation. The manufacturer must have a quality control problem. After these results , I do not recommend purchase of this product.

I ended up buying this at a local store instead of here, but the product is the same.1) It barely sweetens. I put 8 in my cup of coffee before I surrendered and returned to brown sugar.2) The packages are terrible. Almost impossible to open. There's a little "tear here" notch which is utterly useless, as it's hard to start opening, then causes the package to very suddenly give, causing crystallized bits to fly everywhere upon opening. (Yes, it takes that much force to open the package. I eventually gave up doing it manually and hunted down a pair of scissors.)Horrible product all around. Don't waste your money.

column9: tasted like xylitol to me...convenient packages
column10: I didn't have the problems the other reviewers did with this product.  It's convenient to have little packages of xylitol with you.  The tearing notch doesn't work well, but it's not impossible to open.  If you're used to artificial sweeteners, you may need to use two or more packets of this stuff to get the sweetness you want.  I don't normally buy xylitol in individual packets like this, but I use it everyday at home.  It tastes as close to real sugar as *anything* else I've tried.
I love how Harney & Sons package their teas in those little mesh bags. They are so elegant. Chamomile is my fav but I will probably try some others.
This was my first purchase of Davidson's Teas, but definitely will not be my last.  What an excellent taste the Spearmint has.  Also, not a lot of tea was needed to make a good pot of tea.

Excellent taste and good deal for the money. I love tea but am El Cheapo when it comes to paying big bucks for a tiny box of it. With this product I get my money's worth and it's good idea to boot.Only one quibble: the tea is not large chunks of spearmint but small flakes. So if you're using a teaball, the sediment goes through. If that's important to you, you'll need another way of brewing this particular tea.

This spearmint tea is very nice. Like all Davidson's teas it's Organic, so you aren't drinking down loads of nerve agents.It would be very inexpensive even if not organic, great value.Oh, and so far none of these have turned out to be peppermint, they have been without a doubt spearmint (I like peppermint as well). Excellent tea.UPDATE-The problem with this tea (and with the peppermint from Davidson's) is it's inconsistent. Sometimes you get a great bag of it, other times it has no flavor. Since writing the above review I've recieved bad batches of both mints, hardly any taste or smell. So when it's good, it's an easy 5 stars, but when it isn't, it's worthless. Hopefully that will explain the mixed reviews. I've had nothing but great tea from Davidson's otherwise (red, honey bush, chamomile, etc).

column9: Labled as Spearment but is Pepprement
column10: Recieved the 1st bag and could tell as soon as I opened it that it was peppermint. I contacted the right person who sent me another bag. That turned out to be peppermint also. Gave up after that.

column9: Just like Grandma used to make!
column10: I bought this product with trepidation because in the past I'd tried other fig preserves that were extremely disappointing - too much sugar, or bad figs, or somebody held their pinky the wrong way. Just bad.I held my breath when I opened up the Harvest Song Gourmet jar and took a spoonful out to taste. Then the heavens opened! Choirs of Angels sang! Tiny bluebirds rested on my shoulders! Okay, not really, but this stuff was the real thing - it tastes *exactly* like Grandma's homemade. Exactly. That she made in her kitchen in New Orleans 40 years ago with figs that Grandpa grew in the backyard.So if you are a fig lover, I highly recommend these preserves - they are to die for. If you've never tried figs or especially fig preserves, you don't know what you're missing!
This review is only for people who like figs.  These preserves are the best I have ever had.  I plan to buy them again after they are gone.Amazon is very good about carrying quality products.

These fig preserves are fantastic!!! I first found them in Maui and bought several jars to bring home. Then I found them in a local gourmet grocery, but they ran out and I'm searching again. I'm wait-listed on Amazon. I can't wait for them to get back in stock. The Apple/Pear preserves by Harvest Song are also most excellent!

My husband loves fig jam and this is by far the best he has ever had.  I will reorder this (sooner than I thought since my 14-year old grandson also loves it and he usually does not like jelly and jams).  There are nice "pieces" of figs in the jam.  Delicious!

This was a gift for my 90 year old grandmother. She was so pleased with your product she didn't want to eat it too fast and use it up! If her friends were very lucky they got a taste of it too. No one had ever tasted a fig spread as delicious as yours. This is high praise indeed seeing as no one was younger than 70! I want to add my thanks to you for making me the best grand-daughter ever!

We are now on our third jar of the three jars I purchased and have thoroughly enjoyed all three.  I looked for a long time to find fig preserves that were as good as I used to make and believe me, these are better (and no mess too!)  I am stunned by the negative comment as we think it tastes terrific!  I am going to purchase more for Christmas gifts!

column9: Best fig preserves I can find - love them
column10: These fig preserves are the best I have been able to find, and I've tried other types over the years.  I won't bother ordering or buying any other again.  They come very well protected, (no worry about breakage), are delicious, more fig than any other ingredient, and spread beautifully.  Yum.  Good on toast, with cottage cheese, with meats, over ice cream ....

column4: D. Raddatz "Previous Apple Manager and Proud Dad"
column10: This jam taste just like it did back in Armenian with my mom's homemade jam.  Great stuff!  Packaged very well too.

You cannot imagine my disappointment.  The other reviewers say just like Grandma's homemade.  I suppose it is possible that my Grandma was a better cook than yours.  These are awful preserves.  And that is the nicest thing I can say about them.The packaging is spectacular, the quality, the flavor and the overall experience eating these preserves is way below par.  I did consume some, just hoping my initial experience was not good.  These preserves are terrible.  These are the worst tasting fig preserves I have ever tasted.  I was so excited reading they are just like Grandma's; I got the cherry flavored one too.  Yikes.Side-by-side, you could not tell the difference in the two jars.  They tasted identical.  The fig did not taste anything like figs and the cherry did not taste anything like cherries.They tasted identical.  They tasted awful.I am very disappointed especially since after reading the other reviewers; I was really excited to have finally found some good fig preserves.

column9: Love the salt, not the packaging.
column10: I was dismayed when I ran out of Baleine (my favorite cooking salt) and could no longer find it in any stores.  I hadn't looked for awhile because one canister lasts about a year with nightly home cooking use, provided of course you're not doing something silly with it like seasoning your pasta water - get coarse kosher salt for that.  But so then, amazon to the rescue.Buying 6 seemed a bit egregious but I figured, what the hell, salt doesn't go bad.  I used to cook professionally and encountered this stuff when I worked at a ritzy country club in Florida.  The salt is fine grained and delicious.  The beauty of the fine granules is how easily and evenly they pour from the spout; just tip it upside down and it flows with hourglass consistency.Each cylinder has 2 aperture 'settings', a large single hole for quick pouring, and 4 small holes for slower pouring.  I almost always use the 'slower' one, and with a slight shimmy of the wrist from maybe 14 inches high, the salt lightly dusts whatever's beneath it.  As you get used to the container, you learn to measure your pours by time and feel, much the same way some chefs measure by pinch.I tried one replacement from the store with similar packaging and after 2 nights with it, decided that I couldn't take it anymore.  The granules were too large and the openings too small, which resulted in me having to violently shake the container to get anything out, thereby producing, shall we say, 'money shotesque' splurges of salt that would land sporadically on my proteins.  Who could live like that?So my take is basically the middle ground between the two other reviews.  Unfortunately, my salt also came with one container broken and half spilled.  But, I love this salt so much, that offense hardly makes the experience 1-star worthy.  For evenness and consistency of seasoning, it's a great product and hard to beat.  And now I'm stockpiled until the latter half of the decade.  <3 the Whale.

column9: Never knew I could have a salt brand preference!
column10: Love this salt!  I don't remember when or why I picked it up in the first place.  Initially I bought it at a local fancy kitchen store. When they closed I found a local grocery that carried it.  Well, it's no longer on the shelf there either, so now I am STOCKED with a package of 6 containers of my favorite salt courtesy of Amazon.  I'm not certain of the correct salt terminology, but to me this has a smooth, clean flavor.  Other salts now seem to have a big "bite" that seems harsh and overpowering on my food.  This salt enhances the food without saying "Hey! Look at me! Taste me! I'm SALT!"  Great on popcorn, eggs, anything.  I have used this for years, and now that I have several containers, I may just have to share with friends.  Arrived in perfect condition, though I understand others have not been as lucky.  Each container is large, with a "sprinkle/shake" hole, and a "pour" hole. I keep mine in an open container so I can grab a pinch anytime.  Highly recommend!

column9: Great salt in need of better packaging
column10: Like other reviews here, this one is to say I love La Baleine salt and, when my six containers arrived, one had lost its bottom and emptied inside the shipping box. Luckily the six containers were packed within a plastic bag, so I did not have to clean anything up; however, I feel there's got to be a better way. Five stars for the product, one for the shipping.I've never had a problem with a storebought canister of the stuff, so either these things were made to only ship in full cartons or retail stores go through a bunch of broken ones. My guess is that if they were packed in such a way that they could not move at all, there would be no problem.

So the salt is fine, but the poorly designed "cylinder" is not very sturdy and today, while pouring some salt into a soup I was making.. the lid came apart from the canister and poured the whole container into my soup... obviously ruining it.  Buy something else and save yourself the hassle.

column9: AMAZON PLEASE PACK IT BETTER NEXT TIME!!!
column10: Amazon needs to learn how to package their products better. One container of salt was broken and the white substances (salt) were all over the inside and outside the box and my freight forwarder have to call me and ask what is this white power... AMAZON PLEASE PACK IT BETTER NEXT TIME!!!

My local stores seem to have quit carrying this product so I've been trying to find another fine sea salt.  Problem is, I have not found a single salt that is near as fine as this product.  It is what some call "popcorn salt".LOVE this product!!

column9: Slap Ya If You Don't Buy It
column10: A friend brought us back the Original Slap Ya Mama from New Orleans a few years ago.  When I ran out, I thought I would try the extra spicy also.  They both are highly recommended.  Great for popcorn, eggs, porkchops, you name it.  The spicy is SPICY.  If you're not sure, try the original in the yellow container first.

Our local grocery store quit carrying this product!  Was glad to find it here on Amazon.  If you like spicy, you will love this stuff.  My family uses it pretty much on everything.  I even sprinkle some on our home made Chex mix for some heat!

A tailgating friend of mine turned me on to this cooking essential.  This seasoning is used more than any other in my house.  A great blend of peppers offers great flavor and a comfortable level of heat.  If you are a chili-head, this won't provide a sweat inducing burn (unless you use a ton), but it will provide a very nice flavor with enough heat for most people to notice.  If I want a little extra heat I add one of any number of other things.  But this seasoning is the first thing I grab for almost anything.  Eggs, pizza, mashed potatoes, bean dip, taco meat, grilled cheese, the list could go on and on.Give it a try, you won't regret it!

I used to live in Louisiana, so I knew about this product already.However, I could not find it here in North Carolina.It adds just the right kick to any dish.I use it in beans, and in stir-fry and on fried chicken.

This spice mix is absolutely fantastic. It gives a lot of heat and a ton of flavor to anything you put it on or in. I use it as a spice rub on turkeys when i'm to lazy to make my own (which is often) and it's great. It gives a wonderful dark color to the bird and tastes great. Highly recommend!

This powdered seasoning is a great addition to just about any meal.  If you like spicy food and are looking for a nice flavorful kick, Slap ya mama delivers.  It has become a favorite around my household amongst the whole family.  The odor is not overpowering and the flavor is awesome.Nutrition Facts:Serving size:1/4 tsp (0.04oz)Servings per container about 22.7Calories: 0Total Fat: 0Sodium: 190mg  8%Carbs: 0Protein: 0Vitamin A: 4%Ingredients: Salt, red pepper, black pepper, garlic. no MSG.

I am not one of those people who eat the hottest thing available for the endorphin rush.  I prefer to eat hot items that not only have heat, but also have a good flavor to them.  Slap Ya Mama seasoning not only brings tears to my eyes and sweat to my brow, but it does so with a pleasant flavor.  Put it on chicken, fish, and beef, it does not matter, Slap Ya Mama enhances almost anything you can think to put it on!

column9: Well my mama just about slapped me!
column10: Salty, spicy, and flavorful.  That's what I wanted for my mother who loves "hot".  I'm very happy with the purchase.  I've ordered twice, and come Christmas time, I'll try some other S.Y.M products.  Of course my mother also gets a kick out of the name. It's definitely worth trying, and it always ships on time or before schedule (at least to NY and PA) I have to check if there's a lower sodium option.  If I could get her hooked on that I would feel even better about myself.

A friend of mine told me about Slap Ya Mama, saying she put it on everything.  Since I like spicy, I ordered the HOT version and glad that I did.  This stuff is great on everything...especially pizza.

This is a very good choice for seasoning. I find myself putting it on almost everything! Not only is it very spicy but it also has a wonderful flavor. Many sauces  and seasonings only concentrate on being hot. This has the best of both worlds.

My husband LOVES the Slap-Ya-Mama seasonings!  He eats hot sauce and spices on everything and is very particular about what suits him!  I got him this last year for Christmas in a mall kiosk and had trouble finding it again this year when he wanted more... so happy to find it on Amazon!

I bought this and a bunch of hot sauces and seasonings for a boyfriend. He was incredibly impressed with this one. He couldn't stop raving about it. I'm not entirely sure I trust his palate since he's probably burned most of his taste buds off, but I figured his enthusiasm helped warrant a good review.

While I have not yet tried the hot seasoning, I was very disappointed when it arrived with packing tape securing the top of the container.  To get the applied tape off, the paper put on by the manufacturer tore.  Obviously, this container will not be put on my table.

This has become my favorite loose leaf tea.  Very tasty as iced tea, also good as hot.  Product is packed in metal tins, stays fresh quite a long time, but I do recommend keeping in it in the refrigerator in hot climates to prevent oxidation.  Flavor reminds me a little of double mint gum -- my favorite as a kid -- but mellower.  Fairly sweet on its own, not much sweetener needed.

column9: A  delightful organic loose leaf green tea
column10: Octavia Tea Organic Lime Blossom Green Tea, Loose Tea, 2.57-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2) is a very delightful green tea.I recently acquired a The Breville One-Touch Tea Maker, which is a marvelous way to brew loose leaf tea, and this lime blossom green tea is exquisite when prepared in it.The green tea is smooth and the citrus subtle, making a well balanced, very pleasing blend of flavors which is never sharp or bitter. I find this brew to be very calming for my digestion as well and enjoy it during and after meals.  It's also especially nice that the tea can be brewed several times, making the 2.57-ounce tin really last.Finally, I am thrilled that Octavia Tea Organic Lime Blossom Green Tea, Loose Tea, 2.57-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2) is USDA Organic and comes in very practical but attractive tins to ensure freshness.  The pack of 2 at Amazon is a great value.  I don't think I've tried any other organic green tea that I like better than this one.
I like lime, I drink it all the time, although I'm not a mime, I know it's not a crime, I hope you like my rhyme.
I like this as a basic sauce. But actually prefer the thick & chunky. I often get this because the thick & chunky is often sold out. The flavor is a good tomatoey flavor with some herbs.

This is an amazing product. Gelatin is pure collagen protein, 9 grams of collagen protein per tablespoon. And the best thing is that it's hydrolyzed collagen which makes it easily digestible. When I heard that the Guiness Book of World Records for weight loss was a woman who lost over 300 pounds by taking collagen, I just had to try it. I've been taking collagen for one month and my sagging skin is noticeably firmer. This is so thrilling to me that I will be taking this for the rest of my life. I also noticed some research online that said ingesting hydrolyzed collagen will tone and tighten sagging skin, reverse wrinkles, get rid or cellulite, keep bones and cartilage strong, and easearthritis pain.I started taking a liquid collagen product but decided I could no longer afford it, so I was excited to learn that gelatin is the same thing, except you simply mix the powder in water or juice. You need at least 8 grams of collagen per serving once daily to see skin toning. The best time to take it is before bed at least two hours after eating. If you search for unflavored gelatin on amazon.com you will see one of the reviewers of another brand said she was taking it to get rid of cellulite and that it is working. I decided on this particular brand because it is not made from porcine/pigs. I like that it is kosher and made from beef bone. Just as a side note, in the olden days people always boiled bones to make broth or soup and that's how they got the needed collagen to keep their bones from getting brittle.
I make bone broth nearly every week and NOW Food Beef Gelatin has become a staple in that process. The resulting broth is amazingly rich. Price is right too.

I started taking this to improve my diet since I read that gelatin is good for health.  Happily, I have found a side benefit I didn't expect.  It cured my constipation issue that I had since starting a low carb diet.  Actually,  I had that problem somewhat even before that.  Anyway, maybe that is what people are missing when they eat low carb and have constipation.

I had never tried Honeybush tea before purchasing this batch from Davidson's, and I couldn't be happier with it. In appearance and consistency, the ground tea is very similar to Rooibos, except it is a slightly darker red. The aroma of the tea is just heavenly. I should also mention that it makes a truly AWESOME iced tea. I normally don't type in caps, but I wanted to emphasize how good this is as a summer refresher. Heat water until close to boiling, then turn off the heat and steep the tea grounds until you attain the desired strength and color. Let the water cool down and then refrigerate it and you have iced tea that far surpasses any bottled brand. Lastly, you will want to store this tea in an airtight plastic container or canister, as it comes in a paper bag that is not really meant for permanent storage.

Already a big fan of bush tea (Rooibus tea) I thought it would be interesting to try another one of these African teas.  The shipping container is very much environmentally friendly with a good seal, and you certainly get your money's worth.  Opening the container you will experience an absolute joy at the exquisit aroma emanating from the wonderful small granules that comprise this tea.  Be forewarned, you cannot use your usual tea strainer, you must use a silk bag or some such to filter out all the particles when you brew your tea.  Personally, I bought a Rooibus tea at Starbucks, and simply kept the teabag, tearing it open at the top, and reusing it to brew all of these African teas.  I must admit, however, that the flavor is quite subtle.  Perhaps it would be enhanced with honey or sugar, but I prefer my tea without, and this one just doesn't have a strong enough flavor to make me switch from Rooibus.  Good for an alternative once in a while, but be forewarned, it is very, very subtle.  Some folks add dried cranberries and a bit of orange to enhance the flavor.  I have't tried that, good luck to you if you do.  One very important benefit, though, is that there isn't a microgram of caffeine in this tea.  It is caffeine-free.

I specifically chose this tea due to the fact that the price per ounce beat any tea blend or otherwise in my area.  Ounce per ounce of loose tea you simply couldn't beat the price... plus free shipping? I blend my herbals in my own concoctions and brew them in my infuser.  This is a finer grind than I am accustomed, but I solved that problem by shoving a coffee filter into my infuser before adding the tea.  It is not heavy, dark or woody at all.  It is light, fresh and almost sweet.  I love it with my chai blends as well as with the greys.As another reviewer stated, it is superb as an iced tea and I've begun blending for the purpose of brewing to ice.  I highly recommend not only this particular tea... but also the company.  Well packaged, though I do suggest repackaging for long term.  I would and will buy again!Cheers!PS - It's decaffienated!

column9: This has made me rethink honeybush
column10: I was surprised when this honeybush proved to have a slight black pepper/cinnamon smell, and even more unusual, a slight burning sensation in the back of the throat.  It is not unpleasant at all, but it is not like how I expected honeybush to taste on its own.  If it helps, the sensation reminds me of the same feeling one can have from very freshly-pressed olive oil.However, I've only had it blended with red or green rooibos before, and in those bags, honeybush seemed to make the result a sweeter taste--but never something even slightly "peppery."  Maybe this honeybush is so fresh that some constituents are still in it that aren't there once aged.  In referencing internet resources, it appears a constituent of cinnamon makes up part of honeybush.The bag arrives completely sealed, and with a zipper-like top (not rolled as the current picture shows).  Once opened, it has a nice deep smell (again, slightly peppery) and a darker color than any red rooibos.  It blends well with rooibos, but shifts the flavor to something slightly spicy and, in my opinion, still needing something to sweeten it up a bit.My wife likes it a lot and we will be using it as one of our many tea options from now on.The price is a steal for what you get.

I drink Rooibus and Honeybush regularly.  Overall, good quality (although I preferred Inaba and Kalahari) and I like the organic aspect, but this doesn't strike me as bulk tea (having bought many loose, bulk teas in the past from various internet tea merchants), as much as crushed leaf remnant, more like what what we would find in a tea bag or even remainders of the sorting process.  If someone knows better, I would stand corrected.

I like this tea a lot.It is milder that Rooibos tea and tastes less acidic (I must say that Rooibos tea is not strong-flavored but I still find that Honeybush is even milder without loss of flavor).I like my tea dark colored but I cannot always have black tea so this Honeybush is a perfect addition to my tea repertoire. It has a mild pleasant aroma too.I like that it has no caffeine, it's dark but never tart or bitter.I often brew the same batch twice with good results. It is my second purchase and I am still well-pleased.

column9: Unique know what you are buying
column10: I had never tried this type tea before but I decided to give it a try. It is different than anything I have tasted in the past and its not to bad, but just know it is a bit unique it reminds me of licorice.

column9: South African Honeybush is a hit!
column10: What I really like about the South African Honeybush tea is the gently sweet taste and wonderful fragrance. I often blend it with other teas I have but most often brew it straight by itself to enjoy the really great aroma and flavor.
I like the soothing flavor. You can have a cup before you retire for the day and it doesn't disturb your sleep. I've given it to friends and they share the same opinion.
I usually drink rooibos but this red is good too.  More on the herbal side of red.
That was I expectedtaste good, smell good, that's a good product.I recommend it. to drink at night, before to go bed.

I love this tea because: it's herbal (no caffeine), it's great w/milk (especially chocolate soy milk), it's comfort food and it comes in loose leaf. Davidson's ships right on time (have monthly continuing order) and are friendly and helpful if I need to call them--BUT still have to deal with Amazon regarding any problems with the order. I started w/a pound every 3 months, changed that to 2 months and now get a pound a month. Drink it throughout day and love love love it.

I bought this for my husband and he absolutely loves this tea. It's mild with a slightly sweet hint and is delicious iced as well. Now when he brews sweet tea, he only likes using this blend. Shipment is always prompt and the bags they come in are resealable and do well to maintain the freshness and quality of the tea.

This is an excellent  herbaltea which taste very similar to Rooibos, yet it has a slightly sweeter taste to it which makes it linger a little longer on your taste buds. I often times drink this with no added sweetener. There isn't much more to say other than I am very please with the quality products from Davidson's Tea.

I was quite enthused to try this tea, based on reviews. Upon opening the bag, there was a slight scent. Once brewed, there was a flavor which I cannot describe, but which I did not like, followed by a very subtle lemony aftertaste. I am very fond of rooibos tea and had expected something similar, or at least an herbal quality which this tea does not have. It is just not for me. I will use the rest of my pound of honeybush to dye fabric.

I really like the taste of this tea, but I did not like that it was so finely ground up. It slips straight through my traditional mate bombillia, clogging it up. I know that this is not South American mate, but it is advertised in the mate section... So for this reason I can't give it 5 stars.

Very Good Product. I've drank twenty bags @ $4. Couldn't afford that very often but buying in bulk and organic from Davidson's makes this excellent cup of tea a bargain. The picture doesn't do the bag Justice as it has a zip-lock feature. It will take some time to drink all of this one bag and I purchased 4 different varieties. The zip-lock bag would do well if I were were drinking from only one. I vacuum packed 3/4 of each and stored them in the freezer. The partial bags are in the fridge ready to use. I'm looking forward to drinking these fine organic teas for some time to come.

Residing in Canada, finding honeybush is quite difficult except in pricey upscale tea shops. My local tea shop has it but the price is approximately 20$/oz.Here comes Amazon and Davidson's Tea where I could finally buy it in bulk for a reasonable price. The honeybush appears fresh and it has that strong aroma when you open the bag. Once brewed, it is not the tastiest drink but it is good served hot during a cold winter or iced cold during a hot sunny summer day. I add cinnammon, cardamom and/or lime zest to add taste to it.It is healthy, caffeine-free and cheap, what could I ask more ? One advice though, transfer it to a sealed contained as Davidson's bags are not made for long-term storage.
I thought this was a great buy and will reorder.  Great flavor.  I thought it was lacking nice buds but it makes great tea at a great price.  Shipping was fast also.

column9: Good tea if you like "spicy" notes
column10: I like this tea and I agree with a previous reviewer who mentioned that it is different from other Honeybush he had tried - it is a lot more "spicy." The only other honeybush tea I'd had was the Tazo brand, which is kind of sweet. This tea is not sweet per se, but has a very spicy, peppery nose. Since buying this tea, I looked back at the Tazo tea because it tastes so different and I noticed that the Tazo one adds "natural flavors" which I think account for the sweetness. This tea is pure honeybush with no added flavors, and so the taste is a bit different. I do not think the grind is too thin, all the honeybush/rooibos teas I've had have a very small grind so I think that is normal.

This smells great and can't wait to taste. I've loved Davidson's genmaicha and currently on an herbal adventure. Rooibus in general tastes a bit moldy to me but I've read good things about honeybush being similar but different. Loved a free sample tasted at Teavana and since I'm loving Amazon Shop and Save and in the past Davidson's decided to order here.

Overall, I am moderately satisfied with this product.  Ordering was easy (of course); it was delivered as promised; the reclosable bag is very nice; the flavor of the tea is fine.  My only problem is that the tea seems to have been ground.  The bits are so small that none of my tea balls/strainers can contain them so there are many floating in the tea, clinging to the cup, etc.  I prefer my tea without solids and will not order this product again.
This is one of the best honeybush teas I've tasted, and the price is very good.

Very pleased with this tea. It's my first purchase of honeybush tea, and certainly will not be my last. The tea has a very smooth flavor, even when you steep it for a long time for a stronger brew. Very pleasant!It also blends well with other teas - I like to mix it with decaf English Breakfast plus a small pinch of peppermint tea. Very tasty.The tea is very fine in consistency. I'm used to that, since the decaf black teas I drink are also powdery due to the decaf process. I was, however, expecting larger pieces since honeybush is naturally caffeine-free. Not a big deal since I have fine mesh baskets that I use with other teas, but I was hoping this would be different. Oh well, it still tastes great, which is all I really want in a tea.Highly recommend.

I bought this based on other reviews and the comparisions to Rooibos. Don't know if I got an old bag (possible), brewed it wrong (probably) or what but it was awful and went the way of the drain. Wish Davidson's had a sampler of their bulk tea's so one doesn't get stuck with a pound of something they don't like!

Don't be misled by the fact that the description says that this is a pack of 10...it is absolutely not.  It's only ONE packet...which you can buy at the grocery store for $1.00.  Don't pay four dollars for this item--you'll be shafted. Amazon gave me my  money back
This is the best H.H. I've ever had and was broken hearted to find that they no longer carry it where I live. Luckily enough I found it here. Thanks so much!!!

column9: Not All Enchilada Box Mixes ARE The Same
column10: The local stores obviously think they're saving shelf space by only stocking this 'enchilada box mix' in the product line.Well, it DOES taste different than it's chicken counterpart--and this is not a good thing.If you're looking for a fritoey-pie flavor, this would be the product to purchase. It could be prepared with ground turkey or veggie meat crumbles.But I can't recomend utilizing seafood because of the 'heavier' flavor throughout the mix. I've prepared it several times and I just have problems detecting the cheese taste which is supposed to be throughout. I got more of a 'chili' taste. both upon my first and second bites.The product is edible. But it's not one of the enjoyable dishes. And I did not end up feeling like I was eating a delicious dish which I'd want to eat again--or serve to others. Save your money.
Delicious. Well packed. Authentic and rich.The package is over a foot by eight inches by four inches. Tis heft too, like tossing a plump child over your shoulder to tote into the kitchen.

I have 2 labs and one is extremely allergic; these dog cookies are rated well with the Whole Dog Journal The Whole Dog Journal's Guide to Optimum Dog Care: Good Eats - they have a monthly newsletter as well - the ingredients are whole and healthy and there is no chicken, which is really hard to find - my dog is allergic to chicken, eggs, beef, peanuts ... and he's on a grain-free diet - these cookies have oatmeal which is fine for him - so it's very hard to find a healthy dog cookie that works with his allergies and both dogs love them.

My dogs love these. I love the 50-ounce boxes. This is a great product, free from bad preservatives, by-products and animal digest. Wellness is a wonderful brand that is tasty yet very healthy for dogs. These treats are a great bang for your buck in comparison to other dog treats. The price here online is the same as the price at the pet store, but I love the fact that I don't have to spend my gas money going to get it!

My puppy received these biscuits as a Christmas present from his Mom.  I don't normally purchase my dog food or treats online, but I will buy these again.  Both my puppy and mature dog, LOVE these biscuits, and I am confident that they are made of the finest ingredients.  I had some in my pocket while I was in the barn, and my horse started nuzzling my pocket, so I gave him one, and he loved them too!  All natural ingredients make this an appealing treat for horses and dogs alike.  Thanks, puppy-mama, for turning us on to Wellness Wellbars!

column9: Good Ingredients & The Dogs Love Them
column10: I have respect for the Wellness brand and have previously bought my dogs other Wellness treats.  These WellBars are marketed as "bite size."  My corgis love them!  And, they can certainly eat them in one bite.  But, for a medium dog, I consider these larger than bite size.  Luckily, the bars are easily broken in two to provide a smaller snack.  (Weight maintenance is a high priority with my chow hounds.)Each bar has 24 calories.  The first few ingredients are:  ground barley, cane molasses, ground brown rice, whitefish, and sweet potatoes.  There's no wheat, corn, soy, artificial preservatives/color/flavor.This is a big box of treats.  I do wish that the bag was resealable, but that's a quibble.
My 12-year-old Husky goes crazy for these - they are healthy, delicious (apparently), and a great training tool.  They are a little pricey, but worth it for the joy in my dog's face.

column9: My dogs tell me these treats are YUMMY
column10: My two Corgis were thoroughly spoiled by my late husband (I spent a year and a half dieting them down a combined total of 25 pounds!)They are accustomed to the finest of fare, and they absolutely love the Wellness brand of treats.

Our dog likes these treats. We keep them in our laundry room and everytime we go to do laundry she buries her head in the box until we give her a treat.  They are hard treats and kind of big so they probably wouldn't be good for tiny dogs. Our miniature schnauzer is about 18 pounds and they are just the right size for her.
My dogs love these treats!  These treats smell so good that I'm tempted to try them.  The box arrived promptly and was well packed.  Thank You!

column9: All My Dogs Have Loved These
column10: I've had three dogs who all love Well Bars. They break easily and can be used as a training treat.

column9: Good Ingredients & the Dogs Really Like Them
column10: Both of my dogs love these bars.  They smell good too - like apples.  Wellness has a reputation for using quality ingredients, and the ingredient list for these bars is no exception.Eating these bars made one of my dogs itch, though.  He does have some food allergies (corn & wheat), so I didn't detract from the treats' rating.  My best guess is that he reacted to the cane molasses because he's never eaten it before.
Our Golden Doodle loves these treats. Great size for a great price. The large size here on Amazon is the same price as the small size at a local store.

I had to try these treats and are rather impressed with them. I have larger dogs (bullmastiff etc) but they work well for him too. They are square, solid and obviously pretty tasty as all three of my dogs love them. There is a lot in the box and I think for the price, well worth it, being made with good stuff. I recommend to anyone who is the "treat" man or lady.
My dogs love these treats and the price at Amazon was a great value.  There were twice as many as the normal size I buy at less than double the price at my local pet store.
The service was great.  The product is my dogs favorite and it's healthy too.

Both my boxer's favorite treat.  It's healthy, they love it, and it smells good enough for me to try!  (I haven't..yet, for the record).  Wellness continues to impress me with their wholesome products.

Wellness is the brand I go to for dry and wet food for my dog, so I thought I'd try the chicken and cheddar bars.  The second ingredient is cane molasses... I honestly don't know why this is, and it seems odd.  As soon as you open the bag inside the box, you get a whiff of an overwhelming sweetness.  After my dog has one, he's constantly trying to get the caked treat off of his back molars.  It sticks on pretty hard.  I have to help or I have to brush his teeth to get rid of it.  This can't be good for his teeth, and I don't know if he needs the extra sweetness in his diet.  I would recommend Old Mother Hubbard wheat-free treats, such as chicken and apples, before this.  They're also made by Wellness.  Old Mother Hubbard Classic Oven Baked Chick' N' Apples Dog Biscuits Or, Get Naked dog biscuits, which are also very good.  Get Naked Super Antioxidant Biscuits for Dogs, 12-Ounce

My dogs have a sensitive stomach, so I've got to be careful about what I give them. These treats are perfect. They are an optimal size. I give them several throughout the day, so them being small (for a 60 pound dog) is great. I have been using these for years, but just recently started purchasing them online. I haven't really noticed any problems.

Our dog loves these--all the wellness well bars, not just this flavor.  They do seem to be a little hard, great for cleaning teeth but maybe not if your dog has teeth problems.  Nice healthful treats.

My dogs love this flavor and I'm happy they are a healthy treat without all the wheat, etc. thanks for providing this much less expensive buying opportunity or I could probably not afford for my dogs.
These biscuits are real favorites of my small CKC and my GSD. usually they don't like me to change their treats but these were lpve at first sniff and the vendors were quick and very courteous.
My Pit bull puppy would give up her doggy sole for these treats.  I use them all the time.  Highly recommended.
Much bigger box and bang for the buck.  I will purchase again. This is a great treat that the pups enjoy.

column9: Dogs are in love with these treats......!!!!!
column10: As with all of the Wellness products I have ordered so far....these came on the date promised and arrived safely.Both of my dogs were at my feet begging before I had the packaging open...They love them..........K
I hope this product is as healthy for the dog as it seems to be enjoyable.  My 4 year old dachshund loves these!
We have ordered these before and will continue to do so because Bailey loves them and they are good for her.
I like these treats for my dog for two reasons:  1.  They are good for him.  2.  He really likes them.  Surely they have contributed to his healthy teeth.
My dog, of course, adores these - anything with cheese is his favorite.  However, they gave him considerable amounts of gas.  We will, however, try other Wellness treats to see if they work better.
I have been giving these treats to my Weimaraner and Lab for years, and they simply love them! They are extremely healthy, vegetarian treats and they smell good enough to eat!

column9: SMELLS GOOD even I want to eat it
column10: This smells so good . Doesnt' smell like cardboard boxes. Comes in thick plastic bag to prevent puncture and letting the freshness go out.  There's no sealable zipper or anything so I have to use a clothing pin.My dog eats it when she wants to.  I leave it next to her bed she won't touch it sometimes. But sometimes she does eat it up.  She should eat it up fast or else it will become stale.Smells fruity and a hint of gingersnap cookies.  I gave it to another dog and he ate it like there was no tomorrow.  I gave my dog a wellness lamb jerky .. she ate it like crazy. I gave the other dog lamb jerky... he ate it like crazy.My conclusion is that not all dogs like fruity gingersnap cookies. Still have 60% left.Wellness brand is very good but I should stick to a guarantee treat....the lamb or any line meat jerky offered by Wellness.Not sure if I can eat it . lol
My dog loves these crunchy treats and I feel good about giving her them because of the wholesome ingredients. I'm about to order my second box.

I have been giving Wellness treats to my dogs for awhile.  They really like them and I think Wellness puts out a good product.  When I get the box out at night, they run to their crates and wait for their late night snack. No command necessary!

column9: Best of the Wellness Bars, too bad only comes in 20 oz box!
column10: These are the best ones of the Wellness bars because they're completely grain free. My dogs love these. They also contain no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. However, I wish these came in a 50 oz box like the other flavors. The 20 oz box at 8.99 is the same cost at the pet store (and it is 45 cents per ounce) versus a 50 oz box which is just 30 cents an ounce. The product is fantastic, though. A++++
My dogs love these. They are not grain free, but they have no wheat, corn or soy and no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. This is a great value at just under thirty cents per ounce. A++++

First Impression: Well the kind folks over at Wellness Pet Food heard about my website and sent me some treats to try! They ended up sending me a big box of their WellBars that have Yogurt, Apples, and Bananas in them. Totally vegetarian, oven baked with lots of vitamins! I'm sure you have read one of my other reviews about Old Mother Hubbard, they make outstanding healthy treats. Turns out that WellNess is owned by Old Mother Hubbard. Who knew? As usual Dad ran me though a barrage of tests to see how much I really wanted the treat. Let's just say I had to work very hard. Those silly "sit ups" that little dogs do, roll over, sit, stay, down, etc, just to have him put the treats in my Everlasting Treat Ball! I made short work of it and devoured my new delicious and healthy treats. The only thing I'm a little disappointed about is I found out that they have WellBites that are soft treats. They even have one that's Lamb and Salmon flavored... Those are two of my favorite things in the world. Now I have to talk Dad into buying them for me...Conclusion: Outstanding healthy dog treats! A must buy for a healthy pup.

We can't change our dog's diet much.  Unfortunately he is highly food motivated and loves to visit our local hardware for treats.  In fact, he keeps a supply at the hardware.  He had never been diagnosed with any food allergies but after buying a large box of commercial treats to keep at the hardware, we started to notice some problems.A local pet store recommended another flavor of these treats.  He liked them but we didn't notice an improvement in his symptoms so I tried these.  After all, apples and yogurt are some of my boy's favorite things!He loves these treats.  Although his symptoms have not cleared up entirely, they did improve.  His friend at the hardware likes to feed him a lot of treats at once so we consider them well tested at this point and we just ordered our third box.  Dogs like 'em and mom approves!

Our dog will not eat the Wellness Wellbar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats; however, we crush two of these up for each daily feeding and mix them with his regular dog food.  For this reason I would not buy these crunchy treats again, although I must say they smell good!We feel the reason for his not eating the crunchy treats is that he is accustomed to the soft Wellness wellbites that we have been giving him for over a year.  He loves these.  Wellness WellBar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats, 50-Ounce Pouch

I ordered this product thinking it would have been soft treats I could use for training and disappointed that they were biscuits. However they seem to be very healthy treats compared to some and the dogs really like them.

tried wellness webb bars, whitefish and sweetpotatoes and with crunchy peanuts and honey.  have three dogs two just push them away, the third who will eat dirt inhaled them.  Rate this products as a 0.
This mustard is excellent.  The sweet comes first and then it gets warmer.  It is not a really hot mustard but has a great flavor with a definite bit of heat.

For the longest time I've hated mustard with a passion, and I've decided to give it a shot again.  Today I bought a bottle of Inglehoffer Sweet Hot Mustard and some pretzels and I am loving it.  The stuff kicks like a shotgun.  It's great!

I love this mustard and the price is great!!!The only issue I have is the fact that you don't know the expiration date until you receive it.I would like to know of when it expires before I buy it, rather than taking a chance on whether I get old stock or not.In spite of this, I would be willing to make this purchase again.....thank you Amazon
This mustard is absolutely amazing!! Have been using it for years and now not one grocery store anywhere near me sells it. I am so excited that I have found it on Amazon. Thanks

column9: Love this stuff, cheap in bulk
column10: A friend of mine first got me hooked on this when he had a sausage and cheese plate at a party. I have always liked "Honeycup" brand mustard, but it was a little bit too thick for my tastes. This was a great compromise, and has a really strong kick but isn't burning hot. I can go through a bottle a month, so it got expensive, but buying six like this cut a good percentage off of it. Great deal!
It is my favorite mustard and this is the best price... but you need to buy pack of 6.It is enough for 1-2 months... if eating this mustard instead of potatoes. :)
Pretty good stuff...tastes ALOT like the mustard you get in chinease restaurants.  Except it has an underlying honey taste to it.

column9: This mustard is the best ever !!!
column10: Try this mustard on some smoked sausage in a hot dog bun or on some summer sausage thinly sliced with cheese spread on good crackers....this mustard is great !!!!!

Bought this mustard because I hoped it would taste like Johnsonville Mustard Sweet N' Hot which I can't find anywhere.  This mustard is not at all sweet, and the hot part of it tastes like pure horseradish.  Even though I like horseradish and I like mustard, I am disappointed that this "Sweet Hot" mustard isn't sweet in the very least.  Too hot/spicy to spread on crackers for cheese and cracker snacks (overpowers the taste of the cheese completely), and makes my son gag.  He likes sweet mustards, but this mustard is not sweet.

Like many people my first exposure to scotch were brands like J&B and Seagrams, in other words "Instant Turn Off".I recieved a bottle of Macallams 12 year old scotch as a gift.I tried it and was smitten.To understand how good this is, you need only sniff a botte of J&B and then sniff Macallams. The aroma and therefore the taste is amazing.
Makes a good 8 ounce of strong coffee.  Much better than the Senseo pods.

The Java Podz coffee pads do not fit well in the Senseo coffee maker. One pad fits in the two cup holder. It makes a very weak cup of coffee. I ordered a large supply and will probably throw them out.

We bought these for the Senseo- the ad says it is compatable but its not! Buyers beware- I almost broke my Senseo trying to use them- The Senseo got stuck closed and I had to wait for it to let go of the vacuum. I think its because there is more coffee in these.

"This one caught us by surprise! We don't know of any other pod maker that has this flavor and it's really good! We love the way it smells - the way it tastes - and the fact it is just plain different. Most pod people are ignoring the flavored sector to this extent - and it's nice to have a cup of really flavored coffee - meaning - a rich...flavored cup of coffee is hard to come by and this one is very good." - singleservecoffee.com

This has been my favorite tea for more than 30 years. I always drink it at my grandmother's house. I am a red tea lover, and I compare all other teas to this one. The flavors blend perfectly and are complemented by a small addition of sweetness. Honey is the best, but stevia works well too. Red Zinger is close as my second favorite, and Tazo African Red Bush falls in a weak third place.

column9: Wow, just like freshly grilled eggplant
column10: Great product. Tastes like freshly grilled eggplant. Nice and smokey. Not at all slimy or preserved tasting. Can't believe this comes from a jar.
Although my kids like this juice, I was disappointed to discover it's only 66% juice. It's also 10g sugar per box.

Mighty great coffee, awesome one day sale pricing, and cool old fashion packaging. One problem, liked to never of broken into the goods. That top was really glued on, not good for old farts with bad hands. A rusty knife may work, but I sure don't want to cut some precious coffee packets. Some kind of pull string, like on those old dog food bags, or a ductape seal would do the trick.Well, shiver me timbers. I just learned. via another old fart, that there is a secret passage into the EkoJava coffee chest. By golly, there's a hidden perforation under the label, no signs or maps, about two inches down from the top, that opens the goods real smart. Just run a fingernail around the perforation and twist the top right off. Who would of ever guessed?Now, more Java for me mates.

It's so hard to find a quality, grade one, single origin coffee. I got the product and immediately tried it. The flavor was incredible and the stick packs were nice, but I hope they will come out with a bulk (not in stick packs), pre-ground coffee option in the near future. Other than that, I could not be more impressed or pleased with the product.

The Sumatra coffee is my favorite of the EkoJava blends [I've tried French Roast and Honduras House]. It has a nice bold flavor and the packet size is great for the re-usable k-cups [solofill or my k-cup type].  I'll purchase again.

Very good coffee. I like bold, strong coffee and this very nearly fills the bill; I brew 12-ounce cups and it's good; 10- or 8-ounce cups even better for my taste. No mess, nice canister, good coffee. The price is decent when it's on sale for $10; I think the list price is too steep.I brew it in a solo cup with an ez filter. Less mess, less waste (of water. I don't like the amount of water I waste rinsing away coffee grounds.)I'd like to see them come up with a stronger blend, a variety pack, and a refill option to cut down on price and packaging even more.

column9: Wanted to like it more than I did
column10: I love a nice full bodied Sumatra, but this one just didn't deliver all the satisfaction I wanted. I'm back to filling my solo cup with another Sumatra. Cute packaging, near perfect portion size, but left me wanting more.

column9: Eko admits the issue with Sumatran grind
column10: My review is impacted by the use of this coffee and brew method - not on the sole quality of the taste.We bought two EkoBrew baskets, a can of the Sumatran, and one of the Honduran. When the Sumatran refused to brew a full cup we contacted the company. Received a nice email that explained the grind was "pre EkoBrew" and they admit to it not working well with their single serve basket. That being said, they apologized and suggested for us to use less coffee with a smaller cup setting - as well as offering us a refund for the inconvenience.So, I'm not sure if the taste is fantastic enough for more than two stars, since I can't brew a proper cup with their own product. I gave them an extra star for customer service.

column9: Very good quality just too expensive
column10: I tried the EkoJava packets a while back when they were on sale for $10. The 4 star review is actually due to the cost of EkoJava more than anything else. At $10 the price is as good as or cheaper than k-cups much of the time. At $12 (as of the time of this review) it is 48 cents a cup. I have never seen it at full price, but $15 for 25 cups is too much money I think. The good part is that the quality of the coffee is very good. I am not a coffee connoisseur by any means, but the Ekojava is some of the best unflavored coffee I have ever had from my Keurig.I think it might be ground a bit too finely though. The brew time is pretty darn long (even double sometimes) but I have not been getting short-cupped at all. I would worry about it more if I was getting short-cupped. At first it looks like all of the coffee isn't going to fit below the solofill line, but just shaking it back and forth to even the top off is enough to get the grounds enough to go below the line (I did not tamp it down at all.)My only other complaint is that when you open the EkoJava packet with the perforated line on the package, the hole to pour the grounds out can be a bit small. I get around it by either using scissors, or opening it with the perforated line in such a way that makes the hole bigger.Overall, IF you can get EkoJava on sale at a point where it is the same price or cheaper than k-cups then I say it is a good buy assuming you already have a solofill.
