They should be recalled, or at least not called "teething" biscuits, more like "toddler" biscuits.

My son almost choked to death on one of these. Instead of slowly dissolving they break apart in large chunks. I would pull them out of his mouth whenever one broke off but today he managed to swallow it before I could get it out and it was nearly lethal. The biscuits are wide and flat. The pieces that break off have sharp corners. The piece that he swallowed was completely blocking his windpipe and because of the sharp corners it was nearly impossible to get out. Baby heimlich did not work. I had to stick two fingers all the way down his throat, carefully dislodge it and pinch it between my fingers to get it out. He is 13 months and eats all kinds of crackers and other solids. These should be taken off the market.
My son really loved them. They are good around the time he is teething because he can bite on them. However, I do not recommend them to infant less than 8 month old..

column9: Definite choking hazard for teething babies
column10: My 1 year old has choked on these biscuits - he is old enough to feed himself cereal pieces, baby mum-mums, etc. but choked within 1 minute of eating these biscuits.  They are hard enough that when they break off in a baby's mouth, the pieces still stay big and hard rather than dissolving like baby puffs or mum-mum biscuits, and the big pieces immediately get caught in the back of the throat.  I might keep the box around and give them to him when he's much bigger, but then it should be marketed towards toddlers who can eat them safely, definitely not to teething babies.  DANGEROUS!

<a href="[...]" target="_blank"></a>My daughter easily broke off a piece and started choking. When the piece fell out I noticed blood on it and some dripping out of the corners of her face! Never again! I'm sticking with "Happy Baby".

column9: Turns into a sticky mess; may be a choking hazard
column10: Let me first say that my daughter loves these from when she was 6 months old.  They are tasty and fun for her to eat; that's not the problem.After having been gummed for only a short time, these biscuits turn into a gluey, sticky mess.  It's amazing how tenaciously the goop sticks to mom, baby, clothes and anything else in the vicinity.  Be ready with several wet naps or a clothing change if you give these as a snack.Second, and more importantly, they are HARD.  When my daughter is 3/4 finished with hers, she stuffs the whole thing in her mouth.  It will not dissolve, and instead becomes a rather large (in my opinion) choking hazard.  I will note that I have never had a choking incident with the product.  However, when I give her these biscuits I monitor her closely and take it away from her when about a quarter of it is left.

My daughter is 10 months old and she almost choked yesterday when trying these cookies. She had been chewing for less than five minutes when a big piece broke and got stuck in her palate. We were able to retrieve it but it was scary and VERY dangerous. The first box I got at Whole Foods contained several cookies that had broken into pieces, I should have known better. Do not use this product if you have a young baby as it is extremely dangerous.

column9: A real review by someone with a real baby...
column10: These barley teething biscuits are very similar to the wheat ones by the same brand. My baby seems to really like them. They're hard enough that they don't break apart or dissolve too fast. I can say that, to me, the wheat are sweeter than the barley. I personally think barley anything tastes absolutely disgusting, but like I said, my baby likes both flavors. At first, I didn't understand why they were wrapped in packs of two, but then I realized that the first one is undoubtedly going straight to the floor, so a replacement is necessary or tears will ensue. Great product, good price, organic! So no worries.

OK THIS might sound even more lame...we got these for our 12 year old Siberian.  She lost a few teeth this year and has always loved a crunchy bone after every meal...we just couldn't give her those colored, fake bacon, clay looking dog treats that seem to be the only soft dog treats out there.  We were giving her no salt soda crackers but she decided she didn't like those.  So, we decided if babies with no teeth could eat these, our Husky with some teeth might be able to crunch her way through them and...she loves them!  She can crunch to her hearts content without hurting her gums.  And, the sodium content is so much lower than even the salt free soda crackers!
These biscuts are not safe.  My 11 month old was able to break off a huge piece and started choking on it.  Thankfully we were able to get it out in time.  Not worth the risk.  Do not use these.

I gave one of these to my 1-year old who only has 2 teeth but is teething like crazy. Less than 2 minutes later a piece over an inch long broke off in her mouth. I pulled it out and she was fine, but I didn't expect it to break that easily. She obviously loved the taste and feel because she grabbed the rest and started in again. They are incredibly messy but seem to serve their purpose. Definitely don't give these unsupervised, though.

I gave one of these to my 9 month old (with 9 teeth albeit!) last night, and he choked!!  Of course I assumed they'd dissolve like other teething biscuits and didn't try it for myself first.  Thankfully I was right there and by the time I had flipped him over and got him in position to try and get it out, he started coughing and crying, but I hate to think what could have happened if I couldn't get it out!  If your baby already has teeth and can break pieces off - buyer beware.  I tried it for myself afterwards and these do not dissolve very well.  It took a while for me to dissolve it. I agree with a previous reviewer, all it's going to take is one death, and these will be pulled off the shelf.  Thankfully my baby wasn't that statistic last night, but very well could have been.

A piece of this biscuit broke off and got stuck to the roof of my 6 month old grandson's mouth. He was gaging, but I couldn't feel anything in his mouth.  It was terrifying! I finally swept my finger aggressivley in his mouth and found it stuck to the roof of his mouth. This product should be taken off the market.

These are the worst teething biscuits that I have bought! Huge chunks break off, unlike other, better quality biscuits you can find, like Gerber. Even for kids who are bigger and can chew stuff up better, the pieces are still too large to be trusted at all. Do not trust at all.
My daughter loves these. I tried them also. Yummy. We just watch her carefully with that last bite. Hope this helps.

column9: Choking hazard, better for toddlers with molars
column10: I agree with all of the previous reviewers - these biscuits are dangerous for babies and even young toddlers who are unable to chew well.  My son broke one of these biscuits in his mouth when he was very close to one year old and had quite a few teeth.  Fortunately, I was able to remove the broken piece from his mouth.  I was still pretty frightened by the incident.  He is now 15 months old and has 15 teeth, including all of his molars, and I finally feel better about giving him these.  I still supervise him, though.  These are convenient when out and my son, a very picky eater, likes them.
Be very careful when feeding these to your baby.  The biscuit falls apart really easily and becomes a  choking hazard!

column9: Turns into cement and choking hazard
column10: At first we thought these were great because they took a while for our son to get through, but the mess that is left on his hands, face, high chair and clothes hardens and is impossible to get off without major scrubbing.Due to the size he also shoves the entire cracker in his mouth and at times chokes on it..After a few we threw the box away.

I've been giving these to my 8 month old off and on for a few weeks.  They're ok.  We haven't had any choking incidents.  She sucks on them and they spread goo everywhere, but that's the tale of all teething cookies.  Their texture reminds me of dog biscuits.  Very dense.  They taste a lot like graham crackers.  I bought them because barley sounded healthier than rice and we've enjoyed the jars of Earth's Best baby food.  They last a long time.  The box is still more than half full.  She likes the Mum Mum rice rusks better and those are what I'll be buying in the future.

We purchased these for our teething 6 month old.  She really enjoyed it for about a minute before a piece broke off and she started choking on it.  We had to flip her upside down and pat her on her back to dislodge it from her throat.  The title of teething biscuits is a bit misleading, they should really just sell them as biscuits for children who are already eating solids.

column9: Tasty snack that sooths baby's gums
column10: Our 9 1/2-month old daughter LOVES these teething biscuits! We initially tried them upon recommendation from another Mom in our Mommy & Me group.  The biscuits can be rather messy as they disintegrate but part of this may be due to the fact that our daughter only had one tooth at the time we introduced these teething biscuits; she does not seem to get quite as messy now that she has a couple of teeth. My husband and I try out everything that the baby eats and we found these to be pretty tasty - not quite as sweet as a graham cracker (she loves these, too) but not too "wheaty." We keep packs of the biscuits in the cars, diaper bags, stroller caddys, my purse, etc.  They are often a lifesaver when we are out and about, running errands or out to dinner! They make the baby's gums feel better, keep her preoccupied and are tasty snacks.

This is the frst time I bought this biscuit for my 9.5 mo baby. The biscuit is hard n it broke off to smaller pieces inside her mouth but it didnt melt like those Gerber food. My baby's face then turned red.. She almost choked but luckily she swallowed it I guess but it scared me ..I wont but this again,

column9: COULD BREAK INTO PIECES --> CHOKING HAZARD !!
column10: Other 1* or 2* reviews are correct.  This products is a choking hazard itself.These biscuits shouldn't even be given to babies.  My nephew is 9 months old and according to the description should be able to try these biscuits.  He is starting to grab stuff and eat more solid foods.My nephew had one and the biscuit broke off.  Lucky he was able to cough it out himself.  NOT recommended for babies.I don't understand why it would even be approved to be on the market for babies.  It's more like an adult biscuit.
how can u say its not safe??????its great because they are hard,my son chews on them,they melt,yeah messy but...u put a bib on .it works for us

column9: Baby loves them, keeps him busy too.
column10: My baby has been eating these since he was about 7-8 months old. Being a first time mom I was very paranoid about him choking on them at first but I have never had a problem. He is a year old now and they've been a daily snack for him. He will sometimes cough a little but he does that when he is drinking formula or juice. I admit, even I inhale my food/drinks once in a while. =P They are messy and will leave an icky film all over baby's face/hands but he loves them and it keeps him occupied for quite a while. The only problem is, I have to watch my dog very carefully to make sure she doesn't steal them from him. I highly recommend them.

I typically love Earth's Best products, but these are dangerous and a serious choking hazard.  They break off into large pieces and can't be chewed easily.  They are very hard!  I knew something wasn't quite right when the plastic packaging that houses the biscuits has "use only with adult supervision" all over it.  Well, yes, of course we would only use them with supervision, but I shouldn't have to expect to scoop them out of my son's mouth to prevent him from choking.  My husband will eat the rest as a snack and we will never purchase them again.

We've tried the wheat and barley versions, and our son likes both.  We haven't had any issues with pieces breaking off, like we did with the Gerber ones.  They dissolve and get a layer of goop on everything, but it's not the end of the world.  They take a long time to eat because they are dissolving not being chewed so that's a plus.  We normally give him one cracker instead of the 2 in the pack.

I tried this for the first time today with my 8.5 month old grandson and within one minute a piece about the size of a half dollar broke off in his mouth and became lodged in his throat.  He started turning off color and couldn't breath.  I lifted him out of his high chair hoping that might dislodge the piece but it did not.  I then tried the modified heimlich for babies twice and it didn't work.  Finally, I put my finger in his mouth and had to go all the way to his throat to reach and grab the piece he was choking on.  Thankfully that worked, but I still am freaked out - more than 8 hours later.  My grandson means the world to me and I can't imagine anything bad happening to him.  Don't buy these biscuits, don't use these biscuits.

My son has been eating these since he was 7.5 months old and had 8 teeth (he is 11 months now). He absolutely loves them! I love that they are organic (obviously) and that they come in packs of 2. I never leave the house without throwing a pack in our backpack - they've saved me from many meltdowns!Could they pose a choking hazard? Yes. But I have never had an issue and he eats at least 3 of these a week. As with any snack, you have to watch your baby like a hawk. Mine has not choked once.
These are not as hard as the wheat version (wheat version is a better starter biscuit).  These crumble nicely in their mouths and my daughter loves it!

column9: very brittle, breaks much too easily, choking hazard
column10: I was definately expecting a better product from earth's best. However, these biscuits were not good at all. My son who only has 2 teeth broke these very easily. I will not be buying them again.
The price for these are great considering what they go for at the grocery store.  Plus, they are organic which is best for baby.  If your baby likes these, then you can save money this way!
As with any teething biscuit you need to have a bib on because they can get messy. My daughter loves these and I feel good about feeding them to her.

These teething biscuits are supposed to be hard enough for baby to gnaw on and not have it break off into pieces. About a couple minutes after my son sucks on the biscuit, it softens, and he's able to break off very large pieces into his mouth. Luckily, I was right there watching and was able to retrieve the huge chunk out of his mouth. This is just not safe. I do not recommend these teething biscuits.

Let me first address the low reviews found here: Please disregard any low review on here that points to the fact that their kid wasn't ready for it. Each child is unique and just because the package states that a certain age is appropriate, it is just an aggregate suggestion and still leaves the determination up to the responsible parent to supervise and make an informed decision as to if their child is ready to consume the product. Just because their are parents who threw these at their kids and had a bad experience, doesn't mean this product is lacking, just the parenting skills.THE PRODUCT: Earth's Best is a brand I love, they use all organic, non-genetically modified foods without any fillers, or artificial nonsense. This teething biscuit is awesome. It is a 3 inch long by 1 inch wide biscuit. This is not a cracker like Ritz or Graham because it is firmer and doesn't crumble all over the place leaving a mess when the kid crushes it in their hands. This biscuit encourages the child to 'teeth' it until it is soft. We began giving these to our daughter at round 7-8 months with proper, responsible supervision and they worked great for her early teething requirements. So much so that we used Amazon's subscribe and save feature.I highly recommend this product and hope you consider the reviews for what they are saying; are they critiquing the mistake they made or reviewing the actual product? Because the product is not the problem, it's the user.

column9: Takes forever to eat & super messy
column10: I laughed my head off because when my twin babies were finished eating these biscuits, they were literally covered from head to toe. My babies take about 30 minutes just to eat one biscuit. Afterward, they would need a bath! I like the fact that it keeps them busy, but boy do I have to pay for it in clean up time. Also, biter biscuits are not for younger babies. Most biter biscuits are for twelve months and older. Before ten months of age, my babies had some trouble with pieces getting broken off into their mouths and choking. Now, they eat these like pros. It takes some experience, time and close supervision. Gerber biter biscuits are less messy because they crumble easier instead of getting sloppy. But, my 10 month olds can eat Gerber BB's in less than five minutes. It keeps them busy while I'm making their food, which is a big plus.

column9: Tasty, but too dangerous for teething
column10: While these little biscuits are quite tasty and my 9 month old LOVED the first one I gave her, it will be some time before she gets another one.  Within a minute or two the biscuit had broken into pieces just the right size for her to choke on.  These are not the sort of teething biscuits I was looking for.

column9: Biscuit broke very soon after chewing on it
column10: My son is 5 months old and teething (no teeth yet). The first and second time we gave him these biscuits, they broke into several pieces within about 20 minutes, one time leaving a big chokeable piece in his mouth. I think they are too thin and not sturdy enough to be used for gumming/sucking.

My 10 month old has two teeth coming in on top and three on the bottom. He eats cheerios, gerber puffs, soft cooked vegetables and ripe fruit with very little problem. I tried the Earth's Best barley biscuits because he is prone to food allergies and I wanted to avoid wheat. Every time I gave him one of these biscuits (3 times) he was able to bite off too big a piece and gagged, not to the point of actually choking, but enough to send me into a panic watching him struggle and turn red. They don't seem to dissolve in his mouth fast enough. On the upside they taste good without being overly sweet. I think they are better suited for a little older babies who have more teeth and have really mastered chewing. I will try the Mum Mum rusks as a previous review suggested.

column9: Excited to finally have teething biscuits!
column10: I am a new mom of my 7 month old son with a new one on the way.  My little guy has been teething for 2 months now and needing something to chew on that will teach me to eat "big people food" and also subside the pain the teething is causing.  My mom used these teething biscuits with my brothers and highly recommended them, I was very excited to get them.  At first my little guy wasn't quite sure what to do, but after a few minutes he learned not to bite off pieces but rather to gum it and enjoyed it for a good 20 to 30 minutes!  However, since they say "9 months and older" I kept a good eye on him to make sure nothing bad happened.

column4: Kevin Watt "I know that poetry is indispensab...
column9: these are great, all food should be supervised when < 1 yr
column10: These worked great for us.  When your kid is just learning to eat, you should always be supervising!  Food is kinda dangerous :  That said, babies are very good at choking stuff back up.  My doctor mentioned not to confuse "can't breathe" choking with "too much food at once" choking.  The 2nd 99.9% is fine they'll choke it back up.  The 1st you worry most about wind-pipe sized things like whole peanuts, marbles, grapes, tomatoes, etc.If he's fussy, we give out baby one of these and it makes him happy long enough so we can change him & cheer him up other ways.

We gave this to our 9 month old and it broke off in her mouth as other reviewers had mentioned.  Now that she is a year old she is able to eat them without a problem.  I would suggest waiting until your child has been eating finger foods long enough that they can comfortably handle these biscuits.  Once they have reached that stage, the biscuits are great.  My 4 year old loves them too!

I bought these for my baby after standing in the snack aisle for 20 minutes reading labels. They seemed to have the most real ingredients despite the addition of "evaporated cane juice". When I first got them, she was about 7 months old and had just started solids. I broke them into small bite sized pieces (which was very messy) and she didn't seem to go for them much. Now, she's 10 months and we have started introducing a couple snacks after naps and desperate for a little variety, I broke these out again. I still break the pieces up because we like to "donate" to the dog and I really don't want to waste them. So, I break them into about 6 pieces and she has enough to hold and can bite off little pieces or suck on the end until it's small enough to pop into her mouth. In regards to the other parents talking about choking hazards, I'm not sure how that would happen unless the crumbs got caught in their throat. Or, if the baby took a huge bite and tried to swallow it whole. I would recommend introducing these in small bites until the child is used to the texture.

Please be very careful of this buscuit, it is too thin, a baby biscuit is supposed to be hard and melt upon contact and not be breaking off in chunks enough to choke the baby. Just the thin look was scary to me and was later confirmed.Looks more suitable to a toddler.

column9: Great Ingredients, Super Messy, and Easy to Choke On
column10: I really, really wanted these to work. They have fantastic ingredients, they taste great, and they're hard... to start off with. Once my 9 month old baby starts chewing on these, they get soft, squishy, and on every single thing they get near. They're perfect if your kid is in a high chair with a bib and can have a bath afterward. The other downside is that they do break off in big chunks and it's easy for the baby to bite off more than he can handle. I'll keep using these when my son is a little older because I think they're probably better suited for an older baby who is teething, rather than someone under a year.

The first time I gave one of these to my 10 month old, she was already eating cheerios, graham crackers and rice rusks.  The crumbs got everywhere. She was able to bite off such a large chunk of the biscuit that I had to sweep it out of her mouth because she had difficulty chewing it and it did not seem to be breaking up or dissolving like the rice rusks.  I continued to let her have the rest of the biscuit and the same thing happened again.  I finally had to throw out the biscuit.  I should have thrown out the whole box.  A few weeks later our nanny gave her one of these under supervision while she was in her high chair.  It broke off into a couple pieces, one of which got lodged in her throat.  She went from coughing to gagging and not breathing as her panicked face turned from scarlet to purple.  Fortunately, the piece dislodged itself before our nanny had to do any back blows or CPR. We stopped buying the rice rusks because of all the bad stuff that's been doing on with food products from China, but we'll be going back to the baby mum mums.

column9: This product is a choking hazard!
column10: I chose these as a substitute for zwieback toast, which has apparently been discontinued.  Gerber makes a very similar teething biscuit, but after comparing both, I found Earth's Best to be much healthier.  My son LOVES these biscuits, but I will be throwing the rest of them away.  For the second time today, he broke off a piece larger than a quarter after sucking on the biscuit for only about a minute.  My son is eleven months old and does great with chunky food, but there is no way he would be able to chew these hard biscuits with his gums.  I am thankful that I do watch him like a hawk when he eats anything, because this product is dangerous!  I will not let my son have these again.

This is more useful as a dog biscuit. It is very hard, which ok, if it stays in one piece it's good for teething. But as many other reviews say, when they suck and gnaw on it, it becomes soft enough that VERY large pieces break off and remain in their mouth. And these big pieces, once in their mouth is still hard enough that there's no way they can chew with their gums only. Just eat one yourself. This is just downright dangerous. Why would you anyone create a product like this for kids??? If you bought this, please just eat these yourself and not give it to your kids.

These biscuits are very healthy, but break very easy. My seven month old only has one tooth, and within two minutes of her chewing on these they break! Major choking hazard! I would NOT recommend these biscuits.I love all of the other Earth's Best products though...
This is only 1.54 in Target, are you kidding me? Twenty some dollars for the teething biscuits, am I buying gold biscuit.

column4: Just a Mom with her thoughts
column9: Absolutely wonderful, but a bit pricey
column10: When I opened the cookie tin, the sweet smell sent my senses into overdrive.I ate one on the spot.And then I ate another.David's Cookies sent my taste buds on an adventure. The delicious flavors included in the cookie tin were Chocolate Chunk, Peanut Butter, Oatmeal Raisin, Macadamia White Chip, and Double Chocolate Chunk. I was taken back to the days of eating my grandmother's homemade cookies. My favorites have to be Macadamia White Chip and Peanut Butter, although all of the cookies are wonderfully yummy.The only downside to David's Cookies is that they are somewhat expensive.

For years we have used Boboli pizza crust and enjoyed it very much.  But...after it was taken off the market for a period of time a few months ago, it has been put back on the shelves and since then it has been totally tasteless.........nothing like it used to be.  Don't know what the previous problem was, but we have probably purchased our last Boboli pizza crust.  We were asked to rate the product and do not feel it even qualifies as a "1".  Please bring back the previous recipe or explain the reason for changing it.

column9: Used to be good, now it's just awful
column10: My wife and I started a tradition years ago where we would make Boboli pizza's and rent a movie every weekend.  The boboli crusts that used to be so good have progressively become worse and worse the last couple of years.  What used to be a thick but light crust with lots of cheese on it has become a blob of almost uncooked dough with only a couple specks of cheese.  They seem to keep changing the recipe and each time it gets worse.  It's definitely time for a new tradition!!!

column9: Just Bad -  Not One Redeeming Quality
column10: I was a kid when Boboli was first introduced (at least to the local market). Yet somehow decades passed and I never tried them. So this weekend when I had some leftover cheese and sauce from a pasta dinner, and saw these in the market, I thought, "perfect".The experience was anything but.I don't know what these are supposed to taste like, but I found them to be just awful. Once cooked, they're thick and doughy. Nothing at all like actual pizza crust. Not NY Style, Chicago style or California. Worse still, they have this god awful rancid oil taste. Like used, dirty oil from a cheap take out place.Needless to say, I will not be using the 2nd one that came in the package. Nor will I be purchasing these again.

I hadn't cooked with hominy before but wanted to give it a try. Considering that this is just lime-treated corn, it's hard to believe the nutrition label on the back. Per serving (1/2 cup, 245g) there is:Calories: 60Fat: 0.5gCarb: 10gFiber: 6gSugar: 4gProtein: 2gThis product is incredibly low in carbohydrates and very high in fiber. But even more promising than the nutrition facts is the taste. I recently used this in a "Peanut Butter Chili" along with 15 other ingredients and the hominy was my favorite part. Once cooked, the hominy has a wonderful texture and consistency, better than any bean or corn I've had. I highly recommend this product.

column9: Best pasta company, so good I mail order it
column10: This company has a proprietary way of making pastas with a high whole wheat content. Their products don't have a mealy consistency, go mushy, or fall apart with extended cooking, like when used in soups or stews. Their 100% whole wheat products are the only true whole wheat pasta worth buying. Ask the PBS TV show "America's Test Kitchen" who tested these pastas and ranked them numero uno. No, I don't work for PBS or Bionaturae.

column4: Shira Anthony "Author & Avid Reader of M/M Ro...
column10: I love the chewiness and texture of this pasta.  The bag is HUGE - you will need to put it into smaller containers, but I like buying in bulk.  I like the fact that it is organic, and even better, my kids love the shape and taste, as well.  Great tossed with garlic, cheese and olive oil and also great with red sauce.  I haven't tried baking it, but I'm guessing it would hold up well to baking, too.Great price, great product - but I love all the Bionaturae pastas!

*****Ashby's Japanese Green Tea is a distinctive, strong, great-flavored Japanese tea. Nothing wimpy or mild about it, and I'm glad, because it's so enjoyable. I made a large thermos with one tea bag, left the tea bag in, and drank it for several hours, and it never got bitter. I then made more tea with the same tea bag. The flavor is definitely Asian and I could drink cup after cup. It smells great, too.Ashby's of London writes this about Japanese Green Tea: "From Japan, this pan-fired tea is lightly rolled and dried over a fire in a large flat bottom pan. This tea contains the desirable "Polyphenols" that have been reported to be a cancer fighting substance. It has a very light, fresh taste and produces a transparent greenish colored brew." I agree, but please note that the tea is distinctively flavored, not mild (which I really like) and delivers a wonderful tea experience.I highly recommend it, and if you enjoy Asian teas, or want a true green tea, you'll not go wrong here.*****

These lollipops are so good, very tart, tangy and full of lemon flavor.  I mainly love these pops for what's NOT in them:  all the junk found in other kids candy.  I think $20 for all these lollipops is a great deal..4 big bags.  We love Yummy Earth!
My husband likes strong coffee and so far these are his favorites.  We will definitely be ordering these again for sure.
My sister loved these Barista k-cups. Said they made a very rich cup of coffee and the product was very fresh.

column9: Bought it as a gift for a friend
column10: My coffee-loving friend said all four flavors were good but that the Italian Roast was awesome. I'd already  tried the House Blend before I bought the variety pack and I liked it fine. I just didn't get over to my friend's house in time to try the other flavors before they were all gone!

column9: Love The Coffee and the Variety But Not the Price
column10: You can buy Barista k-cups for $.75/cup (other brands for $.50/cup) so $1/cup is a little steep.  But if you've never tried it, I recommend that you go ahead and splurge on this deal.I like my coffee strong so I even enjoy the really stout Barista French Roast.  I save the smoother House Blend and Colombia for my husband.  But, without a doubt, Barista's Italian Roast is my new absolute favorite.Normally I would only drink it on weekends, preferring the formerly less expensive Timothy's Rainforest Espresso for work.  But now that Amazon has discontinued their subscribe and save deal on the Rainforest option, I'll switch to the Barista Italian Roast.

I love this product.  I use it on salads and I don't need any oil to add because it's just the right texture and we go through a lot of it because we love the product so much.  It's hard to find too but thanks to amazon, we found it.

column9: Buyer Beware! Can injure your dog's teeth.
column10: I originally gave this item a glowing review--my dog loved it and it seemed a safe choice for his vigorous chewing. Unfortunately, having just taken my dog to the vet with a cracked tooth that had to be extracted, I must retract my original recommendation. My vet had just seen another dog that same day that also broke a tooth using an antler chew. My vet recommends rope chews as a safer (and softer!) alternative.

My 6 year old daughter loves this apple cinnamon and oatmeal flavor!  It's kinda expensive though, and the bars are the smallest I've seen.  However, at least I can recognize the ingredients, no craziness, only goodness!

OMG.............I odered this salame and got it a few days ago.  It was absolutely wonderful.  It was moist, tasty and just all around perfect!  I ordered two more packages and CAN'T WAIT TO GET THEM!

The Balance Bar Gold Lemon Meringue Crunch bar is a good energy bar. At 28 percent sugar, 14 grams for a 50 gram bar, it is in the lower range of sugar content for energy bars. It is not too sweet.The bar has a nice lemon flavor. To me, it tastes a lot like lemon meringue pie. I suggest that key lime would also make a nice flavor for this kind of bar. As the product description says, "No pie we've ever tried came with the satisfying crunch and nutritional punch delivered by this energy bar." That may be somewhat of an exaggeration, but the bar does taste good and does have a balanced set of natural ingredients.One observation is that each bar weighs in at 200 calories. This makes it good for vigorous exercise, but perhaps too much to take a whole bar for a snack. On the other hand, we have been having snow storms every few days this year. I think that shoveling qualifies as vigorous exercise, so I can eat as many of these bars as I want to without worrying about calories.

This is the first protein bar I have EVER loved, and I've tried many. It's 200 calories with 14 grams of protein, 7 fat grams (4 of them saturated) and 23 grams of carbohydrates.It measures 3-3/4" long by almost 1-1/2" wide by ¾" thick. The thin outer coating is a yogurt lemon blend, then there is a layer about ¼" thick which is soft and creamy, on top of a crunchy layer about ½" thick.The crunchy layer has the most tart lemon taste and this is great since I love a tart lemon flavor - it's tart but not like eating a fresh lemon. Not too sweet, just right, and I haven't noticed an aftertaste as with other meal bars.Since I'm usually a breakfast skipper, I've been eating this for my first meal and this is an easy grab-and-go item. Before trying this bar, I'd cave into getting a candy bar around 10 AM so I could make it to lunchtime. Eating this bar for breakfast is certainly more healthy than grabbing a Snickers bar later on, and this keeps me satisfied until lunch.NOTE: I received this through Amazon Vine as a free item, but I will continue to purchase these.

I received a pound of Buffalo Bill's hickory pieces as a gift, and enjoyed the size of the pieces and the consistency of the beef's tenderness and flavor. The box happened to come with a couple of samples courtesy of Choo Choo snacks, one of which were a few pieces of the maple pepper beef jerky. After finishing the hickory I went ahead and opened up the maple, and ate it all in maybe 30 seconds. This jerky is so unique and borderline mouthwatering, I actually broke down and bought a pound of it. It's just ever so slightly spicy, and the smell and taste of the maple syrup hits you at the start then lingers after you've finished it. I don't profess to be some sort of food critic, but I figured something this tasty deserved a review with a few big words. So if you like eating healthy and are looking for a nice treat, I really recommend this!
The taste is OK. Not too tuff, not too sweet or too hot. It just looks like something I would not eat! I did finish the package but not to sure I will reorder any. Not because of the taste.

This is my second order of bb.jerky and although I didnt like my first order of the big slab jerky,I am glad I tried the premium style jerky,it has good flavor and a tender chew,once again the shipping was very fast,and even though my first order was an expensive lesson, bb.jerky has a good variety of products to choose from,so choose wisely,start small and try them all.

column9: If you like jerky this is it!
column10: This is excellent jerky.  I could eat the whole bag in one setting.  If you have had the good trade show quality jerky and are looking for something like that look no further this is it.  Buy a few bags, kick back, and enjoy your dancing taste buds.....

When I was growing up, one of my favorite meals was a stack of my mom's hot pancakes with lots of maple syrup flowing over them. The Buffalo Bills Premium Maple Pepper Beef Jerky gives me that great maple syrup taste with a twist.  The classic smokey Buffalo Bills Premium jerky paired with the delicious warm sweetness of maple sugar and the robust taste of cracked black pepper all come together to create a wonderful treat. There is a good balance between the maple sugar and black pepper; both are strong flavors but neither overpowers the taste of this jerky. The size of the Maple Pepper Beef Jerky pieces make it easy to enjoy this treat any time. I'm glad the people at Choo Choo R Snacks are quick with the shipping; they make it so easy to enjoy my favorite jerky.
This jerky piqued my interest.  Maple pepper? I had to try it and it did not disappoint.  Good flavor and texture neither the pepper or the maple overpowers this jerky.  The shipping was fast too.

column9: best jerky i have ever put in my mouth
column10: i just wanna say that buffalo bills jerky is the best jerky i have ever eaten in my life and i have eaten alot of jerky moist tender great taste i will be ordering more asap
This jerky tasted bland and like it was 10 years old. I tried to eat it but could'nt stomach it. I guess I'll leave it for emergencies. Even the dogs  did'nt want itDarl Shipley

Purchased this product; received it, but it was in a large ziploc bag, taped on sides, and the black pour spout was missing.  I contacted customer service via email and was told (after several emails back and forth) that a replacement product would be sent (even though I just wanted the cap as this is not a standard size bottle) and yet still have not received anything from them.  Am just disappointed that my request has been ignored and that they do not take my request seriously.

I saw this at my grocery store and thought...hmm...bbq, szechuan???How bad can it possibly be?I got home, opened it up and was immediately hit by the pleasant smell.I put a little on a spoon and oh boy was I hooked.Hot, sweet, spicy.This has to be one of the best sauces ever invented bar none.Simply awesome on chicken, burgers or as a dipping sauce for chips.Incredible.Highly recommended.
This tea is a number one with my family and customers. Glenburn Coffee House in Midway BC Canada thinks this is a great tea for tea lovers like myself.

column9: beware if you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant
column10: I like the flavor of this African Nectar tea, which is why I was drinking to relax during the "two week wait" of my IVF cycle. I did not know at the time that hibiscus and marigold should both be avoided during the first trimester of pregnancy because they can cause implantation problems and miscarriage.If you are pregnant, or trying to become pregnant, you may want to avoid this tea due to the hibiscus and the marigold.
I love the little bags the tea comes in and it's nice how they're each individually sealed.  And the taste.. what's not to love?! SOOOOO tasty!
Considering it was made out of potatoes....I don't get it, but I tried. Not my cup of tea, may work for other people.

Reviewed by a true-blue Singaporean living in the US, this is a must have treat for those who miss the authentic flavors of south east asia! Tried the other more "inexpensive" version by Asian Home Gourmet but it was no comparison. The Prima Taste laksa broth is definitely alot more authentic and taste just like the morning/lunch hawker fare in Singapore...."Sedap!"(YUM) AMAZING and pretty simple to prepare - won't go wrong with this! THANKS PRIMA & AMAZON for offering this!

Awesome quick fix for curry craving.  Instant laksa curry is hard to find, let alone this is more of a restaurant brand, not a typical store-brand that you can find in Asian market for curry mixes. I've searched high & low in Northern-Cal to no avail, jumping with joy that Amazon carries it now,Follow the instructions, and add some seafood of your choice, fried tofu, sprouts, rice noodle, and whatnot, then you will have a satisfying treat.  Give it a try, a good chance you would like it if you dig creamy broth, and South Asian food.Oh, don't forget to add finely minced Vietnamese mint if you can get some, or even Thai basil. For fresh herbs enhance the flavor; eat like the locals.  5 big, enthusiastic stars!

column9: Authentic and so easy to make
column10: Easiest to make laksa. Combine provided 2 packets of mixes with water in the pot, boil, and the laksa gravy is ready. Definitely has the distinct laksa flavor - not like Katong laksa, nor is it like a real heavy hawker style kind of laksa but to me, it is authentic enough, and it does not have msg. I would say one box is enough for maybe 3 servings. The one sold here shows "two chillies" - spicy level, to me, is not mild, not too spicy, like a medium high. I used organic spaghetti, mung bean sprouts and hard boiled egg with it - yes, I am subscribing to it now. My friend introduced me to it. I would like to taste other Prima products now. This Prima laksa satisfies all laksa cravings until hubby and I get back to Singapore!

I loved the Prima Taste Rendang and set about ordering everything they make, that's available on Amazon. I LOVE curry, love coconut, and the other reviews of this product sold me on ordering it. Even though I had to order four boxes, I thought it was worth the gamble.I hate to even say this, but I didn't like it at all. When I opened the paste, it smelled like the fish food I used to give my fish. (Suppose it's shrimp paste making that smell) Normally I am ok with shrimp paste. But as I cooked the food, the smell .. reminiscent of bait buckets...started to make me gag. I even tried a tiny bite of the finished product but couldn't go any further with it.I don't know if this is authentic or not, I normally love thai food, curry, anything of that nature! But this, I couldn't stomach it. My husband said it was ok, a little spicy for him. I couldn't even sit at the table with him because the smell was repulsing me.If you like a strong shrimp paste flavor, you'll probably love this! I think anyone who loves seafood and soup would like this. (It's very soupy) I've liked almost all other Prima products, but I just couldn't stomach this one.

I first tasted this at a food show and wanted to try it home with my friends. The process was pretty simple. Boil water and add the packets provided. All I really had to do was add the vegetables, and VOILA! Dinner for 5! I'm glad I was able to find this product on Amazon.
I found this to be a bit too fishy to serve alone over noodles like typical Laksa. Maybe I just forgot what it was supposed to taste like..

My Southeast Asian colleague tells me this is the most authentic laksa she's ever had outside the region. The mix is flavorful without being chemical and artificial like many soup powders. Oh, and I had the opportunity to attend a Prima Taste cooking class in Singapore!! They are the real thing.

This SOUP is quite thin, but flavorful. It's meant for seafood: shrimp, fish, or if you want to get exotic, squid, clams, calamari, scallops, abalone or a combination. I suppose you could add bland Asian veggies e.g. soy skin, wood eaves (a type of tree mushroom), other kinds of mushrooms, heart of palm, water chestnuts, maybe even scallions?I serve it over Basmati rice just to make it more substantial. The egg noodles that are recommended, or maybe are traditional, aren't as good (my opinion) as just rice.I would not buy this again only because it's so soupy. I prefer curries that are more substantial.

column9: fish flavor, tastes good, not for me
column10: White guy who is trying different things and likes alot of the asian stuff ive tried before.  i didnt know this would be pretty fishy.  i made mine with shrimp and yellow onions (last minute decision, no green onions).  it was more fishy flavored than i thought it would be.  not too much, but just on the edge of acceptable for me.  this might be how all laksa is but i wasnt a huge fan.  i probably just dont like laksa though.  i like other prima taste products, but i think just not this one.
wife is from singapore... and she swears by these. they are almost like going out to eat at the local hawker stall back home for her. very nice
If you have ever lived in KL, Singapore,or in general just like good Laska...this is it!! Great sauce, easy to make, and great price.

I love this candy! It has a pleasant, mildly sweet (rice flour) taste and the texture is similar to a powdered, soft gummy bear. The melon flavor is mild and sweet (not sour). This candy may be an acquired taste for someone who is accostumed to mainstream, super-sweet American candy. The texture may take some getting used to and the taste of rice flour may not appeal to some. All that said, I've been trying to find this candy for several years but because I didn't know the name of it, I've been making-do with my memories. Now that I've found a merchant, I plan on buying a stockpile.

I was unsure about about how this would taste, but I wanted to taste some japanese treats.  I was really suprised at how much I would like these.  They are really good and the melon flavor is fantastic. I also love the paste in the center.  These make a great snack.

I love japanese treats snacks and most things but its problematic  because i absolutely dislike bean paste. I had been trying to find a mochi type of snack with out a red bean paste filling for some time and wandered across this gem. I ordered 1 pack to see how it was and the mochi is as soft and gummy as the day it was made and the filling is just delicious. I will probably proceed to stockpile these and eat them all! please enjoy and try them out.

column4: Daniel Night "Do to others as you would have ...
column10: My honest opinion, beautiful, but strange tasting, and made me feel a little sick. They tasted good enough so that I ate five more quickly after eating the first, and did notice a melon flavor, but it seemed quickly muted by this odd sweet taste that made me feel ill. It wasn't highly unpleasant, but made it taste what I thought was overly candy like and so turned what could have tasted like something pleasant, into a cheap candy taste, that was too strong and so made me feel sick. Also the powdery consistency in the middle I don't think was strong enough, I noticed more of the soft outer covering than the filling, which was more interesting and so wanted to taste that more, but it was so easy to chew that it passed into me fast and was gone in a moment.

I have to say that out of all the flavors that have graced my tongue from Japan, Melon is my favorite. It is such a refreshing flavor and its not too sweet. Daifuku is like a marshmallow stuffed with flavored paste or jelly. It takes a bit to get used to, but once you overcome the different texture its amazing. I prefer my cold so I keep them in the fridge, I also know some Japanese people who keep them in the freezer. I really recommend trying these, I don't think you'll be disappointed.
I didn't like the melon filling. It was a bit too sweet for me combined with the white stuff inside the rice cake. So I ate the rest without the filling. Also the item was different then above image.

I bought these along with another flavor of the same type and it's very good. I'm also not a big fan of anko (sweet bean paste) but the melon jelly inside is very nice!! I will definatly order these again and try the orange flavor as well.

I had browsed this product several times before I finally decided to give it a try, and I'm glad that I did!  This is one of the best treats I have ever tasted!  It has the perfect balance of delicious melon flavor that is not drowned out by an overdose of sugar like most American candies and has a wonderful texture that isn't too sticky.  I had tried Japanese bean cakes with red bean paste before and found them to be OK, but after tasting these treasures, I won't be eating those again!  Veryasia was great to deal with as well--communication from the company and the shipping of the product was very prompt.  I would highly recommend this company and this product.  This delightful candy is one of those rare, not-to-be-missed treats for the tastebuds that everyone should try!

Received the packaged on time as stated. It was a delicious snack or dessert. The melon flavor was very pronounced and the beans inside was a sweet balance to the mochi melon rice that wraps it. I will definitely purchase this flavor and brand again.

I've tried a variety of Daifuku and Melon is the only flavor I love. The Rice cake is mildly sweet with a thick jelly like texture you can squeeze in your hands with a light corn starch coating so it won't stick everywhere. The Melon filling is sweet with a light melon flavor sort of like gum that you can't chew. I don't know if I'm turning you on or off to the product but it's very delicious and sometimes I like to eat the filling separate from the cake. They are both quite good on their own and neither overpowers the other in flavor.

This was mine and my husband's first time trying daifuku. After reading the reviews I still wasn't quite sure what to expect. We both fell in love with the unique texture and taste of these. I wish there were more in the package for less because we couldn't get enough of them! They are very tender and the melon filling is sweet deliciousness!

These are the best things on the planet! Those people that had a one star review are crazy because this Japanese treat is simply delicious! They are extremely soft when you bite into them and they are not too sweet. What a great find!
Tastes like melon, very soft and chewy and fresh-tasting!Everyone who tried it loved it!Thank you!  Will buy again!

These are very delicious little Desserts with a gooey melon center and a great alternative to average high fat cakes. The texture at first may seem a bit odd to many, but the taste is wonderful. It's a very clean, natural taste and I highly recommend them. But you only get eight cakes, and you will be wishing for more when you have finished with them. So I suggest you buy at least two or three packs at a time.

My friend is really into different asian foods and I am getting more and more into them so I figured that I would try this mochi. It ended up tasting really good. It's not like other mochis that I have tried. It's sweeter for starters and has mellon filling inside. Around the filling there is something that seems to be a marshmallow thin layer and then the outside rice ball layer. This mochi though is not like normal asian mochi so be for-warned if you like mochi to be semi-sweet this might not be for you. But if you like other asian mellon candy I think that you will like this. The color is also brighter that the photo shown.
this a melon flavor but its tast more like green apple or something i love the texture except the filling because its like a powdery past and these are very satisfying i only wanted one <3
IT'S LIKE EATING A CLOUD...that's the response I always get when I serve a friend one of these. They are unusual and delightful, not too sweet, just perfect!

These Japanese pastries are very soft gel like candies with melon flavored filling that tastes just like watermelon gum. It's not as sweet as American candy and honestly, it's perfect. Especially if you want to keep your sugar intake low. It's a very light and healthy treat, but becareful! These things are addicting!
My friend bought a bunch of this stuff at a anime con and it was amazing!!!!!:)It was this exact brand as well... I havent ordered any yet but I will soon!!!!!

Knowing me and wanting to try foods from different countries, I thought I'd try this...and let me say: I LOVE it!Melon is probably one of my favorite flavors and the paste inside was just great! Though for me it was a bit too addicting, so it was hard for me to leave more for later.I also shared some with my brother and he with his children, they loved it as well thinking it was kind of like a gummy treat.I DEFINATELY will buy again! <3
I get these quite often and I love the way they taste. The people that sell them are awesome; my packages arrive, on average, about 3 days after I order them.

I've had daifuku once before and since then have been searching for it. I could only find it here and I am soooo glad I finally got to taste it again. I hope to be able to purchase more Asian snacks in the future.^_^

column9: Not as I thought, but still great
column10: Ever since I have seen these here on Amazon I have always wanted to try them. It took a while, but I bought some. They came earier than expected, but all the same I was still pretty excited. Being into Japanese culture and all.I was a little surprised when I had my first bite. I did not expect the texture to be like that. But I loved it all the same. Its nice and soft, almost like biting into a marshmallow. It's really nice, and sweet too. Not way too sweet like most American candy. To me the sweetness level is perfect.So I believe its a nice treat to have once in a while. Even nicer is that the eight pieces could last longer than other snacks since just one if good enough for a few hours. [At least for it is like that]Anyway I'll be sure to order more in the future.
I wasn't sure about ordering this product or similar products, but did take a chance on this one, and was not disappointed! I will be ordering this product again.Freda J.

column9: Not suitable for vegetarians; taste is reportedly good
column10: My friend tried these and said they taste very good; the taste is similar to honeydew melon. I, however, couldn't eat them because they contain gelatin. I was really disappointed about that, and I wish they had listed the ingredients in the product description. Most other mochi do not contain gelatin, so it was really unexpected.

column9: If you are looking for authentic asian snacks...
column10: If you are looking for authentic asian snacks, then you will be very disappointed. This thing just tastes so bad. The color of these Daifuku looks quite disgusting as they have some kind of glowing green color, which looks very different from the picture they have it up there. After the first bite, I threw the whole pack into trash can. Yar, it is that bad.I don't know why it has such high ratings among other reviewers. I guess it is either those people have been eating really bad snacks or my pack just got spoiled during the shipment. Either way, I personally don't like this product at all.

This does not taste anything close to the rice cakes I have had from asian stores. The melon taste does not do any justice to this in my view.It's more like a gummy bear candy than rice cake. For some people this might taste good, but not to me.

First time purchaser from Marky's.  The caviar we had ordered was not a winner but this was!  Completely ready to cook - husband pan seared in small portions and it had great flavor and was incredible!  Arrived fresh and kept well.  I strongly recommend this product and we will be ordering this foie gras again!

Had a small problem at the time of delivery that Marky's fixed immediately. Made a torchon and all the guests raved about how delicious and fresh it tasted. I even prefer it to the Hudson Valley foie we purchased last year.

Illy issimo caffè Italian espresso style coffee drink is a 6.8 fl. oz. (200 ml) blast of sweetened caffeine in a can.1930s Italy under the rule of Mussolini greatly contributed to the development of modern coffee culture, improved coffee-making, and new types of coffee-making equipment. The Horn of Africa (where coffee originated) was under Italian colonization and companies such as illy and Bialetti were founded.In that tradition, this drink is now made in Denmark under the issimo brand from illy and distributed in the U.S. by Coca-Cola.This canned cappuccino has a slightly bitter dark roast coffee taste with the right amount of sugar and a pleasant mouthfeel. It's not as good as freshly made espresso but it's not bad at all. I do prefer the illy issimo cappucino as a treat.
I love them, they are very healthy crispy as can be go great w/ any type of butters or cheeses, or just eat plain.

column9: Bigelow French Vanilla Tea - I might be addicted
column10: I hope there's nothing too pernicious in this tea because I drink one cup a day during the weekdays and three cups on Saturday, Sunday and bank holidays.These are big cups so I add another bag of plain black tea to slightly cut the vanilla flavour and make the drink stronger.  Right now this is Saturday morning and I'm on my second cup.I tried Bigelow's other flavoured teas and thought they were undrinkable - I was acutely conscious of consuming some kind of artificial additive.  I am with this tea also, which accounts for my first sentence.

I love, love, love this tea!  I drink it all the time, every day.  I am a tea drinker, no coffee, and this is the tea I drink 98% of the time.  I enjoy it morning till evening.  I even carry several bags with me in case we are out at a restaurant, I order "hot tea, hold the bag!" or if I go visiting, I use my own bags.We have two cases (of 6 boxes) delivered every month on the Auto Ship program.  This way is less expensive, and so convenient.  We stay one order ahead as a couple of years ago, Bigelow had a supply problem.I use a Russell Hobbs Tea Kettle with warming tray, so my water heats up to the correct temperature, brews in a separate glass pot and stays on a warming tray.  I have a pot on all day long.  I do love my tea.  I love that Amazon ships directly to my home.
Not available in stores!  Great way to get the product I love and miss so much!! If its hard to find look on Amazon!!!!

column9: Delicious tea! One of my 3 always in stock.
column10: I am never with Darjeeling, Chamomille and Bigelow's French Vanilla tea. Having a choice of 3 in a tea canister is a real treat at the end of the day. I lived in England when I was a girl and I've always had my tea time. The French Vanilla is excellent with a little bit of Half and Half cream. If you haven't tried this, you must!
Most Vanilla teas taste like perfume--this doesn't.  It isn't artificial at all!  I have tried umpteen vanilla teas in all price ranges and this tastes the best and is good price too!

My favorite afternoon and evening tea is Bigelow French Vanilla Tea - it is sweet, gentle not sharp, not overly sweet, very flavorable.  My grocery store stopped carrying it, but Amazon always has it, so I can buy a lot because it comes as a pack of 6 boxes. Yeah!

column9: French Vanilla tea hard to find in stores but still delicious
column10: Bigelow French Vanilla Tea and similar product by Lipton are almost impossible to find in Texas stores and in many other states surveyed on driving trips.Amazon has an inexpensive way to obtain this product on a regular basis in packages of six boxes of  20 individually wrapped tea bags.I have recently scheduled a shipment to automatically appear every six months.Great service and great tea at a very good price.Thanks Amazon

I love tea, went out on a limb, bought a box of this and the Vanilla Almond. I fell in love with the French Vanilla, but I had to give the Vanilla Almond away, it's a very weird taste.The flavor is full, rich, and amazing. I overkill my tea, I make it with 2 tea bags in a 20 ounce cup, lasts me about an hour.The French Vanilla Decaf is sort of weak though, I thought it would have the same full taste but it doesn't.
Excellent buy!  Much cheaper than I can purchase in the store.  A very flavorful tea.  The aroma of the tea has many people at work asking me what I am drinking.
This is a soothing tea. The taste is mild and satisfying. The best I have tasted in this flavor.

Bigelow French Vanilla Tea is my favorite breakfast tea....can't start my day without it.  Sadly, it has been disappearing from my local grocers' shelves and I can only find it in one specialty store.  Specialty stores have special high prices & several yummy, unhealthy temptations that I try to stay away from.  I turned to Amazon, and there was my tea.  I signed up to get six boxes delivered to my door every 3 months.  This convenient service costs me just a little over half what I was paying at the specialty store.  There was a mix up with my first order that caused me to receive 2 shipments at once, but I have been assured that this has been sorted out.I would highly recommend this tea to any tea drinker.  The vanilla flavoring can't be missed, but is not so strong that it overpowers the tea.  This tea has never tasted bitter or "strong enough to trot a mouse" even when I go over the brew time.  Always delivers a smooth flavorful cuppa. It's not an exotic, upmarket tea, but if you are looking for a good, smooth tasting everyday cup of tea, give this one a try.  I give the tea 5 stars and the convenient Amazon delivery 4 & 1/2 stars that maybe should also be 5 star.  I did get a double order....could have been my human error, or their human error or computer glitch.  Customer service was excellent and the duplicate was returned at no cost to myself.  Overall, I am 5 star happy with both product and Amazon.The Amazon provided price of $14.ish drops to $12.ish when you sign up for the regular scheduled delivery....and free shipping...whatta deal!

This tea has a wonderful vanilla flavor mixed in with Bigelow's fine tea.  I was always able to get it in a couple of local grocery stores.  However, everything on the shelves seems to be green tea, or some spicy Chai tea.  For a tea with a great flavor that even makes great iced tea, you can't go wrong with this one.  It's a winner!

A smooth, delightful vanilla flavor, with a peaceful aroma for an easy morning wakeup. I stumbled upon this tea while on a cruise and could just not get away from it. Since I didn't like a "spiced" tea, this was perfect.
This, of all the vanilla teas I have tried, is by far the best. It's so sweet and the french vanilla is so pronounced. It's a great treat for anytime. Highly recommend!!!

column9: Wish it was cheaper but taste is terrific.
column10: I add these for flavoring to large batches of Luzianne tea. Great flavor and very consistent. The individual packs mean they will be fresh until you use them. Highly recommend.

I have been drinking this tea for over 6 years now. I have tried many other types of tea and brands, but nothing comes close to Bigelow French Vanilla! It's sweet and strong enough you can taste the vanilla in it, but it is still a good black tea. The decafe version is also great!

I like Bigelow teas a great deal.  They typically have rich flavors and it is easy to drink cup after cup.  While not my favorite Bigelow tea, the French Vanilla is robust in its composition.  I only give it four stars because while it is a very drinkable tea, I wouldn't consider this a vanilla tea.  The ingredients include black tea, natural and artificial flavors and I would have anticipated that vanilla be explicitly noted.  It's definitely a good tea, but I wanted something that was more heavily accented with vanilla.

column9: Delicious tea at a theft of a bargain
column10: This tea is great! I have it with a spoon of sugar and a spoon of coffeemate amaretto creamer and it's liquid candy. This is hands down the cheapest and easiest way to buy the stuff too. Go Amazon!
This is the tea I normally drink.  Rather then waiting for it to go on sale in the supermarket, I purchased it through Amazon.  I am now atocked up for quite awhile.

This tea is almost like dessert for me.  The vanilla flavor is really there, but not overwhelming.  It's great in the morning, and I also love to sip it after dinner.  I'm so happy that Amazon came through again, so that I could order multiple boxes at a great price, so I'm never without this great product!

I drink this tea at all different times--breakfast, lunch, and after dinner. The French Vanilla flavor is bold but smooth, and not at all syrupy tasting. No other brand of French Vanilla tea that I have tried equals it for taste. Sometimes I drink it with honey and milk, which is amazing.While I usually don't drink coffee with caffeine in the evening because it keeps me from falling asleep, not so with this tea.If you are looking for a truly delicious French Vanilla flavored tea, look no further. I buy this at my local supermarket, which usually has it in stock, for about the same price as on Amazon, so I don't need to buy six boxes at a time.
This item arrived as ordered. It has become impossible to get it in my area, so I am pleased with the quick delivery and the fact I am never out now!!

This is one of those items that shouldn't be difficult to find but is.  I've started going thru Amazon rather than driving all over town looking for it without success.  My daughter and I love this steeped in hot milk for a latte.

I loved dried apricots but my local market does not always carry them. I decided to order them off the internet. I read all the reviews and compared prices before ordering from Mariani. They came very quickly and in excellent condition. They are moist and sweet even after the bag was left open over night. I will order these again and I recommend this product to other apricot lovers.

I am disappointed in the description of this product on Amazon. But I have to blame myself for the purchase because I could have gone to the Mariani website and seen that they DO NOT call these "Dried Apricots" [http://shop.mariani.com/Mediterranean-Apricots/p/MAR-1140091&c=Mariani@OrchardFruit].The product listing mainline on Amazon is: "Mariani Premium DRIED Ultimate Apricots 48 oz. Resealable Value Bag by Mariani" [caps are mine]. (That line is repeated also in Amazon's "Product Features".) The ONLY place on this product's bag that the words "Dried Apricots" appear is in the INGREDIENT list.The front of the bag says, "Premium - Intense Flavor and Aroma - Ultimate Apricots," and the back of the bag says, "We've taken our most luscious Mediterranean Apricots and infused them with a natural flavor essence to create Mariani Ultimate Apricots". Few of the apricots would qualify as "dry" compared to the dry apricots I've eaten my entire life (a long time) and some of them are almost mushy. When you open the bag it smells a bit like a fruity wine. No, I don't think they have fermented, I just think the odor is that special, ". . . natural flavor essence" that the MANUFACTURER adds to the DRIED APRICOTS!Although I don't like to publish "indelicacies", these are also the first dried fruit (including prunes) that ever gave me the bends from gas. I am not suggesting that will happen to everyone, but after eating some (a reasonable number) of them 2 days in a row and being symptomatic, then eating none and not being symptomatic, then repeating the process, I am a bit beyond buying into the theory of coincidence as a cause.
Tastes like someone dunked them in rose water. Couldn't stand them. I love normal dried apricots, thanks, not this bizarre variant.

I have loved dried apricots all my life and am just thankful that I've lived long enough to enjoy Marianis' "flavor enhanced" apricots. Gooey, sticky and totally addictive! In my experience, that only applies to the 48 oz bag.

I purchased Mariani dates & found them wonderful so I was eager to try their apricots,  I've always loved dried apricots so was disappointed to find these rather flat and tasteless. I don't think I will be buying them again.If anyone has a way to enhance the flavor, I'm open for suggestion.

This product has two markings:1. Gluten Free2. Allergen Information: This product was packed on equipment that also packages products that contain milk, soy, wheat, and tree nuts.Unfortunately, I was so happy to see "gluten free," I failed to read on to see the allergen statement which indicates the exact opposite of "gluten free." I ate these for two days - and paid for it each time - before I realized my mistake in trusting the first indication of "gluten free."If you are allergic to gluten or a celiac, DO NOT consume this product.I am very disappointed when businesses don't take these allergies seriously - in this case, by placing two contradictory statements regarding allergens on their packaging, and, of course, emphasizing the one that increases the appeal of the product to a specific group of people vulnerable to allergic reactions. In particular, reactions due to celiac have permanent effects on people's lives and health, including an increased risk of cancer, and a failure to recognize this is blatantly irresponsible and should be prosecuted.

column9: Gives you smelly farts, worst apricot product ever had
column10: This product can be summed up in one word, GARBAGE. This is not even worthy for compost, because it has been tainted with all sorts of chemicals, preservatives and "natural flavors", whatever the heck that means.The ingredients list is as follows;Dried apricots (from Turkey)Natural FlavorsMedium Chain TriglyceridesSulfur Dioxide = Uncontrollable smelly fartsSodium Bisulfite = Uncontrollable smelly fartsPotassium Sorbate.This is a good product if you're going to shoot a prank video that involves you having to fart really loud and smelly in someones face or something, but other than that I can't think of why you would want to buy this product, in my opinion it is complete waste of money. On the package it is advertised as "premium" and "intense flavor and aroma". Allow me to clarify, if by premium they mean premium tainted apricots then that is spot on, and by intense flavor and aroma what they mean is the smell of sulfur coming off these apricots is so intense you'll be farting every minute for the next 3 hours.Shame on Mariani for wasting so many apricots. Worst apricots ever. I would Strongly NOT recommend this product, buy organic apricots instead.

column9: Knead a little taste of home? Add water and knead in some flour to make it at home.
column10: This is a product from my home town.  Swedish Limpa Rye is a sweet, dense, moist, and dark rye bread.  The color of this bread is lighter than you would expect if you've seen a dark rye, but the richness of flavor (orange and rye) reminds you it's still the rye bread you remember from childhood.  This is a dry mix and makes one loaf.  The crust crisps and the interior is so moist it makes for great toaster bread (slice thick).  Make a grilled cheese with American cheese and be generous with butter.  Delicious!  You do need to knead the bread and must have some flour on hand for the couple of times you have to work the dough.  No stand mixer needed.  Need two loaves?  Buy two bags.  Check out Sturdiwheat's pancake mix and Fish Coating mix.  The original flavors are fantastic.  The pancake mix is hearty with alot of texture from the grains used and so is the coating mix.  We oven-roast potatoes and nearly any other garden vegetable with a quick toss in the coat on an oil-lined baking dish.  We pan-fry fish and chicken in the same coating.  It's sweet, a little peppery, and extremely crunchy.  I buy the coat mix by the dozen.  Each bag of coating makes more than one recipe of fish, chicken, and vegetable.

This mix may very well make delicious bread... I don't know. I thought I was ordering pre-made bread. I read the description a dozen times and nowhere does it say that it is a mix, and currently there is no picture of the item. The same company has other listings for mixes and are stated as such.This was a gift for my sister who has no bread machine, no Kitchen Aid, and now no bread to serve for Thanksgiving.I will update my review if I ever get the chance to prepare the mix.

Discovered this midst the Mayflower Hotel in Seattle. The bartender there is a big fan of the extra horseradish mix and so am I.  As soon as we returned go California we ordered this through Amazon.  Mixed with tomato juice it is far superior to any premixed product.
Very good and fresh.  I was concerned they might be stale.  They were not and very fresh and delicious.  Very satisfied.

column9: Big hit with my college age son & friends
column10: I sent this to my son in college for Halloween and it was a great hit with him and his friends in the dorm!  He said there was a lot of candy!
This provides a good mix of candy at a decent price - it provide variety to the office candy dish, much better than typical hard candy choices.

column9: Stale Candy was Smashed and Difficult to unwrap
column10: When it comes to soft, edible candy it's hard to separate the packaging from the treat itself since we enjoy these sweets with more than our taste buds. I still hesitated to factor the packaging into this review, but ultimately decided that the candy itself wasn't very fresh either. I thought it may have been just a few pieces that were hard/stale, but it's pretty much all of them. I don't know if I received a stroke of bad luck or if the entire supply shipping from Amazon is old. My candy was also severely smashed making the caramel stick to the wrappers. I'm a fairly lazy person so it's a chore to fight with the wrappers to remove them when I want a piece of candy. The cookie part of the Twix were crushed as well and some of the chocolate had that chalky white thing going on.

Not much to say that people don't already know about the candy.So I bought a couple of bags for work.They arrived on time and were in perfect condition (not melted/smashed)The dark chocolate milkyway candy bars weren't the greatest but the rest of the batch were great.

This is by far the best all-purpose seasoning I've ever tried. I use it on everything, its especially perfect as a steak seasoning. Haven't tried it on anything that it hasn't improved - I highly recommend it on corn on the cob with some butter.

column4: Jennifer Trump "A conclusion is what we come ...
column10: Maybe I don't know what these are supposed to be like, so I won't give them a one star, but these were tough - the skin was tough no matter how long I cooked them.  I used them in a cassoulet, and the next time I will go for plain white beans and not bother with white kidney beans.

I agree with another review in that too many biscuits are broken when they arrive at my house. BTW I had the same problem buying them directly at the store.I have fed my dogs these biscuits for about 25 years. The dogs love these biscuits but the real reason I feed them is because they are the hardest biscuits I have been able to find. The dogs take a long time to eat them and have to do a lot of chewing. This cleans their teeth. Since I started feeding these biscuits not one vet has suggested that my dog's teeth needed cleaning. I've probably had 5 or 6 dogs in that time and 5 or 6 vets too. I got the box cheaper than buying equivalent amount of bags even after adding shipping cost. My dog loves this bisquits. Only problem, though it is minor. was that there are more broken pieces than good conditioned bag product. It is understandable but I hope there are less of that.

We particularly like them because they fit perfectly into a medium sized Kong toy - and because they are shaped like a peanut - you can shove them so they get kind of stuck in the Kong and it takes the dog a while to get it out.

I'm very impressed with this product. It tastes like real coffee, but doesn't contain any caffeine! This is the most healthy and delicious coffee replacement I've ever tried. Highly recommended for those trying to cut down on caffeine.

You can just suck on them in that case.

My son has loved this since he was a baby, he loves the satin parts. He is now 20mos and still loves it so much that I had to buy a spare.The only negative is that it says it is "spot" clean only. I'm sorry but who creates something for children that you can't put in the washing machine.
I could not believe how refreshing this olive oil was! I was never a big salad eater until a friend suggested pouring some of this oil on as a dressing. Now I actually don't mind eating salads!!

I ordered this cake directly from FantasiCakes website for a dinner party I was hosting. I pre-ordered it.It arrived fresh and intact. Very good size. My guests loved it. Tastes great. It has a wonderful texture, crispy and a little syrupy outside and soft inside. Served 20. Definitely worth it.Can't wait to try the other ones they have.

Contacted local distributors and got no explanation why.  Have since learned Canada Dry seems to be playing games with the availability of their diet cranberry ginger ale.
