The k-cups didn't seem to have very much coffee in them.  They seemed very light when shaken as compared with the past.  I would also like to note that I have noticed this same problem on quite a few of the k-cups.  Also, they all taste very similar and not a good taste.  I had read that Green Mountain may have taken over some of the k-cup business for Timothy's, Caribou, etc. and maybe they have changed something.  For now, I will buy from BBB when they have a coupon and I can check the freshness code on the package.But, really I have gone back to using a french press which really doesn't take that long to make and has superior flavor.

When I bought this coffee I was skeptical that it would live up to it's Amazon rating. After I tried it, it exceeded my expectations. This coffee is excellent. Not bitter at all. I drink my coffee black which usually allows me to taste the coffee fully without diluting it with cream or sweetening it with sugar. This coffee was not too weak and not too strong to the point it was bitter. It will definitely remind you of an Italian cafe.

Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig is likely my favorite all-around coffee blend. Somewhere between a medium and mild blend, this aromatic coffee is sure to  please the most discriminating of family and friends.
It was OK as a coffee, but not what I was expecting for an Italian Blend (darker, richer, full bodied)
Awesome idea!  Coffee is great and don't have to worry about comparing prices at the local stores...Amazon is always the cheapest and I don't even have to go pick it up!

When I purchased my Keurig coffeemaker I had no idea what coffee to buy.  Especially since there is such a huge selection of coffees to choose from. The saleslady suggested the Timothy's Italian Blend based on what kind and what flavor that I told her I liked. Plus, she really liked it, too. I'm from Louisiana and was a little hesitant to buy it.  Italian coffee.........for a southerner??  Well, I'm so glad I did! This is the smoothest, best tasting coffee I've ever had! No bitterness, just a great cup of coffee!! I even converted my husband over to it. He drank only one brand, one kind of coffee for a number of years. Now, he loves it and won't drink anything else!! I keep it on hand at all times. Try it, you won't be disappointed.

I last bought this in May 2011, for around $26.  I used to get it for around $17 on Subscribe and Save, before Amazon ended that option.  I had to stop buying all my k-cups from amazon, because the big warehouse club has an 80-pack of Donut House and Caribou blend varieties for $33.  I first thought it was just the coffee product that amazon was having pricing issues with, but their prices seem to be inflating across the board, while their competitors are not reflecting the same sort of steep increases.  I've found myself going to v*t*c*st.com for many of the repetitive grocery items that I used to order through amazon.  The main difference I can see is that amazon's competitors don't have to worry about pleasing Wall Street, so their prices are kept more honest.Italian Blend coffee is a decent mild coffee, my wife's favorite.  We'll keep ordering it, but it won't be from amazon.

I have had a Keurig for over a year and have tried many of the different k cups.  So far, this has been the best k-cup.  It isn't too strong and isn't too weak.  It holds its own against the half-n-half that I use with it and makes a consistently good cup of coffee.

This is my favorite k-cup coffee.  Believe me, I have tried them all.  I have purchased 4 Keurig machines in the last year, so you know I use a lot of k-cups.  I try the new ones when they come out, but I keep coming back to this one.  One cup at home, and one cup at work to start my day!Followup:I have just got into the third box of the 4 in this order, and I am having blowouts with the k-cups.  Three in a row this morning.  I finially gave up and had another brand.  I hope this doesn't continue.  I may have to find another favorite!!

As we sample many flavors of k-cups from Amazon.com, a few stand out and Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend stood out. It has a fantastic flavor. Rich and delicious. I recommended it to one of my co-workers and they enjoyed it as well. This will be one of my stock items from now on.

I drink this coffee as my second, third, etc cup of the day.  I usually drink a lighter cup first and then continue with the Italian Blend.  I love this coffee.  It's a little stronger but has no bitter taste and still manages to taste light in my mouth.  I love it.

Have only had the Keurig for about 2 months.  The Timothy's Italian blend was in one of the sample packs.  One cup, and I was hooked.  Usually bold & extra bold are deliciously strong but also have a bite to them that ruins the taste of the coffee for me.  It tastes like the brewed coffee was burned.  The Italian blend has the perfect combo of strength & fullness, without the bite.  It is sooo smooth.  I know that everyone has their own taste in coffee, but to my mind this is "kewl beans" (don't know what that means, but heard it somewhere and it sounds right, lol)  Absolutely delicious.

Timothy's Italian Roast is a very good medium roast coffee.  I found little bitterness or aftertaste with it.  A nice smooth cup of coffee.  So many choices in the k-cup world. There's something for everyone. I would give it 5 stars but the name says Italian Blend.  I would figure an Italian coffee would have a darker roast.

column9: OK Medium Blend Coffee. Slightly Bitter.
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is a standard Medium roast coffee - nothing remarkable in my opinion.  I found it to have a hint of bitterness, which is also a negative for me.I prefer Tully's Coffee Italian Roast for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) because Tully's seems to have a little more flavor, but is also a touch bolder.If you are a medium to light blend coffee drinker, then you may find this blend pleasing; however, if you lean to medium bold blends, then you should look elsewhere.
This isn't a bad dark roast if you like a stronger coffee, but I prefer the Diedrich French Roast - better flavor.
Nice aroma and is a great breakfast blend.  Strong enough but without the harsh after taste.
Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)  Its Great! Tastes like coffee with a little kick. And the price is right thru Amazon.com.

Tastes like coffee!  Not burnt, not bitter, just good coffee.Only gave it 4 stars because of "blow-outs".  Unfortunately, with this brand, I get about 1 blow-out per 30-35 k-kups.  I have never experienced this amount of blow-outs with other brands (in fact, only a single one in about 500).  I would recommend gently squeezing before inserting in to brewer to verify a tight seal on the top.

We just bought a Keurig a few months ago and are trying different coffees to try to find what we like best. So far it is the TWC Italian Blend medium...very smooth and not bitter. However, I do not like an Extra Bold coffee.
The Italian blend is very smooth with an outstanding flavor. Unlike some dark or bold roast coffees this one has no bitter taste. Timothy's Italian blend is is one of our favorite coffees.
I love Timothy's brand but this ones a miss for me.  It has an "off flavor" that won't get me to buy this one again.

column9: My clients wait for their Timothy's cup!
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is WONDERFUL! I run a salon and every morning I have clients who tell me they have waited to have their morning "cuppa" at my shop, as they don't have a Keurig (WHY!!!!!!??????)It's just delicious! We make the 6 oz cup and it is almost syrupy in flaver.....rich, caramely, heavy coffee flavor with no bitterness (even when served black) Robust, but not acid, fragrant .......wow, we just love it.

Nice new blend. I am starting to like this one. A change of pace, not bitter or too strong but still has a lot of flavor. Try a box or two and see. I have it on the subscription program with Amazon and it works well.

I love the Italian roast the best. It has the coffee shop flavor I love and you can't find this flavor at other stores that sell these pods. My parents asked me to order this for them also and have it delivered to their door.  I recommend the auto ship method from Amazon.com so you know you will have it regularly.

I tried this coffee based on the suggestions of other reviews. I wasn't disappointed. This coffee has a rich, smooth taste. My Keurig has 2 settings. I make mine with the lesser amount of water and it truly is delicious. Very satisfied customer!!

column9: One of the best single cup servings available
column10: If you like a bold yet smooth coffee, this is the one for you.  I didn't expect much from a single serve product because I had another product with similar features.  I was pleasantly surprised by the full flavor and rich tones of this coffee.  They finally made it easy to get real coffee instantly.
great coffee, nice flavor, smooth... enjoyed this coffee very much. The price was right too...I would recommend this to anyone who enjoyes a good cup of coffee.

Timothy's Italian Blend Coffee is number #1 in my book.It has the best flavor and a smooth taste out of most of the coffees we have tryed. We usually drink Coffee People's- Donut Shop Coffee which we have on auto ship. However, I do enjoy buying this when it is on sale!
I have been getting this flavor for awhile now. It is one of my favorite of Timothy's. Not too mild and not too strong.

We have been getting this for awhile now. My husband really enjoys the flavor. This last shipment was very disappointing though as several of the cups didn't have the tops on the cups so the coffee was lost. They are expensive and you not expect to this to happen.

After trying about 10 different k-cups with my new Keurig, this is one of my top 2 or 3.  Definitely strong enough for a nice mug of coffee on the 7.25 oz setting, but not too dark or bitter.  I'm disappointed that its apparently not available directly from Amazon any more.  I see some reviewers got it with Subscribe & Save, which is not currently showing up. :(
I have bought this product before so I knew what it tasted like. Its a good coffee not bold at all.

We tried several different varieties of Timothy's and other K-Cup providers (Green Mountain comes to mind, but I know there were others also) and found the Italian Blend by Timothy's to be an all-around very drinkable blend, and as a result also practical to order through subscribe&save.  When using multiple blends it was not practical to manage each subscription because of lower volume, but having been able to settle on one favorite the additional subscribe and save discount, and the ease of managing just one subscription makes this a winner.  Also, it is admittedly a fairly small sample size but the number of cups that are duds (i.e. when brewing either grounds end up in the mug, or the mug does not brew completely) has been much smaller with the italian blend than with other Timothy's or other manufacturers products.

The Timothy's World Italian Blend coffee is a great K-Cup for those that just want a simple cup of coffee, nothing too strong or too weak. It's the kind of coffee you could drink every morning and be just fine with . I personally like my coffee on the stronger side and wouldn't mind a little flavor so I was looking forward to getting my second shippment in so I could try some different kinds. Right now I am loving the Tree Hugger's Organic blend. It's got just the kick I was looking for!
It's has been a pleasure ordering from Amazon.com. The coffee arrived sooner then expected and in good condition.
Everytime I try a new coffee I always come back to this one and my husband agrees. It's just a good strong but not bitter like dark roast cup of coffee. Of all the brands I prefer Timothy's the best.

This is the best k-cup I have found so far.  I have tried them all...  If you are new and looking for the perfect cup of coffee, buy this one.  The best price I have found so far however, is at Bed, Bath & Beyond (using your 20% off coupon = 44 cents a cup or $7.99 for 18 k-cups).

This is great coffee but I cannot believe this company has jumped in to sell it at twice the price Amazon was selling it for a month ago.  Amazon needs to get it back in stock and get the price back down into the realm of sanity!I love the smell and taste of Starbucks Espresso Roast in the latte's we make at home and work, which is why I decided to try the Italian blend, and it is by far my favorite.  It smells like a good morning cup should smell, then tastes just as good.  Most of the others have too much coffee in the k-cup for me and come on much too strong.  This one makes a perfect large cup of coffee.  I still buy others because my husband likes to explore but, in the morning, this is my coffee.

column9: Good robust flavor, lots of jitters!
column10: I enjoy a rich, robust cup of coffee, this coffee fits the ticket if you like the same.  AFter reading the reviews, I decdied to try it.  It seemed to be priced well in comparison to other Italian Roasts out there. I will say though that it must be packed full of caffene.  I can only drink one cup of this stuff, it gets me pretty wound up.
I really love this coffee  and i think you will also  I will buy it again and again

column9: A very good cup of coffee
column10: I have tried several of the Timothy's coffee's as part of the initial variety pack which came with the Keurig brewer.  I tend to use the 10oz brew and add a bit of creamer or flavored creamer to my cup of coffee, but I always try to taste the coffee itself before doctoring it to my taste.  This was a very good cup, I prefer a medium to dark coffee, and usually drink a moderately strong french roast at work.  This was the best of the non flavored coffees, Timothy's or otherwise which I have tried so far (coffee people french roast is a 3 star, Newman's extra Bold and Timothy's Nicaragua extra bold are both very good but a little strong for my taste)  If you like a medium coffee that is smooth and flavors nicely with a creamer give this one a try.
I tried several coffees before settling on this smooth blend. It has a robust flavor and smells wonderful. If your looking for a smooth coffee with a little kick,this is the one!
Timothy's Italian Blend is a great cup of coffee for those that do not want that bold and robust taste. Mild flavor and no aftertaste.

We have this delivered monthly from Amazon on the Subscribe and Save program; it's my husband's coffee of choice. Always fresh, always consistent, it's a favorite in our home.  If you like a little extra kick from your coffee, this roast is a nice, milder espresso blend--not too dark and heavy.  Great coffee.

We love this brand of Timothy's K-Cups. After only drinking the Green Mountain variety for a long time, I decided to give Timothy's a try.  The Italian Blend is a favorite in our house.  It tastes great!

column9: A great-tasting cup of coffee every morning!
column10: We have owned our Keurig since before Christmas, and have sampled many of the k-cups through the 5-cup sampler packs.  After all of the tasting the Timothy's Italian is my favorite blend.  It is crisp, robust, and has a coffee-shop freshness every time I make it.  And what a great surprise that I can purchase this coffee through the subscribe & save program on Amazon!  I just signed up for automatic delivery, because I have not and don't expect to tire of the great taste of the Timothy's Italian Blend. (Try some of their other blends, especially the Fair Trade.)
Timothy's Italian blend is bellisimo a bold rich flavor with that special edge espresso has in a minute. We love it!

Just a great cup of full bodied coffee, pure, rich with flavor, strong aroma, very smooth with no bitterness. Similar to Kona in flavor. If you like a strong cup with pure flavor and no burnt taste try this, it is a winner!

column9: Not for Dark Blend Coffee Drinkers
column10: I am a fan of other Timothy K Cups, but not this one. I tried it based on the reviews, but unfortunately it is not that strong. Of course it's a matter of taste. I prefer the darker blends, but if you are someone who prefers a "not so strong" coffee than I guess you would enjoy it. Don't get me wrong, it does not taste bad, just too weak for my preference.

Realizing that these reviews are very subjective and it is hard to judge taste... these are my favorite K-cups so far and I have tried many. They are not too dark and not too weak, but with a great sweet and nutty flavor and are very consistent. If typical breakfast blends and the like are just too weak for you and the super-double dark ones are too bitter, give these a try, I don't think you'll be disappointed.For a "taste preference" reference point, I am also a big fan of Kona and Kona blends.
Timothy's Italian roast is a mild not bold coffee...It has a nice taste however much weaker than other coffee's I have had...I would surely classify this coffee as a weaker blend of Italian Roast...

column9: weak was stronger the first time I bought it
column10: Don't if they changed it,but it did not taste like the first time I ordered it,don't know what they did to it?

column9: Good For Those Who Like Their Coffee Less Bold
column10: Certainly flavorful, but less body than I usually prefer. I think of Italian blend as a bolder, darker coffee. If you're put off by the stronger taste (think Starbucks)of the coffee house blends, this is the brew for you.
this is a blend of coffee, and has a weak flavor, the Italian roast is much better

This italian blend is a very pleasent coffee to drink anytime. I do not find it harsh, bitter or too strong. I have a few cups a day and can drink this well into the afternoon. I cannot recommend Timothys Italian Blend coffee enough... And AMAZON you "rock my world" on the delivery, always here within 2 days of placing my order !!!!! Couldn't be a happier customer !
Have used many boxes of this coffee in my Keurig.  It is full-bodied and very good, but not too strong/bitter.  Highly recommend.

This herb/spice mixture is a wonderfully pungent addition to tomatoes, salads, olive oil for french bread, etc.  No one flavor dominates, so it's not too garlicky, oniony, peppery, or anything else.  We love it but can't find in our local Safeway now, so glad Amazon offers.

The best tasting hot tea on the market! 1/3 the caffeine of coffee (which I gave up in 1999). My local favorites like Kroger and Walmart don't consistently carry this product. And the really good news is that by ordering from Amazon, usually with no mailing costs, per box the tea is at least a few cents less than at the local stores. Now go figure that! Thank you Lipton and Amazon.
I'm not usually a fan of Lipton teas, but this is the best French Vanilla Black tea I have tried - and I've tried a lot of them.
I could not find this tea locally anymore, so I'm glad I found it at Amazon.  I've been drinking this tea for a number of years now, and probably wouldn't go back to regular tea.
If you like tea, you will LOVE the french vanilla tea.  Can't find it in stores.  My shipment arrived promptly and was perfect.  I love Amazon.

I've been enjoying this tea for a few years now, ever since it first came out. I've always purchased it at my local grocery store but both stores that I could buy it from stopped selling it!!! I found it here on Amazon and couldn't be happier. Now I order in bulk and enjoy it everyday! It is the best tasting vanilla tea that I have found and I have tried many!!!

I couldn't tell you the difference between a bargain wine and an expensive one, but I can usually tell with tea. This is one of the only "supermarket" teas I like, but unfortunately it is not carried in my area. I'm so glad I can get it via the Internet!!
This is the best French Vanilla flavored black tea that I can find.  It isn't sold in stores anymore around my hometown; so Amazon is where I get my stock supply.

I wasn't a huge tea drinker before I tried Lipton Flavored Black Tea, French Vanilla, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6).  It has a great flavor that can be enjoyed hot or cold.  I actually started drinking it iced to help cut back on my daily pop intake.  Since it has such a great flavor I didn't feel like I was missing out on anything!  The best part is this tea tastes great without adding sugar to it!
Unfortunately for me, I am no longer able to buy this in my local store. I was so happy to find it here.
Lipton French Vanilla is hands down one of the most delicious black teas available - I am thankful I can continue to purchase it through Amazon since it is no longer available in stores.
This is, in my opinion, the best tea that Lipton produces.  It has a marvelous flavor and aroma! It's terrific as a hot tea, cold tea, and sun tea!  You won't be disappointed!

The flavor is pretty good. I am pretty bummed because my tea bags aren't sealed all the way. At the top seam, there is a centimeter gap causing loose tea to invade my mouth! Hate that. I guess I will have to invest in a tea ball. That ticks me off to be truthful. The reason I chose tea bags to begin with is because they are supposed to be convenient!
this is my favorite lipton tea sadly all the stores in my town have stopped selling it so I have resorted to buying it at Amazon lets pray they don't stop offering it.
this is the best tea I have ever had.  myself and many family members have this product on auto shipment.  Yes it's that good.  My family uses 3 cases a month.

column9: better than Lipton's Vanilla Caramel Truffle!!!
column10: Much better than their caramel vanilla truffle!!! This is almost as good as Bigelows french vanilla (REg or decaf) and their Caramel Vanilla (that is awesome!!! My coworkers love it and beg to 'Borrow' a bag). I think this is good too but I keep it at home. It doesn't travel as well as the bigelow tea bags that are individually wrapped. But still good!
I have tried many other french vanilla teas but none come close to this one.

Lipton makes the BEST French Vanilla tea...I have tried others and this is my favorite.  Just the right balance in the vanilla flavoring.  I buy it by the case as it is hard to find in stores - thankful Amazon is carrying.  LOVE this tea!
I love this French Vanilla tea and it's not available in stores any longer so I was THRILLED to find it on Amazon. Now that the weather has turned cool, it's time for tea!!
The expiration date on all the boxes was 2009. Maybe Lipton discontinued making this flavor in 09. It doesn't have the flavor that it should.

Rate this one o.k. to taste & cost is good.  The "French" notes of vanilla give it almost a tropical spin when iced, which I liked.  So far not sold on the taste when hot. Still, iced it might be nice for a party or something! Did notice hints of artifical notes of flavor.  *A great one to try is, Harney&Sons fine teas bit more expensive (Amazon sells) Vanilla flavor; soft/smooth/yum hot w/ touch milk and honey, look forward to trying it iced!  Another good tea is Stash brand (priced great), Vanilla nut Creme.  Hot, its smooth, tasting a nice vanilla and a creamy smoothness, I don't taste nut just vanilla and creamy notes.

This tea has been my absolute favorite for years, and I was really upset when I noticed they stopped selling it at Walmart, Target, & my local food stores. I'm so thrilled to have found it on Amazon at an incredible price! The first time I tried this tea, the aroma reminded me of vanilla cupcakes. It is delicious, especially with a little bit of coconut milk.

Maybe i'm just not used to "flavored" teas, but this was just dissapointing. You can barely taste anything at all, although it does definitely smell good. The bags only last for 1 seeping, and the vanilla is almost undetectable, unless you add sugar / cream.
I have not met a Wilkin and Sons product which was not absolutely best in class.  The jams and preserves from Tiptree are excellent.  Black Cherry is no exception.  Lovely with butter on biscuits.

column9: One of the weakest tasting olive oils I've ever had
column10: After reading one product review about this being the best product, I was immediatley intrigued.  I love a good quality extra virgin olive oil and am always searching for good bottles of imported oil.  I want to have the flavor come through especially in a salad or on warm bread.  If that is what you want, this product will disappoint.  Not all oils are strong, but I found my bottle to have no flavor what-so-ever.  I could discern no flavor that said this is extra virgin olive oil.I have had great olives oils and a friend even brought back some from Greece which was rich, thick, and green.  It was amazing.  This did not even come close.I now see four other reviewers who have rated this as the best.  I don't know how that could be.  I am wondering what happened with my oil???

I picked this up at my local farmers' market and it's wonderful! I got some dipping spices from the same vendor. I brushed the olive oil on a gluten free pizza crust, added the spices and some fresh garlic and black pepper. I cover that with sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese. SO good!! I'll definitely be purchasing more!

column9: Best Greek olive oil I have tasted in US
column10: Being from Greece I can say with certainty that this is an original Cretan olive oil. Its pure and full taste makes it ideal for cooking, salads and dressings. We were thrilled to find here in USA an original product deriving from our country and my wife likes to use it every time she cooks, resulting in tasty and full flavored foods. I would strongly recommend this basic component of the Mediterranean diet to anyone who want to improve his nutritional habits.

We have used SAF Instant Yeast (the one with the Red Band at bottom of the package), in a restaurant for more than twenty years.  This Instant Gold works much faster than the one with the Red Band and less yeast is required. In recipes that called for 1 Tbs of yeast we now use 1 1/2 tsp.  Although the Instant Gold costs about 20% more than than the other; it uses half as much so in the end it costs less.  We also have more success with this yeast when making a gluten free bread.

I bake a lot and have tried all the grocery store brands over the years, and the saf products out perform them all.  The doughs rise faster and outlast all others i.e., waffle batter.  I'm using the GOLD for waffles and sweet rolls-the waffle batter lasts all week in the fridge.  The sweet dough is smooth & silky and handles beautifully, bakes up with an impressive crumb.  Give saf brand yeast a try and you won't go back to the grocery store brands.

I use saf-instant yeast for all my general baking needs, usually the red instead of the gold. This is the first time I have used the gold hoping it might improve my rye bread results. I could not discern a differance between the red and gold for whole wheat or rye bread. It works about the same as the red yeast does. I tried it for sweet rolls and I couldn't tell any difference between the two yeasts. The red and gold are excellent for my baking needs.

Its just baking yeast as advertised, not anything fancy or super select. It was delivered on time with no hassels. It beats going to the store and looking through their very limited selections. I would recommend this for large baking needs. I am not a baker but still trying to get the baking store consistency.
Great product for high rise of sweet bakery products.  Perfect for cinnamon rolls, sticky buns, morning buns and kouign amman.
These are the real deal from when I was a kid and I plan to give them to special neighborhood kids for Halloween. They shipped super fast and were well packaged.
One of the best K cup varieties around! Every drop is delicious, tastes better than a Tazo Chai from Starbucks and easier on the pocket book!

I look forward to this cup of Chai tea every evening.  It's PERFECT.  I actually like it better than what I previously paid 4 dollars for at THE coffeehouse.  It is creamy, sweet, and tasty.  I do recommend using a smaller keurig setting with it so it doesn't taste watered-down, but otherwise, it's seriously perfect.
The Cafe Escapes Chai Latte is AMAZING!! I've ordered a few times now and will continue to use this brand only for my chai. HIGHLY recommend!!!!
the flavor is very good, the price is in the ballpark, this is a good buy, don't hesitate on this one

column9: CAUTION: Contains Sucralose w/Artificial Sweetener Aftertaste!
column10: As another reviewer stated already, this is not labeled 'low calorie' or 'low sugar' so I didn't expect it to contain artificial sweetener. I guess that's my fault for assuming, as this does contain sucralose and has a terrible, artificial sweetener aftertaste. I understand that this taste apparently doesn't bother a lot of people, but I absolutely can't stand it and will be returning this product. I feel that this should be disclosed on the package a bit more prominently than just listed on the ingredients (I bought at Meijer, not at Amazon, where I was able to look at the package before purchasing). I know, I know, I should've checked the ingredients. I wish I would've. I'm only writing this review as a warning to anyone else who may be considering the purchase, but like me, hates that fake sugar flavor (not to mention putting whatever chemicals they use for that stuff into their body).
This Chai Tea is just the right amount of sweetness and great evening drink. I love my keurig and the chai tea is one of my top choices for a hot drink.

column9: I am addicted to this stuff!
column10: I ordered this when I bought a Keurig-K-cupKeurig B60 Special Edition Brewing System just to have something for friends who don't drink coffee. Wow, after trying one cup I became totally addicted to it. I am now drinking more of this than coffee. Who knew?

my daughter told me about this product; once i tried it; i have to have it every day. the flavor is fantastic, and it's very aromatic.it doesn't have any real caffeine; i'am caffeine sensitive; i can have a cup every morning and do not have any symptoms what so ever of caffeine problems. i highly recommend this product if you like cinnamon, and like teas, and coffee lovers will find this refreshing also.

This is the first Chai k-cup that I have tried and SCORE...it's amazing.  I'm actually drinking my first cup as I type this.  It's so good that I couldn't wait to review it.  It's sweet and tasty and simply deliciuos.  I used the small cup setting on my Keurig for this cup. I enjoy both my coffee & tea very sweet, but I actually don't need as much sugar for this chai tea.  I put in the same amount I normally do for tea, and it's extra sweet (but still great) so next time I know not to use as much sugar.I will definitely continue buying this one.

I was a little worried about trying a tea - my hot chocolate and cider attempts with my Keurig hadn't gone so well. I combined 2 6 oz. servings - absolutely delicious! Nice and spicy, not at all watery.
I LOVE THIS BRAND AND CHAI TEA IS BETTER THAN COFFEE, IT IS SO MUCH EASIER AND CHEAPER THAN GOING TO STARBUCKS, TASTES ALMOST THE SAME AND ITS QUICK IN THE MORNING
These are awesome Chai Lattes! And this was the best price I could find searching all over the net. I will definitely be ordering more very soon.
This is the best. used to buy chai latte at very expense shops. so glad that I can order the K-cups for home.
I'm not a coffee person this tea is great and the price is even better I recommened this to all tea drinkers
These Chai Latte K-cups are so delicious. I want to drink them all(the whole box)at once, but try to control myself. I wish they were calorie free, but no such luck!

I sure love chai tea and I was not dissapointed!!! It was just perfect! I brewed it on the 8oz setting like they recomended and I loved every drop! This I will buy always! I plan on brewing it,cooling it and putting it over ice in the summer!
I love this as a nice afternoon drink rather than coffee all day in my Keurig , I just wish there was a little more in the cups since it has to be on a 6 oz cup size or it will taste watery

column9: The ONLY Chai latte I love!
column10: This is the BEST!  We have a Keurig--99.9 % for hubby and his coffee---but, I found this Cafe Escape Chai Latte...and O'yum! Winner! I always take a few portions w/me when we go away for a few days, and just empty in a cup and ask the waitress for Hot Water!  LOVE this!

Was buying different K-CUPs to try and taste, but once I purchased this one,...oh my GOD !!!The whole family loves it, I cannot keep in my house, its gone within a few days, kids and wifedrink for breakfast, lunch and dinner ...................

This is a decent Chai latte.. not the best I've ever had, but certainly the best I've found for the Keurig.  It seems a bit watered down and doesn't have the impact of the spice that I like in Chai.  Just aroma and spice-wise, I actually prefer the Celestial Seasonings India Spice Chai k-cups with a bit of milk added after it's done (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004779XHI/ref=oh_o01_s01_i01_details).

I love Tazo Chai concentrate (just heat with milk) and this nothing close.  It has a very strong artificial taste.  It Smells good, but tastes strongly of powdered non-dairy creamer and way too much sweet and low (those pink packets of sweetener).  Too bad, because it is a great idea and I really wanted to like this.

column9: Love chai - love Keurig - love these K-cups!
column10: I'm addicted to these chai k-cups.  It tastes sooo good and much cheaper than fixing my chai cravings at Starbucks.  Highly recommend!!

column9: Exactly what I was looking for: Fast, fantastic Chai!
column10: I was skeptical as to how good an all-in-one Chai Tea for Keurig could be, but my doubts were erased at my first sip!  The spice blend is great, as is the sweetening and the dairy component.  This is the kind of thing I was hoping I could get from my single-serve coffeemaker!Order some, you will thank yourself every time you brew a cup.

As someone who really enjoys a Chai Tea Latte from time to time, I was really excited when I saw this product and read some of the rave reviews! When I brewed the first one I was impressed right away by the presentation and aroma. However, when I took the first sip it was almost too sweet to drink. It tastes like liquid caramel with a hint of spice. Personally I prefer my Chai with more spice and not much sweet, so this was not what I was looking for. If you do like sweet drinks, though, everything else about this was 5 star. So, I guess it depends on preference. Wish I had ordered this in a sampler because I don't think I'll be able to finish them all.

Got this as a present for my son for our Keurig. His only comment was that it tasted alittle sweeter than when he made regular Chai lattes for himself at home. At first I couldn't find it locally, that is why I ordered it from Amazon, but have found it now and a good bit cheaper  FYI.

column9: Not a bad chai latte but expensive
column10: If I could I'd give it 3.5 stars.The flavor isn't terrible. Not as good as a real chai latte of course but it has decent chai flavor and is relatively creamy. I do wish it was a bit spicier though (could probably mix this with real chai tea). Not bad calorie wise compared to other brands of chai latte powders because it uses artificial sweetener over real sugar. I don't mind but I know some people aren't fans of artificial sweetener.The only major hit this gets is that the price is really expensive. Each cup costs quite a bit more than regular k-cups but of course k-cups were never really for price conscious individuals. Definitely would not buy a keurig just for these since there's readily available chai latte powders that are just as quick to make at a much cheaper price.
This Chai Latte is a "go to" when you want a little something sweet or just to relax and enjoy the moment.  Great product that is always on the mark.
I'm particular when it comes to chai tea but I drink it often. This kind, not so good. I'm going to have to try and sell it on craigslist or something

column9: Really good on a grey day!
column10: Thoroughly enjoyed each and every cup of Cafe Escapes Chai Latte in my previous order . . . so I'm reordering to enjoy as the days get shorter and cooler.  Don't have a Keurig Brewer, so I just empty the single cup pack in a mug, stir in boiling water, wait a minute, and then sit and enjoy!  Cafe Escapes Chai Latte K-cups for Keurig Brewers, 16 K-cup Box
I think this product would be good, but I am sensitive to sucralose and cannot use it. It was very disappointing. The product will go unused.

I hate coffee but love a nice hot cup of chai.  I have tried several options for home use and all of them have come up short.  Until the Chai Latte K-Cups.  OMG.  It's just like what I get from the coffee shop.  Having these available to me have pretty much guaranteed I will never order another one ever again.  And only takes 2-3 minutes to brew.
Awesomely easy cup of tea. For an extra dose of self satisfaction, add a squirt of whipped cream!Chai tea is also good for you so drink up.
My goodness, I love this stuff!!!  It is sweet, while not being too sweet.  I have turned all my friends onto it.
Cafe' Escapes Chai Latte K Cups-it taste so smooth and it's a quick treat for the middle of the Day just sweet enough.
This is the best price around for the quantity of kculs per box....stock up!!!!Café Escapes Chai Latte, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count

This is the best tea latte I have ever had.  Drink it daily and really enjoy the flavor.  I've found it in the warehouse section of Amazon.com and it's really a bargain price!  Cafe Escapes has other products and all the ones I've tried have been great.  Do not hesitate to order this!

I searched everywhere. Even discount stores. And buying in bulk (I purchased 3, which got me free shipping) meant that I paid even less than the sales prices with coupons at TJ Maxx or some other similar discount store for exactly the same brand. They taste great. I will definitely order again. They came on time when promised. You cannot do better that that anywhere, ever!
This chai tea is absolutely delicious. Very creamy and full of flavor. I mix it with the Starbucks Sumatra coffee for a tasty drink.  Buy it - you won't regret it!!

i'm a huge fan of chai tea's i find it very relaxing and mind clearing! usually before i start drinking a freshly brewed cup of chai tea, i will stick my nose in the cup and take a few deep breath, the aroma just clears my mind and relaxes me, then i sip slowly until its all gone, its great hot or over ice!I enjoy a slice of marble pound cake with my chai tea!

I have to say this is the most amazing taste I have ever had.  I searched everywhere for this.  The few stores in our town that carries these are always out of stock of this flavor.  It normally sells out the first day they get the shipment it.... Most I have to resort to buying my supply online here.  This stuff has everything in it and no need to add more the flavor is just perfect.
This is my favorite flavor.  I'm not sure it has the same amount of caffiene as regular coffee, but it's too good not to drink every morning.

If you like Chai Latte tea and don't want to fuss with making it the 'old Fashion" way, this is a good alternative.  Of course, you have to own a K-Cup coffee machine.  I've bought a few of these boxes of 24 k-cups.  The last time I ordered them they came in a package of 2 boxes (48 total) for about $32.  Now it looks like amazon is selling them as 1 box (24 k-cups) for about $18.  To me the key to buying this (or almost any item) on amazon is to do a search first.  There are many different sellers here and they all seem to have different prices and a different number of k-cups in their boxes.  Some add shipping and some have free shipping.As far as the tea goes, I really like it and would highly recommend it!
This tea is delicious, the hint of cinnamon helps to relax and soothe.  A great drink for when you want to kick back and relax.

column9: This is a Must Have in My House
column10: If you are a Chai Latte fan, you must try this product!  I 'spoil' myself with a cup whenever I'm off a day from work.
Love the flavor!  Not too strong, but not weak - just right.  My favorite morning drink!  I do not have to add any sugar, cream , or milk.  It is perfect the way it comes.
This is my favorite flavor to use with my Kuerig coffee maker.  It is the perfect way for me to start and/or finish any day.

column9: Cant Beat the Flavor.Better than any Coffee Shop
column10: I love this tea. It is so good and also wonderful if you add a little milk or half/half after it is brewed. Its also has less caffiene than what you would get at any local coffee shop. Can only hope they come out with a Vanilla chai tea.
Bought this for my wife she says it isn't Starbucks but it is the best Chai Tea to come out of a machine.
These are really tasty.  If you enjoy the Chai Latte from the popular coffee shops, you will love this.  Highly recommended.

This is the best tasting tea I have ever had.It reminds me of the Holidays,especially Christmas Holidays.It has a taste I cannot describe but is rich in flavor.Although I cannot find it easily in town,it seems this tea is carried most during Holiday Seasons so I looked on the net and found the price out of range till I looked on Amazon.Thanks Amazon.

column9: Buy the larger box - You'll thank me later!
column10: If you like Chai, this will be your new favorite!  So yummy!  Our only problem was that we kept running out!

column9: Even A Non-Coffee Drinker Loves It
column10: We've had the Keurig a whole week and the only flavor/box that's gone completely is this one. It's a household favorite. My husband who detests coffee drinks and most hot drinks, loves this tea as do I. We have ordered another three boxes of it because it is fabulous. Very reminiscent of the chai latte you can buy hot from one of the big coffee stores. Highly recommended.
Good Chai- cheaper than coffee houses. Convenient in the Keurig machine. Got it through Amazon, which was less expensive than other options.

This is my favorite keurig drink variety so far.  I found the chai tea latte flavor smooth and delicious, and with no strange aftertaste.  I almost purchased this item last week, but was hesitant because of some of the reviews.  Then, I received a free sample.  Wow!  So glad, otherwise I might have missed out on a great product.  Will definitely be buying more in the future!

If you like hot tea with milk and sugar, you will love this chai latte.  It has a slight cinnamom flavor, but otherwise, not nearly as exotic as it sounds.  I have also become hooked on this, my new favorite flavor of K-cups.

I keep it mostly for when everyone else is having coffee, but one person wants chai tea.  Otherwise, I may as well use the mix from the store and make several cups.

I despise aspartame sweetener and this tastes exactly like that except I don't know what is actually in the k cups as I don't recall there being ingredients on the box? This is too sweet for my preference. I love chai, but to me it tastes like milk with sugar and few spices. If you prefer chai where you taste more of the tea and spices and less sweetness, I would not recommend this k-cup selection.

column9: Worst aftertaste ever.. even more then diet drinks
column10: I love coffee. I love chai lattes. I love my Keurig. But this combination was disgusting. The taste when first prepared was STRONG. OK, I get that and could even even like it... if the aftertaste didn't kick in. I have never tasted so much artificial sweetener in any product. This is not listed as lo-cal or diet.. so it was not at all what I was expecting. I would rather have an aspirin dissolve in my mouth. I am returning this to the store. Absolutely terrible.

column9: Yuck! Don't fall for the high ratings!!!!
column10: I did not like the taste of this at all.  It was awful.  I think the Tazo Chai Tea concentrate heated up with milk makes a much better chai latte.  I did want to try this one based on the high reviews and the fact that it would be easy in the keurig to make this drink.  It was NOT good.  I'm going to try my best to give these away.
I am a chai tea lover and was excited to see this. After making and trying it with my family, I just don't like it. Very artificial tasting, I'm just not a fan.

The chemical aftertaste is very pronounced and distasteful.  The bad taste can be muted a little with the addition of milk or half & Half, but do not recommend these for a Chai Latte Fix.

column9: Don't Just Add Water!! Add milk!!
column10: I bought these chai latte cups because I love Starbucks and Dunkin' Donuts versions, but BE WARNED just adding water seems to intensify the artifical taste. While this seems redundant ADD MILK! It say latte, but there is something off with the ingredients so I do half water and the other half vanilla soy milk! It tastes great!! I can't digest lactose so I haven't tried cow milk, but Soy Milk does wonders! Don't throw your kcups away just yet. I love Chai tea and was hoping to find one to use with my Keurig machine. This is way too sweet and lacking the spices that make Chai so delicious. I was disappointed with this one and won't buy it again.

this is my first time ordering from Amazon, and my package arrived on time and in tact. Will defintely order again and will also check out other products sold here now that I know they have great service for online shopping...this was a great first experience with Amazon.com =o)

Get some of this sauce.  Great on any mexican or spanish food.  Not recommended if you don't like spicy food!

I love this El Yucateco Green Chile sauce. It's got a little heat and a lot of flavor. This and Valentina are my two favorite Mexican sauces. They're big on flavor. I love this sauce on tacos. The prices here are ridiculous. This sauce should come in at under $2 for the 4 oz bottle.

El Yucateco Green Habanero is my favorite hot sauce. It is not vinegary, so, while it does have a subtle flavor, it is an excellent choice if you only want to make foods spicy without noticeably changing their already pleasing flavor. For instance, this sauce is fabulous on a good grilled hamburger, barbecue and spaghetti. Let me warn you, though. I only put 3 to 4 drops of it on a burger. You go splashing it all over supper and you'd better have a plan B. The good news is that a bottle of it lasts a long time.

column9: Yum!  Lots of heat with no vinegar taste!
column10: Had this hot sauce at a little Mexican restaurant about a month ago - I couldn't get enough!  I love all of the heat without the strong vinegar taste of Red Hot or even pickled jalapenos.  I searched around for the sauce in stores but could never find it - thanks to amazon, I can induldge in my cravings for this hot sauce.
Adds a great, easily controlled heat and enhances all other flavors. Not a replacement for chili or tabasco sauces - those are startlingly different, and a good chili might require all three!
I love the taste, it's hot in a pleasant way and doesn't have the vinegary aftertaste. This company makes several variants and all are great tasting.

column9: Hands-down the most flavorful hot sauce ever
column10: I tried this first at an authentic Mexican restaurant we used to frequent. Just a few drops here and there on a dish would make the flavor really pop. Now we keep it on hand at home and use it on all kinds of things. I put it in chili, mix it into mayo for a zesty sandwich spread, use it liberally when I'm in the mood to have my eyeballs fall out, etc. Now that I've had this sauce, nothing else will do!

I first had this at a local Mexican restaurant and went crazy for it, even though I thought I might die of the heat.  I am a huge, yet disciminating, fan of hot suaces in general but this is by far my favorite right now.  I can handle a lot of heat as a regular hot sauce eater but this stuff is on a different scale than what you can get at the grocery store.  My husband won't come near this stuff.  It is so good I want to pour it on whatever I'm eating but it is sooooo hot I have to find that threshold of barely tolerable heat before it's so much I can't take it.  Of course, with continued dosage I can do more over time.  Our Publix and Kroger doesn't carry it so I have to go to the mercado/taqueria and can only get the 4 oz. version so this time I actually bought three 8 oz. bottles here on Amazon (fiendish, I know).The flavor is excellent, uncomplicated and straight forward like fresh green habaneros blended with a bit of salt and a bit of vinegar.  It isn't thin or overly vinegary or too salty though like a lot of hot sauces. I think this is because there is more actual habaneros in there because it's a little thicker consistency with a bit of fine texture to it.  Also, the color is fabulous.  I don't know if they add food dye or not but it is this vibrant, almost neon grass green.  Love it.My favorite way to eat it is on simple things like carne asada with flour tortillas, avocado and shredded lettuce, on 'over medium' fried eggs, and it's perfect on fish tacos with cool slaw, raw white onion and ranch.  The Mexican restaurant where I first had this doesn't have it on the tables anymore (probably because it's too hot for most) but they take it and puree it fine with avocado for this outrageously hot guacamole/habanero sauce thing that is just awesome.So obviously I love it and highly recommend it for experienced hot sauce people.

I love to spice up my food whether it is chili, soup, Mexican food,  or some type of meat or barbeque.  This El Yucateco Green Chile Habanero Sauce is wonderful if you like HOT SPICY SAUCE!  This is one of the great hot sauces that doesn't  taste like vinegar.This is a great sauce to use as an additive in other sauces or barbeque sauces to add zest to them.  You can control the dose to get the right flavor.  Sometimes a mixture of two or three sauces comes up with the right combination for a perfect barbeque basting sauce.I included a photo of the nutrition label for your information.  This is a great hot sauce and one of my favorites. If you like spicy food then you will love this one!  Easy does it or you will be saying ouch!
Tried a small bottle and used it up in no time. So bought 4 large bottles. Use it in just about everything, tacos, burritos love to put it in Turkey burgers. Great flavor and just the right heat.

This is a staple in the fridge of any hot sauce lover.  El Yucateco is great in chili and with Mexican cuisine.  It does have some heat to it but the flavor of this sauce is really nice as well.  It is quite thick and when used at the rate of a tablespoon in a bowl of chili, you may notice a slight sweat forming on your brow.  That is what I am looking for when I eat spicy foods... I am not looking for chemical burns in my mouth but I do like to sweat a little.

I ordered this for my husband for Christmas because he always uses it when we are eating at my favorite Mexican restaurant. I wasn't sure if I'd be able to find it online, but I am so glad I did. He was so surprised and excited when he opened the gift.

column9: Beast of a Habanero Sauce - Amazing!
column10: I use this on Mexican dishes, rice, beans, etc.  I am a huge fan of Habanero sauces and this green sauce takes the cake.  I haven't found anything similar in quality or spiciness.  Highly recommend if it if you enjoy a nice hot green sauce.
This is my favorite hot sauce, such a delicious flavor besides being the perfect amount of heat.  I put it on just about EVERYTHING!

column10: I like this hot sause also, not as much as El Yucateco XXXtra Hot Kutbil-ik Mayan Style Habanero Hot Sauce - 4 oz tho. If you like a drop of heat on your food, this is the product for you!

If you like your sauces with flavor style and "heat" this one's for you. Enjoyable on any foods where that extra "kick" is needed. Highly recommended for anything eatable that could use some more spice in its life!Enjoy it while its still "hot" !!

column9: One of the best hot sauces in the world
column10: This is the primary hot sauce I seek out to add some spice to my food. It has a robust habanero taste which is balanced perfectly with the garlic. Great for adding to salsa for a spicy kick. Be warned, this is a fairly hot one!

column9: Good flavor, great with Mexican dishes
column10: El Yucateco makes a bangin' sauce.  It's fairly thick and sticks well to food (not too runny).  It's sweet, and it's got a little bit of kick to it.  I'd give it a 4/10 for heat, a 7 or 8 for flavor.My only issue is that it only tastes good on Mexican food.  I've tried it on pizza and eggs (staple hot sauce foods for me) and I was left disappointed.  But on a taco?  This hits the spot.
This sauce is as promised.  Hot & Tasty!  My son puts it on everything, even his spaghetti.  The size of the bottle is bigger than most, so it last longer.
This hot sauce is great. Spicy but not too spicy, you can really taste the green chilies and Habenero, and what an amazing color! I love using this stuff.

I love this stuff. I'm on my second bottle. Not too hot that you can't pour it on your tacos (YMMV). Slightly garlicky but not overbearingly so. It's not vinegary like Tabasco and it's thick kinda like ketchup. The green color is quite bright and appealing.I give it four stars because it has preservatives and artificial colorings.
I was tired of the same old taste from all the other hot sauce, so decided to try this.  Nicely surprised at how spicy it was.  Did not give 5 stars since its a bit costly for hot sauce.

column9: Quite Hot -  If you want pure heat this may be you your sauce. Yet there are even hotter ones but do you really care?
column10: This GREEN Habanero sauce is quite potent. Two or three drops is all you'll need for a bloody mary and only a few more drops will add considerable heat to any family sized dish.The Habanero chile is one of the hottest chiles known to man and in its immature state its color is green. So these younger chiles are slightly less hot than then the older red ones.This is a pure heat source with little if any other flavor beyond the overwhelming heat. If you really think hard about this sauce you might (?) be able to detect a vague hint of vinegar (which is the Acetic Acid listed in the ingredients).Ingredients (as copied from the label): Water, Habanero Pepper, Salt, Acetic Acid (a chemical component of vinegar), .... etcConclusion: There is nothing special about this sauce beyond its considerable and concentrated heat. While there are some very vague vinegar notes (from the Acetic Acid) -  there is no real character to this sauce beyond pure heat.Yet that my be all you want. A potent heat source and this one certainly meets that mark!If you decide to order this sauce --- Watch the seller's shipping charges which can often be excessive and won't drop even if you order multiple bottles at the same time.I'd pass on this hot sauce because of its lack of character - 3 stars is about right. But if you are looking for just pure heat then give it 3 or 4 stars or even 5 stars.If you want even more heat then look for a Habanero sauce that does not list water as its first (therefore major) ingredient. There are other Habanero sauces which are even hotter but I'll confess I'm not a big fan of tasteless but ultra hot chile sauces.Tastes do differ so you may want to try this one. In all fairness I gave it three stars because it offered pure heat without any obvious flaws.

column9: Crunchy and satisfying with a low glycemic index
column10: If you are familiar with crispbreads, you'll love this. If you expect a 'snack cracker', move on. These Ryvitas are everything they should be, bland enough for tasty toppings, but adding enough flavor (and crunch!)to avoid being boring. These are insanely good with an aged swiss or dill havarti, with paper thin cucumber and/or tomato sprinkled with more dill. I purchased this in a store which is now not carrying it.  It's my favorite cracker.

column9: Great cracker, but many were crumbled.
column10: My only disappointment was with how my case of crackers arrived.  Within each box, I would estimate that a third to half of the box was a mess of crumbled crackers.  The crackers themselves are very good tasting.
Love the crunchy sunflower seeds and slight salty flair to these! Much better price on Amazon than in my local store.

First off, we ordered this in February, and the case does not expire until 7/2010- so I'm glad the product is fresh.Now, as to taste- we found the cracker to be very dense and tasty.  The sunflower seeds give it a lovely nutty flavor.  This will make a great lunchtime cracker with cheese.  This is a crumbly cracker, but the product arrived at our house safely.  I can't think of any downside to it- unless you don't like the flavor of rye or sunflower seeds.  You basically get exactly what it sounds like with this one, and as an added benefit, it does not seem to cause blood sugar spikes- so if you are managing your blood sugar, this might be a good cracker for you (though reactions to foods will vary among individuals, so you'll want to check yourself).
love the product, unhappy with the expiration date on the product , very short expiration date, would like to be able to knwo expiration beford next purchase

column9: Flavorful chewy bites of hearty grains and seeds
column10: We love Ryvita crackers and go through them like some people go through candy. So far, the Dark Rye are our favorites for use as a standard type crispbread and these Whole Grain Rye Crispbread with Sunflower Seeds & Oats are the most flavorful, yet fragile. We received one case and gave another as a gift and both arrived packed very well by Amazon, but as other reviewers have said, many of the crackers are in small broken pieces. I'm not too surprised because when I bake bread using oatmeal, I get a softer texture which sometimes falls apart.  We will be consuming these piecemeal (pun intended) with toppings that do not require spreading.  Peanut butter, Boursin cheese and fruit preserves will be served with the plain rye crispbreads or the survivors from these boxes, but we will use the broken bits atop macaroni and cheese instead of bread crumbs, and they'll be fine for little tastes of cheese, fish or on a salad.  I usually have no problem consuming foods past their "Best by" dates, but being that sunflower seeds can become rancid, I will be sharing these prior to their May '09 date.Because we've never had these before, we don't know if this texture is standard for the crackers or if it's a result of them not being fresh. In their current condition, I would not call these "Crispbread," but flavorful chewy bites of grains and seeds.  The flavors are robust and the texture feels great on the teeth but I sure wish more individual crackers would come out of the box in less than several pieces.  When they are in little pieces, it's too easy to eat more!

column10: WOW WOW WOW WOW,WOW,truly great tasting Banana Nut cake. I've been looking for this type of cake for quite awhile,just found it by accident on Amazon,glad I did,I would highly recommend these & I am going to try their Apple pies next,you won't be disappointed.

I have just finished reading "and a Bottle of Rum - A History of the New World in Ten Cocktails" and I just had to google my favorite Rum, which is El Barrilito, produced in Bayamon, Puerto Rico.I was born in New York City and I am 63 years old.  My father's favorite rum was Barrilito and so I followed the tradition of drinking this variety at home all of my life.  Though, I must admit that the reason I did this was more out of family tradition along with the novelty of bringing back Barrilito from Puerto Rico whenever I, a relative or friend returned from the island because it was either very difficult or near impossible to get it stateside.With time, I learned to discern the difference between the variety light rums and I learned after time that Barrilito has a deep body and flavor.  I always preferred the three star, aged bottle of Barrilito.  I have always preferred to drink rum straight.  If you do drink Barrilito you will taste the distinct flavor of molasses.The world of rum is a tremendously large one and by having read "and a Bottle of Rum - A History of the New World in Ten Cocktails" by Wayne Curtis, I have learned a great deal.Barrilito may not be one of the greatest rums in the world.  I have not tried that many.  But for Puerto Rican rum, I have to give this rum the highest rating.
Just tried this last night.  A friend brought some back from Puerto Rico.  It is AWESOME! I will be purchasing some of my own.

It tastes good so I drink it over ice and sometimes I add to smoothies.....Just buy it, I think you will like it.Glass bottles (not plastic) well packaged so no worries.

good other than the lid loosening, and some of the liquid spilling out.  I did report this to Paisley Farm.  The flavor is awesome, and I would recommend it to others.

Our cats love it at least for now. As anyone knows who shares their lives with felines, cats are finicky eaters and quickly tire of anything. For now, this is a big hit. Ask me in a month or so and they probably won't go near it. Obviously, it's high quality food.

My cat is super picky and suffers from colitis. He needs a high quality food to soothe his poor inflamed colon. He loves this food, just dives right in. It really helps with his colitis too. No more bloody stools. He likes almost all flavors from Best Feline Friend. The pumpkin and bonito is his other favorite.

My cats just LOVE this food! I split a can between two cats each evening, and alternate between this other flavors - but this (Tuna & Chicken Chuckles) is the favorite by far.  They come meowing like crazy as soon as I pop the top.  It's rather hilarious!I chose this brand merely because of the packaging and am glad to have done so...I really think my cats' coat and tummies are much happier these days.

When we first brought our kittens home from the shelter, they only ate some dry Purina kitten food that Purina provides/donates to the SFSPCA (thanks!).  My vet recommended wet food, however, and I wanted to get something grain-free and high-protein.Of the several brands I looked at, I started with BFF - mostly because of the label!  We tried most of the flavors that BFF makes and most were a hit (except the one with pumpkin), but they love the tuna and chicken one the most.  You can see actual white meat chicken and tuna as you get it out of the can, which makes it a little more palatable for me to look at. My cats really like tuna and chicken chuckles.  It's a great grain free option for cats who like fish-flavored foods.  Switching my cats to grain-free has helped tremendously with their "tummy" issues.
This tastes even better than I remember from the many years I lived in Mexico.  It zips up the taste of all my soups.

This beats bulk health-food store granola. I do not like the kind with raisins, & it's much more difficult to find this raisinless kind.

Tried this at home. Shook it with whole organic milk in a cocktail shaker so it would be well blended.It was creamy and velvety and lovely. Very convenient, will buy again. Like this better than the single serve hot variety.

I absolutely LOVE this stuff but, I only pay $2.09 for a box of 6 servings at my grocery store. This price here is a bit steep. I have to addmit I'm actually addicted,so be careful. I'd probably pay this price if I couldn't get it elsewhere though, cuz I'm addicted.  Do shop around.

Love this! It doesn't taste like some instant mix at all! It's thick and creamy and sweet!  I mix it with a glass of cold milk and a few ice cubes. I haven't tried other mixtures yet, but want to try it with chocolate syrup! This will definitely be my go-to coffee drink from now on!

column9: Amazon:  please bring this back for subscription.
column10: Hard to find product in stores.  I drink at least one of these a day, now that reminds me, I think I will have one now...anyway, I used to subscribe to this before the name change from "Cappuccino Coolers", same product, but once the name changed Amazon dropped the item.  Please bring it back, my local store sells me vanilla by the case but I would love to supplement my diet plan with the hazelnut as well.

Great Stuff and only about a $1 per serving.  I throw in ice and a drop of creamer with the milk.  I also use the Almond Syrup and sometimes for an extra special treat some CHOCOLATE SYRUP!!  I've got one of those Tupperware Shakers which is great and I don't have to stop on the way to work and I save about $3-$4 a day!!  Can't beat that!

I mix this with a tablespoon or two of vanilla cream and the rest skim milk....delicious! Creamy and smooth, tastes like a liquid version of nips coffee candy.  It is also good and not as sweet sans the cream.

column9: Ferrarra Pan Red Hots in Small boxes are best!
column10: Ferrarra Pan Red Hots are just what red hots are meant to be. The small individual boxes allow me to control myself and recognize when I've had enough. Large plastic bag is not a good idea for small little candies, you just keep eating.

I'm a serious calorie counter but I love my evening ice cream treat. I've been relying of Skinny Cow for years and it's been fine, but I often pined for an alternative that would give me more treat for the calorie. Now I've found my dream. It's almost unbelievable that I can eat a whole pint for less than 150 calories. And this stuff is GOOD tasting.It's not premium, high fat content, high calorie premium ice cream good, but who needs that anyway. The chocolate flavor is really very chocolatey, the consistency is smooth and the satisfaction of not destroying my calorie limit for the day is priceless! Bravo Arctic Zero!

I received 6 pints of the chocalate flavor.  Four of them were great, rich creamy smooth texture, good flavor.  Two were icy, darker, poor texture, poor flavor.  They looked and tasted like they had melted and refrozen.  As all six pints arrived frozen solid with dry ice remaining in the package, I don't think this is due to shipping.  It looks like they weren't stored properly, or were stored for too long (months).  This is a great product, but there seem to be some quality control issues.  Four of the pints would get an easy five stars, but the other two get zero.
I really like some of the Arctic Zero flavors - the chocolate was a little icy and not as creamy as I have had before.

I was so looking forward to receiving this product. Unfortunately I hated it. I ended up throwing it all out. It seemed slimy like very cheap ice cream. The only good thing about it was it was still frozen when it arrived in Michigan.

Thought it does not have quite the sweetness of ice cream, I found the chocolate and chocolate peanut butter flavors to have a very pleasant choclatey flavor and smooth texture.  I let my pint sit on the counter for about 10 min before digging in, and it had an almost mousse like consistency - very impressive!  Hard to believe this stuff is good for me and I can eat the whole pint without feeling the guilt I'd get with a pint of Ben & Jerry's.

I really enjoyed this stuff and the free shipping. I got it in 2 days and it was packed in an insulated container with dry ice. It's amazing you can get ice cream delivered to your door. Anyway, it was really good and good for me at the same time.

This stuff is so good! I finally found it at Whole Foods in my area, so I don't have to order it from Amazon anymore, but trust me, this stuff is delicious! It doesn't taste exactly like a pint of Ben & Jerry's (Come on, you you can eat an entire pint for 150 calories, be realistic!) but it's really really good. Like a delicious frozen protein shake. I love the chocolate and the chocolate peanut butter, but they sort of taste the same. (You can't really taste much peanut butter in the chocolate&pb one) I know they're expensive, but if you're in the mood to eat an entire pint, this stuff is great!

column9: Price is High; Satisfaction is HIGHER
column10: I'm in love with ARCTIC ZERO, and I am lavishing a lot of money on this product.  It's worth every dollar, though.  The 6-pack comes encased in dry ice; it is so FROZEN that you almost cannot eat a pint straight out of the dry ice ... I say ALMOST because desperation produces creative approaches to eating even the most frozen pint.I love this stuff, and I would eat any of the flavors.  However, the CHOCOLATE and CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER are the best-tasting.Don't expect ARCTIC ZERO to taste like the 800-calories/pint ice creams.  However, if eating a pint of Ben & Jerry's causes you to go into a deep funk over your excessive consumption, then grab a pint of ARCTIC ZERO and bask in the joy of a 128-calorie alternative that really will pacify your sweet tooth AND MAKE YOU FEEL VIRTUOUS AS WELL.ARCTIC ZERO is my one HUGE EXPENSE, and I wish it were cheaper... but, well, I'm pretending that I'm eating my $7.78 confection instead  of heading to Cheesecake Factory and gobbling down a slice of cheesecake for the same price.  [It's a personal deception since I have long since sworn off cheesecake.]ARCTIC ZERO, please stock the Whole Foods shelves in Ohio.  PLEASE!!!

I've tried all the Artic Zero flavors, and the Chocolate is my favorite!  I can eat it a whole pint at a time.  The chocolate Peanut Butter is "OK", but I wish they could make it actually have a peanut butter taste.  I couldn't tell there was really any peanut butter flavor at all.  The Vanilla and Strawberry Banana I can't even eat on their own.  I've used them in a smoothie to save ice cream calories, but don't think they are worth the extra expense.  So, I've stopped buying anything but the Chocolate flavor, which I re-order every few months.  I've also tried the Pumpkin Spice flavor, that one bombed too.  I just ordered their Chocolate Mint Cookie flavor and can't wait to give it a try!  I have high hopes for that one!  But if your on the fence of what to buy, try their Chocolate and Chocolate Peanut Butter combo and decided which you like better from there.4 stars, because it doesn't have the "real" ice cream texture you would expect, but for the calories it helps me get my ice cream fix!P.S. sometimes there are occasional problems with some of the pints arriving a little soft and melted.  After sticking them in the frezzer to re-freeze, when you go to eat them they can have an icy texture.  This is unfortunate, because of how expensive they are.  I don't want a single bit to go to waste!  But since I can't find them locally, I have been willing to just deal with it.

Haagen Daaz it ain't, but.......it ain't bad.  At least the chocolate isn't.  I tried the strawberry banana and I've got to say that it was awful, I actually found it unpleasent to the point where it was ineatable.  On the other hand the chocolate was not bad at all.  No one is ever going to mistake it for "real" ice cream, but at 128 calories for a pint of frozen dessert treat it tastes pretty damn good.  At least it satisfys the craving for something "sinful", without blowing your diet.  128 calories versus 1000 plus calories????  No contest - save the Haagen Daaz for really special occassions.

This stuff is great!  I am a serious calorie counter, but I also love ice cream.  This gives me the feeling that i'm indulging in ice cream-but i'm saving loads of calories.  I love that I can eat the entire pint too.  My favorite flavor so far is the plain chocolate.  However I plan on trying them all.  Now this stuff does not taste exactly like ice cream- but it has great texture and is creamy.  I am so glad I found this product.
I love this product.  It is great for anyone who is trying to cut back on calories but does not want to give up flavor.  Really chocolaty.  Have served it to friends and they loved it also.

I absolutely love Arctic Zero.  All the flavors are amazing.  Chocolate, Vanilla, and Chocolate Peanut Butter are faves but now I need to add to that list the Pumpkin Spice.  This one is right on with a perfect blend of pumpkin spice!  The Arctic Zero customer service is the best I have seen.  You have to try this stuff!!!

Firstly, I have not purchased this product from Amazon, but rather from a local grocery store.  However, I might purchase the different flavors someday from Amazon, because my grocer only carries the chocolate flavor.  That's fine with me for now, though, since chocolate is always my very favorite! :)  Of course, this stuff is a huge draw because it's only got the 150 calories per pint that they so proudly advertise.  If it had as much as regular ice cream or sorbet, I highly doubt it would even be mildly successful.  The flavor is very much like a chocolate sorbet would be.  I would not say it is "creamy," because, well, there's no cream in it.  However, it is similar to what I would call a sorbet, and does have a nice texture after sitting out for 5 minutes on the counter.  The only thing I don't like about it is that there is a smidgen of a salty aftertaste after the first few bites, but then again, I'm really sensitive about salty flavors.  Overall, it's not bad at all.  I would recommend this for people with special needs/diets.
Not as good as the peanut butter chocolate, but still quite good. A great alternative to high fat and calorie regular ice cream.

I am a health nut who loves chocolate. This frozen dessert is absolutely fabulous! I can't go a day without it. The flavor is wonderful, and for 128 calories per pint - it is a chocolate lover's dream come true. I am an Arctic Zero fan for life!

love this stuff!  of course its not real ice cream, but w/ the nutritional stats, you can't go wrong.  highly recommend it.  free shipping & it arrives at your door still frozen.  chocolate is my favorite, then chocolate pb, maple vanilla is ok & i haven't tried the strawberry banana.

I am so happy with my purchase!  I just ordered another case (the pb flavor this time :)) and can't wait for it to arrive.  The yogurt is fabulous, and the packaging and shipping were awesome!  Definitely recommend!

I bought this "ice cream" last week, hoping that it would taste alright.  I count calories religiously and was hoping that I could find a product that tasted decent, because I love ice cream.  However, this ice cream has almost on flavor and the texture is grainy.  After tasting  this product, I would rather have good ice cream every once in a while and in a smaller quantity.  This ice cream WAS NOT worth the 32 calories per serving.

Being a diabetic, I have to watch carbs very carefully. Basically there's not been any ice cream I could have more than a spoonful of.Arctic Zero ice creams have 6g of carbs per serving. 6! An entire PINT has 24g, which is the same or LESS than other ice creams have in one SERVING. Heck, it's less than most flavoured YOGURT.Now, this stuff is nowhere near as sweet as other ice creams, but that's just fine. It's still tasty, and the texture is fantastic... if you treat it right.And this is the important part.The first time I got one of these I tried to just eat it. It was rock-solid, and even the part I chipped off wasn't very good.HOWEVER, if you leave it out of the freezer for a while and let it thaw a bit, it'll just turn totally smooth and creamy and wonderful.I've tried all the Arctic Zero flavours I could find and they're all good, with the exception of Cookies and Cream which for some reason is just horrible. Chocolate and Strawberry are fantastic, though. And mixing chocolate, strawberry and vanilla is FUN.

This is the way Cheddar is supposed to taste!  Amazing!  I understand that the company ages it naturally and it makes all the difference.  Even people that don't like cheddar like this smooth cheddar flavor.  You will not be disappointed.
WOW, THIS IS THE BEST CHEESE, MY HUSBAND AND I HAVE EVER EATEN. SMOOTH,CREAMY AND SHARP, LOVED IT!!!! GREAT PRODUCT, PROMPT DELIVERY

If you love the old fashioned flavor of tangy, extra sharp cheddar cheese, then Adams' Reserve NY Extra Sharp White Cheddar (or colored cheddar) is for you! Creamy texture and outstanding, natural cheddar flavor makes this cheese excellent with fresh fruit or for cooking your favorite recipes.  This cheese elevates any Mac & Cheese recipe to an amazing comfort food your family will love!  We live in the Southwest now, but are originally from Upstate NY dairy country, and this cheese is a true taste of home!

column9: Use it for dinner time, fully engaged and learning!
column10: After reading a bit more about toys that encourage learning and rewards, I came across a TON of reviews for this.  At first I wasn't too sure if it was something my puppy would like, but I decided to give it a shot anyway.  I filled it up with his dinner, and placed it on the ground.  I could tell he knew there was food in there because he was smelling it like crazy.  He then accidentally knocked it over and some food fell out...... suddenly he realized....if i play i get treats!  Normally when I feed him dinner it takes him less than 1 minute or two to woof it down, then he lets out a little burp.  Sometimes he even managed to throw up a bit after because I noticed he wasn't even chewing.  Well, it took him literally 25 minutes to get through a whole dinner with this.  He got a bit frustrated as it was nearing it's last few kibbles, but I think he understands the concept now.  Highly recommended! (my pup is a 6month old shihpoo, 10lbs)

column9: Recommended for agressive chewers or large breeds
column10: This is a great product for keeping the pup busy for a bit- it is made of hard plastic and holds up well to rough play.  The only down side is you may want to have your pet play with the cube on a carpeted area-it's noisy!

My dog is a chewer and somehow managed to gnaw away at the inside tabs for adjusting the difficulty level.  So, our use is just at one level.  May try the smaller cube, which doesn't have the tabs so play can be more challenging.  Otherwise, she enjoys playing with it and it keeps her busy chasing the cube and finding the hidden treats.  Good challenge.

Awesome product for hours of entertainment for my dogs. I have several dogs, but bought this specifically for my pug. He pushes it around for quite awhile. It didn't take him long to figure our that flipping it usually brings a reward. He seems disappointed when he flips it and there aren't any morsels on the floor, but he keeps at it. Great Product!

Bit loud on the tiles and due to the opening size there is only a few treats other than kibble we can put in. Hours of noisy entertainment for my smart Miniature Pinscher who finds a normal treat ball a little too easy. I also couldn't get the holes to open to adjust the difficulty, had to get someone else to figure it out and have not tried to adjust it since. Would not recommend for soft food as it's hard to get out and can easily get stuck.

I wouldn't say that our puppy loves this item but it certainly keeps her amused. I think she is still figuring it out as all her other toys have been balls that she can roll around or shake. This one requires a bit more delicacy to get the food out and it takes a while to get all the food out. It is made of tough plastic and seems solidly constructed so should last for ages. I usually put about 1 cup of dry food in the large size cube and this seems to work well.I had some difficulty getting the inner cylinder out for the first time.
