I did a cursory search on Amazon for coffee, syrup to be delight not only to find it, but to find the brand we actually used. Somethings you try as an adult for nostalga, end up not tasting quite as good as you remember from your childhood; not the case here. This is as good as I remember and I'm very pleased to have this treat back in my life!I have my coffee milk back, but the versitality of this syrup is endless, I've used it to make mocha cookies and coffee cake (not in just name, but taste.) Thank you!!
Buyers regret:  nice healthier sugar but way to expensive for 4 lbs not even certified as organic.  You can get 25 lbs for roughly twice the price of these 4 at Florida Crystals.
This is a 'must have' for real coffee afficionados  ... and this particular company manages to avoid the hard-as-bricks packaging of rivals.
Used Demerara Sugar at a friends house. Makes everything taste better, alot better. Also came sooner than expected so that was also a delight. Just try it.

I love Republic of Tea's rooibos teas. I bought mine at Whole Foods.  Republic of Tea's teas quality rival Numi's but I think this rooibos tea is even higher in quality than Numi's since you get "double" the dose of usual rooibos so that you get a deeper taste of rooibos and you can see and smell the red rooibos powder lightly dusted off the teabags.  And the packaging is compact and attractive, great as a gift.  What I like about rooibos is that it doesn't have that yucky tasting flowery herbal taste of hibiscus, rosehips, etc that teas like Celestial Seasoning are notoriously known for.  Also, you don't have to feel like Superman trying to break into their teabags (like Numi's) since there are no enclosed individual protective packets around each tea bag.  Rooibos teas are nutty and mellow in taste.Rooibos is healthy, great for skin ailments and calming for anxiety/nervous tension (which is why I love it so much), and it has no caffeine.  I double my health with it by adding raw unprocessed honey but it's really already slightly sweetened so that you don't need a lot of sweetener.  The tea is even better iced.  If it weren't so expensive, I'd get it more often but am forced with the lower cost alternative with Twining's rooibos teas which has a more "hay" taste/smell.

column9: Perfect if you're trying to stay away from caffeine
column10: I got this tea as a gift after delivering my baby. It's perfect if you're trying to stay away from caffeine. I love the taste of it because it's close to black tea only it's not bitter and doesn't dehydrate you.

column9: Not so good.  I like the older versions MUCH better.
column10: I got this because my previous "Republic of Tea" Rooibos tea was so awesome (Botswana Blossom Rooibos) but is no longer available.This Rooibos is poor.
Exactly what I was looking for!! Taste is great and great to drink everyday.I would recommend to everyone who loves tea!
Love the taste and everything else about this tea, every time I'm drinking this tea that smooth taste and smell relax me, I really enjoy that until the last drop. I will buy it again.

I love popcorn. We have popcorn about 4 nights a week. I started out looking for popcorn on the cob as I had that this year and it was lovely, and then stumbled upon India Tree. It's the closest that I can find to the dried on the cob popcorn and I love it. It is so fresh and natural tasting. I've been using it for several months and ran out the other day and had to use a popular store brand. Though the kernels popped up larger, the taste was stale and processed...not to mention, the India Tree popcorn is actually cheaper than the store brand. I'm placing my order for more India Tree right now!

I ordered the popcorn but only received one package for the advertised $20+, not 4 as promised. Amazon refunded the difference, so it was ultimately not a problem. Good product but probably not worth $6 per pound.

This year we grew our own white hulless propcorn and discovered that no product to this point could hold a candle to home grown.  Since I didn't grow a lot I wanted to purchase a product with similar quality and taste.  I purchased the India Tree Paloma Blanca popcorn and while it's good it's not of the same quality but is better than any store purchased white popcorn.I won't purchase this product again as I think it's too expensive for what you get.  I'll be looking to try other brands for less and will triple our planting next year.

column9: who needs cheese when you have chocolate
column10: I purchased these at a "local" target for movie snacks. they are pretty good. any lover of teddy grams will enjoy these. the dry marshmallows are reminiscent of the kind in cereal. they have a tiny grove in them so you can "stack them".I strongly recommend them. what I don't recommend is putting them in a bowl and dumping milk on them.it is a horrible idea and creates and unpleasant gritty slurry.

column9: PEPPERIDGE FARM GOLDFISH CHOCOLATE GRAHAM CRACKERS(PACK OF 8)
column10: A delicious great tasting product by Pepperidge Farm that normally cost you $2.49 per bag, sometimes on sale at the supermarket 2 for $4.00, but I picked my Pepperidge Farm Chocolate Graham Goldfish Crackers (Pack Of 8) through Warehouse Deals fulfilled by Amazon.com and shipped free to my home for an awesome price of ONLY $10.63!!! If you can get a deal like this I highly suggest purchasing it right away! If not, no worries and try getting it a little more than my bargain for no more $13.00 in my opinion, seeing as if you were to pay the retail suggested price on bag for $2.49 X 8 = $19.92 would still be a bargain if you look at it this way like I do! Good Luck and happy bargain shopping, ENJOY!!!
They are better than any other chocolate graham we have purchased so far.  Super chocolatey and not fake tasting at all.  My kids LOVED them!

column9: UNCANNY! Must Buy! Must Have! With Kids or Without Kids!
column10: Amazing! When you can't have a campfire and you've got the craving for S'mores, Pepperidge Farms had created an awesome FUN FISH!Zany as Zany can be - Vanilla Gold Fish, Chocolate Goldfish, and of course - Marshmallow Goldfish - Stack'em up; but make sureyou hide your evidence if you want these to be ALL YOURS or otherwise they'll be gone before you get a chance to be a "kid atheart"! Having bought two bags... thinking I would like these very much (how right I was!)...I was downright impressed, while not the traditional S'mores - but gee whiz; I actually ate the whole danged bag in one sittingwithout even realizing it! *blush*  It was so much fun hunting or is it fishing (?) for one after another and then stacking themtogether and eating "fishbait" - hahahahahaha!Next day, began to open the other bag (already!) and started to munch away ....Until, my grandchildren saw the "evidence" and wahhh :( - Poor Grandma here - ended up having to "share" and goodness gracious,the laughter and giggles from the little ones were far worth it all!I 10,000 times recommend this ... this is the best ever from Pepperidge Farms! Way to go! Now if they can come up with the big box,I'd buy it on Amazon in a heartbeat! Who would ever dream that Pepperidge Farms would come up with this? Just awesome!Interestingly, the very next day; while I had to babysit the youngest grandchild for a short time; she went off looking for somethingthat I had to inquire what she was looking for and she kept saying Whitey, Blackie and Creamy.  Looking everywhere in my room evenunder the bed, leaving me totally bewildered until she sulked and said"Grandma, where did you hide them?""Hide what?""The 3 goldfishies"(puzzled)"The 3 Goldfishes? We don't have Goldfish in the house."(now she is mad with her arms folded)"Yes we do, we ate them yessteday! Grandma, where did you hide them?"(trying not to laugh)"Sweetie, we ate them all up yesterday.""Grandma, buy more. I like them lots! Tummy hungry, says want more goldfish."(points to her stomach)Kids are adorable! <3  If you buy them, make sure you stash some for yourself, they are completelyand you just cannot resist them!
I agree with the other reviewer, but I think cereal marshmallows are gross and never liked teddy grahams that much anyway.

column9: There is no better Brown Creme de Cacao than this
column10: This is the secret to making the best Brandy Alexander's I've ever had. I have found that if you use this Cacao it is not necessary to use an expensive Brandy or Cognac to get a great drink. I suggest 1.5 oz of a decent brandy, 1.5 oz of MB Brown Creme de Cacao and 1.5 oz of heavy whipping cream. You can use less cream if you want or even go with more; I have used as much as 2.25 oz and it is still great. Shake with ice and pour into a Martini glass and then grate some fresh nutmeg on top. When I pour it from the shaker I hold the strainer in such a way that I let little slivers of ice through.I have found that it is well worth it to pay the extra money for Marie Brizzard products as they are far, far superior to the Hiram Walker and DeKuyper products that are generally available. The only problem I have with MB is that there is very limited availability locally so I usually have to buy them online. I am more than happy to pay 20.00 for the MB products a compared to half the price for the lesser brands. The proof is in the cocktails.

We are extremely happy with the service we received from Wabash Valley Farms. We received an e-mail confirming our orders and providing us with a contact person. The gifts were mailed in a timely fashion and the recipients are thrilled with the Whirley Pop poppers and baskets they got for Christmas. It is obvious that Wabash Farms chooses the right products for their gift baskets and the baskets are reasonably priced for the value. Thank you, Wabash!

It's a nice machine but the resultant product is too dry for my palate. My 55yrs. of P-Corn eating experience tells me its due to all the steam created...maybe.  My wife, the moon of my delight, and I experimented and could NOT get "IT" to come out as good as our microwave device.

I've purchased a 2-pack on several occasions.  All but one of the bags has been excellent - fresh, sweet, chewy dried mango.  The one bag was somewhat bitter (still edible, just not as good as all the other bags), so there is apparently some variation, as expected for natural fruit.  But overall, a solid product.

Although I've had to do without for a couple months (summer 2010) now while my subscribe-and-save order is held due to unavailability (sigh), I have to say that this is my favorite dried fruit. If I'm not careful, I can eat a pound per week (another sigh). Not TOO sweet, but very flavorful....perfect munchy food. I've tried the dried pineapple (tasteless), the dried cherries (like bitter raisins), and the dried pears (not as sweet as my own dried pears). I LOVE that there is no added sugar! I can hardly wait for this great snack to be available again and my suggestion is to snip up a couple pieces into your morning oatmeal, cook and sprinkle with ginger, cinnamon and chopped almonds. I stir in organic yogurt or kefir as well. Yummy!August 28, 2010 - Just received order and please note that the pieces are small, mostly square as shown in the photo. I liked them when they were larger slices just as well. First bag tested pieces seem to be softer. Same marvelous mango taste but now it's even harder to stop eating them!September 2010 - next order was of large slices again

These true to taste pieces (about 1/2" square) are a very satisfying sweet snack. When rehydrated, they are very good pureed for a drink (w/tonic, club soda or a juice you like-- or maybe a 'smoothie'. Good dessert topping. I used it in a marinade on chicken. The 2-pack on sale is a good price. Hope they'll be back in stock during the sale.
This product is excellent. I love it. It is soft and chewy not tough. My only problem is that when you get to the end it is only crumbs.

column9: Bare Fruit Products are fantastic and healthy!
column10: This is the second or third item I've gotten from Bare Fruits and they've all been outstanding!!!There's no added sugar or fat so the calories are low and the flavor is high!!! I have recommended Bare Fruits to everyone I know!!! I think other companies should do business like the Bare Fruit Company and produce healthy snacks for Americans. Most fruit and vegetable chips have a lot of added junk!

column9: Danger! Danger! You'll not be able to stop eating these!
column10: These mangoes are pure quality. No disgusting after-taste like so many other brands. There are no sulfites or added sweetners just the pure fruit. Highly recommend them but beware because you will not be able to put them down.

All I can say is NOM NOM NOM NOM NOM....I can eat 4 lbs in a couple days. : OTo whoever thought this review wasn't helpful. Ok, ok, maybe I could've expanded a little bit on the textures, tastes, things like that. Sure.The mangos come in a vacuum sealed bag so they are fresh as soon as you open the bag, I suggest storing them somewhere air-tight to increase the longevity, although I cannot keep any for a long period of time because they will get eaten. These have a bit of fiber to them and some iron. The fiber helps with regularity. The taste is that of fresh mangos, with a slightly sort of fresh-baked scent and taste. The texture is slightly tough and fibery at the random folded and smooshed pieces or chunks. But over-all the fresh from the bag mangos are soft and chewy easy to rip apart and digest. 2 Bags is enough to last a few weeks if you eat sparingly, as probably should be done. If you eat too much you will probably experience a slight digestive detox due to the fiber content. Again, they do get a little harder if you don't seal them up properly, so I suggest an air-tight storage.Over all an excellent snack and product. Shipping is on-time and the quality various from very good, to slightly as good, but in MHO it's always been very good no matter what.:.  How's that?

*****These dried mango snacks are sweet, chewy, and yummy! They are 100% certified organic, baked with no added sugar, no preservatives or chemicals, no pesticides or herbicides, and they are gluten free. They are almost as chewy as fruit leather, though (about the same as jerky), so you'll need good healthy teeth to be able to chew them. They are the best and freshest-tasting dried mango I've tried. Buying them in bulk makes such an exotic treat affordable.Highly recommended.*****

It's nearly impossible to find Mango in the store that isn't completely coated in sugar, this mango is great because it's not.  The mango is perfectly sweet on its own without needing additional sweetener.  I am so happy with this light and healthy snack.  I have been having it auto shipped to my house every month for the last three, and so far the product consistency has been great.

I love dried mangos and I have purchased quit a variety of them and I must say this is one of the best on the market.Its very fresh and keeps fresh for a long time if you store it well in glass jars.It tastes great and there is no added sugar.Its a good deal compared to store prices.  Thanks amazon and bare fruit!

Small pieces, as if the fruit was run through a machine. Not as good as the local health food store stuff but almost half price as well. Tastes good, although not having a big hunk in your hand to bite off a little at a time causes me to eat too much at one time.

column9: LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE them!
column10: These are SO yummy!  My two young daughters and I finished off both bags in less than 48 hours! Next time I'm going to have to ration them more!  I couldn't stop eating them!!!

Great Product! wonderful smell when you open the package.  No preservatives! I'm allergic to sulfur and sodium base preservatives.  So it is difficult for me to find a product that tastes great and maintains an appealing color.  This is it for me.  I'm going to give this company's other products a try.

My daughter has life threatening food allergies, so it's important we have safe dried foods she can eat in case of emergency. That said, I think she would eat these daily if I let her! Very tasty and packed with nutrients. Although my preference on a daily basis is whole fresh fruit, this is great as a back up for her. Best of all, it's organic, no added sugar or preservatives, and it's gluten free.

column9: Just what they say they are
column10: Dried mango, no sulfur or sugar.  Very yummy.  I have bought these several times.  Sometimes they are cut into convenient cereal-addition size, and sometimes they are pancake size.  Either way they are good, and a good deal.  Fresh mangoes are yummy but risky.

column9: SOOO good! Decent/market rate price at $13.99/lb
column10: Tastes wonderful! I don't know why the sugared mango is the most common. Not only does the natural dried mango taste better, it is better for you! Price is acceptable market rate at 13.99/lb for no sugar added variety (regular sugary mango runs about 6.50/lb). You would think it would be the same price or cheaper as the sugary mango since they have one less ingredient to add!

column9: The Fruit is, in fact, BARE
column10: As the name implies, the fruit is actually 'bare' without a natural mango taste.  Perhaps its because the product is baked dry exterminating necessary nutrients.We prefer our fruit raw; and if dried (preserved), certainly not cooked..............................Two alternative products are:Klein's Naturals Mango, Organic, (Pack of 6)Sunridge Farms Organic Mango Slices, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)

I bought this product after reading all the favorable reviews.  I loved that the product was organic, with no added sugar or preservatives.  But when it arrived, I found it to be too thinly sliced and too dehydrated -- not at all soft or chewy like the dried mango I usually get.  It also wasn't very flavorful.  Maybe it was just a bad batch, but I won't be ordering it again.

While most pieces taste like mango it is not a very good mango taste.  Pieces range from 1" X 1" X 1/8" squares to 1/4" x 1/4" fragments.  It is very dry, the mental image of eating thin strips of leather form in my mind when I eat it.A bag of dried mango lasts a max of one day in our house.  The first bag is still half full after 3 weeks.As you can probably guess I won't be buying more.

LOVE LOVE these dried mango without anything in it.No sugar, no preservatives, no nothing.The only reason I give a 3 star reviews is thatthe pieces are inconsistent in size and in thickness.Some are nice and thick and full of flavor, some arevery small and thin and very dried up.If the consistency is good, I would totally give it a 5 star.I will definitely order again.Kinda pricey but a great healthy snack!

Used to love Bare Fruit mango when it was cut into little squares/rectangles and the fruit was chewy, tasty, slightly moist.  Now their mango is sold in slices like in the bulk bins at groceries, really dry, and it tastes stale.  So disappointed.  Bring back the old mango!!!

column9: A lot of dark and off-color pieces and plenty of dirt particles
column10: Each time I eat this I get what feels like when you swallow a pill the wrong way and you feel like it's stuck in your throat.  I don't know why.  It doesn't happen to me any other time.  I like their apple chips and enjoy those, but these are just horrible.  So many almost black or grey pieces and plenty of dirt particles on some of the pieces.  No, it's not supposed to look that way since there are pieces that have the proper nice orange or yellow color typical of a mango.  So, I don't know what they are doing, unless they are using over-ripe mangoes.  I will not buy this product again, and I have to throw the rest out since I can't return it.  I will stick with their apple chips.

column9: I'm a nut for dried mango
column10: I only like the sugar free mango.  The sugar added ruins the taste.  This and Much ado about mango are the best.  This one has a better price but my grandchildren went through the bag like they were woodchippers.  The smaller bags slow down the consumption; as a result, they end up being cheaper per month.  This product had smaller pieces; however, the small pieces were absolutely delicious.  Much Ado About Mango has changed their equipment and their product doesn't taste as good as it used to.  This Bare Fruit actually tastes like the old Much ado about Mango which is delectible.  Trader Joes is the cheapest but isn't consistent at all.  Sometimes it tastes like plastic smells.
Looveeee It! A must for Mango lovers. Definitely has that natural taste..can't wait for my next shipment to get here
Best dried mango I've ever had. Problem is I can't stop eating them- they're too good! They're chewy, not too dry.
the dried mango has a very good taste. Very sweet. The chunks are not difficult to eat, like some other brands. the only "but" is the pieces are a bit too small to my taste.
Bear Fruit mangos are the best tasting mangos I ever tasted, and they're organic.  They're naturally sweet with no added sugar and better than any desert for less calories.  A must buy.

Best natural snack ever. PERIOD.  Delicious.  NO ADDED SWEETENERS. Just pure organic mango goodness.  These are the sweet treats of the Gods.I decided to search for natural dried fruit(no added sugars) when I tasted yet another misleading brand. They make it look natural, but hide the fact that they douse the delicious natural fruit with sugar!  It totally ruins the fruit. I looked on Amazon for the real deal.  Here it is.  Satisfied by the reviews, I bought. I can tell you now I'm totally satisfied, and am going to keep on being that way with this all natural organic sustenance.I can also tell you that as should be expected, the pieces vary with taste and flavor. I can taste different parts of the mangos involved, as well as different ripeness. You'll know when you get a really good piece--you'll want to just put it on your tongue and suck on it :)This is what nature intended, a very healthy snack. Great product!

I like both fresh and dried mango - I just like the flavor and taste and all good things about mango. I had tried other dried mango before, they were either too sweet (coated with sugar powder) or too expensive (my school store sells 4.99 for just few ounces).Ever since I found Bare Fruit bake-dried fruits, they substitutes all other snacks I've ever had!!I like the crispy dried apple; and I LOVE this tasty chewy dried mango. I had expect their dried mango to be as crispy as their dried apple, and only found out that the dried mangoes are just awsome! It's not over sweet, the flavor is sooooo good. No sugar No artificial sustances were added; besides, the taste is really good! It's bit dry and not as moist as most brands, but it's still tender and chewy, making it a perfect snack for movie time or sweet-tooth time :)
This is okay, it seems a little bit too dry and chewy for my taste.  But the flavor is pretty good.  Just not big on the texture.

These are cut into small squares, sweet, chewy, and delicious! I have two toddlers that love mangos! I prefer unsweetened, unsulfured fruit and this is the best way I have found to buy them that is cost effective. We haven't gotten a bitter batch yet, but it could happen. It's real fruit without added sugar so you never know... Love love love this product!!

I read through most of the reviews before ordering this product. I usually buy organic dried mango (no sugar added) at Whole Foods. Yes, it is going to be drier and more leather-like, but that's because it's organic and has no sugar. The dried mango that has sugar is more chewy. Be aware of this before you buy. However, I had found that the organic dried mango actually tastes like real mango. I loved the bite size pieces. The texture and flavor varied throughout the bag, but that did not deter me. It's dried fruit. NOT EVERY MANGO IS GOING TO LOOK AND TASTE THE SAME fresh or dried. I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND this product. I am going to purchase it agian.
Great air sealed packaging product is delicious and rapid delivery I highly recommend great source of energy and quick pick me up.

The price isn't bad.  However, the pieces of mango are small and a little too dry.  I was hoping the package would be of nice larger pieces like you get in a bag from Trader Joes.  I had signed up for the subscription, hoping to have an ongoing supply of dried mango, as our family loves it.  However, after our first delivery of it, we have cancelled our subscription and will look elsewhere.

The only problem with these mangos is that I eat them too fast.  They would be really cheap, if the bags did not disappear so quickly.Do not expect something packaged in fancy containers.  These are cheap because they are just barebones organic good food.
My whole family is addicted to these.  They are sweet but not too sweet.  A wonderful,quick,& healthy snack.I keep a bag in my car at all times for a quick snack on the go.
just purchased these and they were exactly what i was hoping for--a healthy, sweet, natural snack to munch on while studying.  it's literally just baked mangoes and nothing else.  highly recommend!

I almost ate the whole bag in one sitting. One of the greatest alternative to the FRESH mango.Thank God for self-control--only ate 1/2 bag in one sitting.These bite-sizes pieces are addictive--if you're TRULY a fan of the mango.

I am extremely disappointed in the 2 pound pack deal. The mangos were not bite size, they were WHOLE slivers of mangos, some over 3". They were mostly extremely dry and tasteless. It seemed as if Bare Fruits puts their unusable left overs into those large 1# packages, you will receive a total of 2# with this order. A complete opposite to the smaller packages which I enjoy tremendously. I will only order the small packages in the future to avoid a debacle like this again. The bite size mango pieces in the small packages are chewy, tasty and a wonderful snack.

column4: B. COLE "tellin it like it is"
column10: i ordered these because i had purchased the 2.6 ounce packages before and really really loved them, in the tiny little pieces all chewy and good... but when i opened up my box from amazon today, they were two bags of giant pieces... i figured what the heck, its the same fruit so i would give them a try. after opening one bag, i found that they are basically like mago potato chips, all dry and stiff... NOTHING like the dried mango you get in the 2.6 ounce packages where it is small bite sized pieces that melt in your mouth and are chewy... these are big pieces that will snap in half if you bend them.... i will not be purchasing these again, its worth the extra cash to get the small bags , at least you know what you are getting....
These really tasted bad. I would not recommend them at all.The taste was awful. Buy the apples, they are good.The mangos are flat, no taste , a waste of money

I've been looking for dried organic mango that is as delicious as that carried by Whole Foods, which only sporadically carries it in their bulk foods area.  This was not the mango I was searching for.  It was toooo dry and didn't exactly taste like mango -- it almost tasted more like dried persimmon.  It wasn't terrible -- that is, my family ate up the two pounds -- but not with the anticipated level of joy.
very good and fairly priced --- like trader joes better but there isn't a trader joes where i live so will buy these again :-)

column9: Not bad, for a good price.
column10: Unfortunately these dried mangos are not as pictured.  Instead of the smaller bite-size pieces as pictured, described as soft and light in some reviews, I received the sliced version, which seems to be a little drier and chewier than I expected.  Also did not have as much flavor as other brands I have purchased.  They're not bad though, and it is an excellent price for the quantity, even better when purchased through Subscribe & Save.

Anyone who says that these don't taste like mango clearly has never dehydrated mango bits his- or herself. These are FANTASTIC. They are, hands down, my favorite snack. I keep a bag in my desk drawer at work, and one in the cabinet at home, ALWAYS in stock. $20-25 for 2 lbs of dried mango is a fantastic deal, too, especially for organic fruit. These are amazing in muffins, cookies, any sweet snacks, they are great plain, dipped in chocolate, peanut butter, whatever. There are a million things you can do with these. I hope Bare Fruit ends up with more dried organic fruit... I'd love to see papaya, kiwi, etc. For now, the mango and pineapple are AMAZING... have yet to try the apple and others.

I have been trying to watch what I eat and have started carrying some dried fruit in my bag for those times I cannot carry apples or other fruit.  This fruit tastes great and is now one of my favorites that I have tried.  On tip is to put a serving size into a smaller bag to make sure you do not eat too many, I did find myself eating a bit too much if I had the big bag around.
Delicious flavor and texture- not too tough.  I especially appreciate that there are no sulfites or added sugar!Reasonable price and altogether a solid product.  I will order regularly.
I will definitely order this again. It melts in your mouth. The texture is light. When I brought it to work, the whole bag disappeared in minutes.
This is an excellent product. No added ingredients, nice an soft, tasty. As good as it gets.
Really good product!  I've had other brands of dried mango that were not as tasty or fresh.  There was no seed "silk" found.

I should have read other comments with 1 or 2 stars!I usually order dried mangoes from other brands and they are a little pricey, so I decided to try this one: It's price looks reasonable and it says it's organic. It's been two minutes since I received it and I already started to feel regret for this product. As other people mentioned it was cut in too small pieces, so too dry, and sometimes hard to chew. Dried mangoes are not supposed to be this dry. I suspect that this company imported dried mangoes from Southeast Asia in big boxes and divided them into smaller bags.It tastes less sweet than all dries mangoes I have ever had: it tastes like dried apricots or apples, more sour than sweet. I don't know whether other manufacturers add sugar when they dry mangoes and this one doesn't or these ones are just a less sweet(worse) kind because the bags don't have any nutrition info. I cannot return it because it comes in an aluminum bag and I already opened it. If it came in a plastic bag I would have definitely returned it.In sum, this is not dried mangoes that I expected. I give two stars only because it's less expensive than other dried mango brands. I know there are many people who like it and I strongly recommend they try other brands: they are more juicy, sweet and flavorful.

The picture has mangoes in squares and the two times I ordered the mangoes they were in whole pieces. When I asked to know what happened they wouldn't or couldn't tell me and I don't think I am going to order food from Amazon ever again.

I didn't actually taste this, but I thought it had a strange smell.  My husband and my son love the dried mango we get at Costco so I thought I'd try this since it's organic.  Neither one of them will eat it....they think it has a strange taste.  Unfortunately, I might as well have thrown $20 in the trash can because that's where this mango ended up.

I used to be able to buy these at our local grocery store but recently I found that they were no longer on the shelves. Of course I found them on Amazon.com and brought them right away; they arrived in just a few days. And they are just delicious! Hot and spicy but not so spicy that you can't eat them - we put them in taco salads, omelets, on regular green salads, you name it. Buy some, you won't regret it at all!

column9: Mario's Sliced Black Olives with Jalapeno are a cut above!
column10: Having ordered these 3 TIMES I consider myself a budding afficionado!  Mario's is a perfect sliced olive nicely paired with fresh chopped jalapeno bits, at the ready for whatever culinary treat you may have in mind.  I've put these in omelettes, salads, nachos...even pizza.  At 60 cals for the whole 2.25 oz. can, you can afford to splurge and just ENJOY them. The buttery richness of Mario olives rivals Black Pearl, and their light jalapeno heat is SPOT-ON.  Mildly spiced at 1 star's worth of warmth, you'll experience full FLAVOR, without the burning lips.  OLIVE HEAVEN!

Light Muscovado is a caramel light brown sugar with the flavors of earth and sky somehow infused into dreamy sweet perfection. All other light brown sugars can't compare to this quality and if you want the best light brown sugar for baking, I can't imagine anything could be more delicious.Light Muscovado is slightly moist, has a medium molasses content and is delicious in gingerbread, coffee cake, cookies and chocolate cake. It is delicious with a Farina porridge in the morning or can be stirred into tea.I first found this sugar while working at Larry's Market in Seattle. The India Tree company is also located in Seattle and has some amazing sugar products for baking and decorating.Also recommended: Dark Muscovado is also deeply delicious and once you use the Muscovado sugars, there is no escape. You will crave the rich flavors and high molasses content of this delicious sugar from Mauritius.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Excellent Flavor - A Good Brand of Sugar
column10: I bought both the light as well as the dark muscovado sugar. The flavor of the muscovado sugar is intense and is excellent. I used it for baking as well as in desserts and I never go back to the standard brown sugar anymore. It comes in a pack of 4, 1 pound each which is a lot. I wish they will sell it in smaller packages. Out of the 4 packs that I received, 1 pack was already dried out and hardened. I can still use it but I had to literally break up the sugar in order to use it, which is a lot of work. This is typical of brown sugar when it has been kept for too long or it wasn't stored in a cool dry place, hence my request for smaller packages.

I have never tried Muscovado sugar, and I can say it is delicious. Less processing = more natural nutrition that is essentially non existent in typical brown sugar. We went with the light Muscovado in case the molasses taste was too strong. You can still definitely smell and taste some great molasses flavor in this sugar. It went great in a homemade apple pie, cookies, oatmeal, coffee, tea, etc. Good stuff.

Great for sweetening coffee and oatmeal. I have found many amazing things to do with muscovado sugar and I will never go back to artificial sweeteners again!!Another one I constantly use is the brand called EL MAESTRO and I usually buy it on ebay. It has a pure, strong molasses taste much that I absolutely love. I believe its imported from the Philippines where they specialize in that. Don't get me wrong, both El Maestro and India Tree are amazing products!!But yeah, you can't compare muscovado sugar to any other sugars out there. Perfect with any recipe, especially coffee and tea... and marinating meats!

The taste factor of my baked goods has gone up several notches of deliciousness (word?) since switching to this brown sugar. There is no comparison to the usual grocery store stuff! I could even tell the difference in quality just by the smooth texture and yummy aroma of this muscovado. Chocolate chip cookes, candies, any baking at all will taste wonderful using this product. The quality really comes through.

I use sugar for most of my tea's and coffee's. My girl brought back some sugar from Mauritius before, and I thought I would not be able to find it again. And now we are reunited once again. I see it at some specialty grocery stores, but the price here on Amazon is pretty good and all of the packs come fresh. It has a nice subtle molasses flavor to it, and it really goes well with drinks. I havent used it for cooking yet, but I guess it would work too. I would absolutely recommend this sugar.

Very good flavor.  I really like it and can doctor it up with other flavors such as Worchestashire sauce.  Love the low salt.  Did not really expect such big envelor of  these, but I just use 4 T of the powder and a cup of water to make the amount I need.,

Bars are around the size of slices of nature valley together. (maybe a little thinner). They are sweet, and I can usually eat 1 or 2 instead of 5 chewy brand bars. For 40-45 dollars, the weight/price ratio is better than 20 dollars for 60 tiny chewy bars. Since they are my only snack atm, I've gotten a little tired of eating these bars after two boxes. The almonds ones only have 1-3 almonds per bar.
Good value, easy to dispense and they taste great.  My husband has them for a snack every day and has me reorder when they start getting down.  He wants them on hand.

column9: St. Dalfour Gourmet On The Go Wild Alaskan Salmon
column10: As a person with Celiac disease it is ALWAYS a challenge to find prepared food that tastes good.  This product is not only gluten free, but it contains WILD Salmon, not farm raised, which I greatly prefer. It also contains veggies like potatoes, carrots & flageolet beans, so it not only tastes GREAT, but it's healthy, as well! It's one of those foods you'll find yourself craving...I love it and highly recommend it to anyone, gluten free or not!

Unfortunately I am completely disappointed with this product. I have an above-average sense of smell, but this extract has hardly any detectable flavor in the bottle and none whatsoever once added to food. Perhaps I received part of a faulty batch? The seller is letting me return the bottle, but is requiring that I pay for shipping again, so I would be very unlikely to order from them again.
Lacks the flavor I was hoping for and the price was a bit high for the satisfaction level.  I won't be ordering this again.  Live and learn.
I had searched everywhere for this flavor and here it was a few key touches away. Thanks for making shopping a bedside activity for me.

I just can't imagine anyone writing a negative review about dark chocolate covered cherries. What is not to love? The more bitter the chocolate the better. These were very good. Out of the 72 that came in the box only about 6 leaked liquid out. Not bad considering they were shipped all the way to Afghanistan. I shared them with a select group of individuals but mainly ate them all myself. They are irresistible. I will be buying more before summer. I wouldn't want them to melt in transit in the heat of summer.

This candy arrived quickly but some of the cherry candies were stuck to the foil paper that enclosed each piece.  Probably a result of not being fresh and in Amazon's inventory for a long time or subject to high heat in a inventory closet and not in a refrigerated space.

If you think of coffee more as an "experience" than as a utilitarian beverage, all I can say is this is the stuff for you. It's a unique flavor but one that really works. I can't wait to try some of their other flavors!
Product was good, fresh, just right.  The cakes arrived uncrushed and in great shape.  Service was quick too, just as you would want it to be.

My kitty Petunia, received a bag of these treats for Christmas from a friend. She runs when she hears me take the bag out of the kitchen drawer. She is pretty finicky, but absolutely loves these treats. So we ordered lots from Amazon. Yum!

column9: It's not fresh but the next best thing.
column10: I use this and other mushrooms from JR. I buy in 16oz bags and usually keep Chantrelle, porchini and black trumpet on hand. The package contains a nice selection of mushrooms and is dust free. I use the various mushrooms for mostly pasta dishes and when mixed with some prosciutto bits, the flavor is great. The shipper ships what is advertised and is very efficient.

column9: Not worth the price...buy fresh localy if you can.
column10: I tried these and must say they are not a very good deal for the money.  I even got a response from the seller (although no offer to refund my money).  Look for a local seller and save your money and taste buds for fresh.
Everything was packaged well, but there were no instructions on how to reconstitute them, had to go online and the mushrooms were not to my liking at all!!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: Truly heavenly - the best tea I have ever tasted
column10: I discovered Heavenly Tea Leaves through their web site a few months ago when I was looking for a good way to cut back on my coffee and go tea. I have ordered several of their different flavors and have always enjoyed them.

This is a really nice variety of teas.  I like having a different one each day.  A couple of the teas I can't believe are a top sellers and taste like wood and gunpowder. But most of the teas are wonderful.  You don't have to use very much so it goes a long way.  And the containers are great with the glass top to use for other things later. The cost is pretty high I think, but the quality and taste of the tea is very good so overall I would say it is worth having the samples so you know which tea you like and which ones you don't care for at all.

These teas are great. Each type has such a wonderful scent. They are all enjoyable. I took them to work because that is where I like to drink tea. All of my co-workers loved the smell and had to try some as well. I had to buy a tea press for these but it was worth it. Nothing but nice things to say. This is a very nice and different type of treat.

I received this tea sampler kit as a gift and I couldn't be happier. The flavors are wonderful and very varied. They are sweet enough that I don't need sweetener, but definitely not too sweet. They smell wonderful too. I honestly think loose leaf teas are the way to go.

My boyfriend bought me this tea as part of a birthday gift and I must admit, I was a little intimidated at first! There are so many different kinds of teas in this particular variety pack, many of which I'd never heard of. It's important not to over-brew the tea and to use the right amount with water, but it isn't difficult to adjust the amounts depending on personal preference. I love, love, love this tea! It's been a wonderful gift, and I look forward to my morning and afternoon cups every day :) In fact, I'm having a cup of rooibos chocolate mint as I type. All of these teas also work really well with the Kati brewing system found on teaforte.com. Check it out!

column9: Made a Good Gift for Tea Lovers
column10: We ordered this for a gift but have not seen it or tasted it ourselves.  Bought this for my Mother-in-law for Mother's Day with the hope that she would like it.  She did like it very much!  Enjoyed the nice packaging and said the tea varieties were a nice way to sample different flavors.No complaints.Good luck!

I'm no tea expert - I just appreciate a nice tasting cup of tea. This sampler of different teas is a delight! I was surprised by the rich flavor of the organic peppermint, chamomile, and I just love the delicious organic chocolate rooibos mint tea. Organic white has a lovely smooth flavor I enjoy every day before I go to work.Well done tea - I was so impressed I ordered more of my favorites from their website :)
Never had these enforce and just got a small sample packet and it was FABULOUS!!!  Can't wait til it's available. Yummers!
People wallmart sel it for $1.79 a box in the stores and on line!!!!! Where do you get the nerve to charge $4 for each box?

I absolutely love "Maxwell House International Cafe Iced Latte", but I'm afraid I got ripped off by buying this. Each individual box would have been $4.79, whereas I could buy the same exact thing from Walmart for $1.78 per box. Needless to say I will not be buying this from Amazon again.Yes, it's my fault... I should have done the math before I bought it, not after. What can I say... I was craving it and I wasn't thinking. But trust me, this stuff is absolutely DELICIOUS!

Bought this drink mix as a substitute for coffee and just love it.  Mix with Skim Plus and you save a few calories and it's still great!Cannot find it in stores and ordering online saved my day. It always feels like a treat!

Love this scent I call it MAN ICE CREAM cause if there ever was ,this is what it will smell like  . Too much is bad though that "pits to chesty " idea just puts too much on ur body not attractive at all.

I have recently purchased Bob's Red Mill Dark Rye, Organic Flour. Rye has a flavor all its own but I for one Love it. I used this flour in making Dark Bread. Turned out great. Make sure you follow the receipe. Happy eating home made Bread...

I regularly read reviews on other products,but decided not to because I like skittles and thought I would get what the picture shows. Like everyone else no tropical skittles, I got this for the tropical and berry skittles. I can get the original anywhere, very disappointed.
i was very disappointed when there were no tropical skittles, those are my favorite. Now i have alot of regular and a few of others

Like other reviews, which I did not read before I ordered, the box does not come as pictured.  My 10 year old is going to be disappointed there aren't any tropical skittles which are very hard to find.
Please be warned, this item is NOT what the description claims!  You only get 10 Original Skittles, 4 Wild Berry Skittles, 4 Sour Skittles, 6 Original Starburst, 6 Tropical Starburst.

column9: Wasn't exactly what I was looking for...but turned out to be better!
column10: When I ordered this variety pack I had done so in order to get the all-too-hard-to-find tropical skittles.  Unfortunately, I did not receive any tropical skittles.  Instead, I received extra packs of original skittles.  Everything else in the picture displayed was provided so I just missed out on the tropical skittles.  When addressed, the seller was more than helpful by responding quickly and also by promptly offering me a refund.  I would gladly do business with this seller again!

The product came in a timely manner but it did not come with all the types of skittles there was no tropical skittle in the one i recieved. There was also and abundence of Regular skittles well very few of the others.

First off, the picture is not what the pack actually has.  There are some regular Skittles, some tropical Skittles, and the rest are Fizzle Skittles, which taste like Alka-Seltzer.  For the Starburst, half of them are original, then there are some with very nasty flavors, like banana-kiwi, which is just disgusting.  Overall 2.5 / 5 stars because only half of the pack (all of the originals) were good and the rest I had to give away (too nasty to eat, but fun to watch friends try them).
Got these for my husband who was deployed. He loved them, and I snacked on some too. haha. But good deal and good variety

These cookies are really delicious!  You can't find them anywhere in the United States.  The outside of the cookie is crispy and light.  The inside filling is like a dry raspberry jam.  IT IS SOOOOOO good!  It is easy to eat the ENTIRE box in one sitting.  La Paille D'Or just came out with a blueberry filling, but you can only get those in Europe or in Tahiti!  Enjoy.

I'm generally more of a chocoholic, but the delicious pure raspberry flavor, wonderful light texture, and simplicity of these cookies has won me over! One box comes with 3 foil wrapped smaller packages within, which is convenient. Make sure to get some if you go to France, where they're reasonably priced.

These cookies are the absolute treat for someone who likes light, fruity snacks. The waffles are airy and the filling is sweet and fragrant with a hint of acidity. They are very light and never filling. Delicious!

Like other reviewer's here, we've tried several of Betty Lou's delicious, healthy snacks in our home, including the peanut butter and the spirulina nut butter balls, but these Betty Lou's Coconut Macadamia Nut Butter Balls have become our new favorite. They are low in carbs, high in protein and thoroughly tasty. The coconut coating is particularly enticing. An excellent, convenient, nutritious snack for anytime of the day. Betty Lou strikes again!

I've been gluten free for about three months, and as someone with a sweet tooth, I've been a bit bummed lately at the lack of easy and quick treats I can find or keep on hand.I went to the health food store and bought one of these individually to give it a try. I opened it in the car and almost went back in for more right then! Only the rain and a need to get on with my day held me back. I will most definitely be buying more.If you like macaroons, these are fairly similar, crunchy but chewy, soft, sweet and tasty.
These are very good, peanut and coconut. Better warmed up in the microwave for a few seconds.

Betty Lou's Coconut Macadamia Balls would be a much sought after snack at our home if only they were not soooooo sicky sweet.  I do realize that probably a lot of people love "food" that is that sweet.At our house, we do not consider snacks that have a large dose of natural sweetness to them in need of excess agave and stevia to make them taste like pure candy.  We would definitely eat these snacks regularly if they tasted like the coconut and macnut, instead of like concentrated sweeteners!Try the Spirulina Ginseng Balls! They are AWESOME and very well liked, even by our children. The Spirulina Balls are also great for energy, and you know you are getting food worth eating, even when on the run!  I love that these healthy little guys fit in my purse or pocket for a quick snack OR when I have to miss a meal.

Great healthy food - great breakfast snack if on the go - good protein to carb ratio - highly recommend - Betty Lou is a real person with a real passion for creating healthy foods for her family - check out the Betty Lou website and see for yourself.
Try the spirulina nut balls. These are too artificial testing. Only eat them if I have no other food in the house.

It's a matter of taste but these are sweet and healthy as a snack.  I prefer the peanut butter balls which are my favorite but this is not to say the Macadamia balls aren't as flavorful.  They are filling and I suspect healthier than a candybar.  I have children with Celiac Disease.  It's hard to find safe pre-made snacks for them to eat and this fits the bill.  Being individually wrapped, they slip into a purse or can sit by the bedside for hunger cravings.  Not all the Betty Lou's products list gluten-free so one needs to read each one carefully.  Also these products list that they may be made in a factory which may also process wheat products so for people being extra careful with gluten contact, this may not be a product for you.
I've tried the peanut butter, but these taste so much better!  I'm ordering 2 more boxes!  10g of protein on such a yummy treat!

column9: Better than the best macaroon you've ever had!
column10: These are amazingly delicious!  In fact, I wish they were half as good, so I would not be tempted to eat so many.  I love all the Betty Lou's products I've tried and I'm here at Amazon to buy more because they have the best price.

I bought these because I have a corn allergy and wanted to substitute them for the LA Weightloss bars that list corn syrup as the first ingredient.  I was pleasantly surprised that they were pretty tasty! My favorites are actually the Fudgie Filberts that taste similar to a Little Debbie brownie if Little Debbie's were diet. Following that I would say Almond and Coconut are tied for second. Third is the Peanut Butter which is the highest in protein but not as good as the others. My husband didn't like any of them but could tolerate the one I liked least, Peanut Butter.  Over all I think these are great as a healthy snack for people with food allergies or other dietary restrictions. I think I would have picked a different name than Betty Lou's Nut Butter Balls.  Nut Butter Balls doesn't sound as appetizing as what they actually are!! Nut Butter Balls.....Mmmmmm!

They are kindof on the bland side, and I'd rather spend my calories elsewhere!  But they are on the low-carb side.150 calories, 7g total fat (2g saturated), 8g sugar, 5g fiber, 1g sugar alcohol, 10g protein.
for the price, these are too good- the kid and husband finished off the box in about 4 days....super-yummy

My older daughter and I love these, they taste great and are filling and a good snack or even meal substitute.  However my younger daughter is allergic to something in them, even though she has eaten all of the ingredients separately with no problem.  She is also allergic to blackberries so maybe there is some kind of connection there.  She took one bite and then said they caused her mouth to itch and feel weird.  After she said this, I realized I also felt this, but maybe to a lesser degree and definitely not enough for me to stop eating it!!  They are pretty awesome, but I wish I knew why they cause an allergic reaction in my 13 yr. old daughter.
I bought these because I didn't get the almond balls.These coconut nut butter balls tastes much better. My kid likes it too.
This s a wonderful alternative to a brownie or cookie, and is actually good for you! I didn't expect these to be so good, and the price Is quite reasonable too. If you like coconut, try these!
I love coconut balls! Betty Lou made me so happy when they started making this flavour. Its really a delicious treat/snack. Try the Pecan, Almond, and Spirulina ones too!!

I got these on a whim... another impulse buy while killing time on Amazon when I'm supposed to be doing something productive. I was scoping some high protein snacks and I was immediately seduced by the combination of words coconut/macadamia/nut butter. And balls. These shipped really fast and I tried one as soon as I opened the box. The "balls" are chewy and sweet and taste like candy, but with that protein-powder taste. I happen to like that taste so I think it's great. The coconut flake on the outside is super good but not much macadamia flavor comes through. Still really good though. I will definitely be eating these when I am craving something sweet or stash some in my school bag to take on the go. I want to try some of the other flavors in the future, but I am going to try to make this box last... yeah, like that will really happen! I wish they came in a multi-flavored sampler pack. Or rather, a sack. A sack would definitely be better. Thumbs up for these yummy balls!

column9: Excellent Nutritional Profile: High Protein, Low Sugar
column10: EDIT 1/2/2012So I picked up a new box of these recently and they taster AWEFUL.  Note in my review below that I previously liked these.  There obviously was some sort of manufacturing defect at work or a really bad formula change...but this is less likely as they really just tasted "off".  Instead of the "buttery", nutty flavor it was dry and "chemical" tasting.  I may try one more time (buying from a different source), but this experience at least highlights a deficiency in quality control.ORIGINAL-------I guess taste is a personal preference, but as someone who enjoys coconut, I really like the taste of these.The Nutritional Profile on these is excellent:- 10g of protein in a 40g serving is a powerful protein punch- Only 2g Saturated fat compares very well to other bars- Only 8g of sugar.  Without use of artificially sweeteners, this is among the lowest I have seen in such bars- Gluten and Soy free are also goodOn the downside- They contain dairy, specifically Whey protein (personally I'd rather have Soy)If you were considering Betty Lou's Almond Butter High Protein Balls, 1.75-Ounce Packages (Pack of 18) for your protein needs, you may want to reconsider.  These coconut macadamia are 25% protein, while the Almond Butter are actually 24% with a bigger serving, more calories, and less Fiber.A comparable bar (in terms of nutritional profile) to this coconut macadamia ball, and without the dairy, is coconut macadamia KIND PLUS, Almond Walnut Macadamia + Protein, Gluten Free Bars (Pack of 12).

I had high hopes for these, especially based on many raving reviews, but I don't like them much. There is a very intense aftertaste, much like the taste you get from some artificially flavored/sweetened whey powders. It's amazing actually that I really love pretty much all the ingredients of this separately, but when they put it together it's pretty bad! They would be really satisfying as a healthy, high-energy snack ... if they just tasted a little/a lot better.

column9: Delicious & healthy, couldn't ask for more
column10: One of these will keep me full and satisfied for a few hours.  I'm usually a snacky person at work, and would often give into the temptation of the vending machines. column9: worst experience with delivered flowers ever
column10: I have never had a worse experience with delivered flowers.It started out when placing the order...  The previous times I ordered flowers through Amazon, I was given options to select the delivery date, as well as what to say on the card.  This vendor had no such options.  During the order process I was informed it would take 1 to 3 business days.  Since I was ordering in advance, 1 to 3 days was enough.  3 days would be on-time, and one day would make my wife happy as she would get to enjoy them for the whole week...4 days after placing the order, the tracking status shows that the delivery estimate was changed to 2 to 10 days.  Worse, the tracking info indicated the shipper (fedex) was holding the order back, but I could go pick it up if I wanted.  Keep in mind that I'm shipping it to an office building that gets fed-ex shipments daily.  Apparently they shipped with a super-low-priority option allowing the shipper to delay the shipment.Sure, I could go pick them up 35 miles away at the FedEx warehouse, and drive to the opposite side of town to deliver them myself...  Of course the reason I ordered delivered flowers was because I wanted to pay someone else to deliver them for me.  I wouldn't mail-order flowers that I can buy at the grocery store, if I planned to deliver them myself.So here I sit, a week after I placed the order, wondering if they might be delivered soon...  With amazon telling me that, for sure, they will be there by next week.So what kind of condition will roses be in after a week and a half being tossed around in a cardboard box?  And I paid for this?There are 123 florists in this town, and they all are affiliated with 1 or more florist delivery networks.  So getting flowers delivered fresh from a florist should never need to involve Fed-ex.  But I guess I get what I paid for, if I wanted real service, I should have paid a real florist for real florist service (or do it myself).I'm sure that my bad experience is partially because of my own high expectations from having used flower services for the last 20 years, always getting next day (or same day) delivery of my orders.  The last time Amazon forced me into 2-day delivery expectations, which was ok as that was explained up-front and I got exactly that.But this time I was promised 1-3 days before I was charged, then promised 2-10 days after it was too late to make a different choice.  That is called bait and switch.  Perhaps the delivery estimate provided by Amazon is not based on the original representation in the shopping card, but that wouldn't matter if the item had arrived on time.  Perhaps it is all FedEx's fault...  But that is what is being sold, so the delivery service is part of what is being sold...  So even if the seller is blame-free for my poor experience, it is the sum of my experiencewith the vendor AND the delivery service that counts toward my ability to enjoy my purchase.I would suggest avoiding this vendor.  Use vendors that are part of a reputable florist network.
