column9: This is something Grace Foods should be very good at.
column10: Unfortunately, they ain't!Jamaica's climate makes it ideal for growing some of the hottest, sweetest, craziest peppersknown to man. However, Grace Foods doesn't seem to have its heart and soul in hot sauce, but ratherspread thin across a wide selection of typical grocery items; it seems that without a strong focuson hot sauce, this "very hot" sauce falls very flat.This runny sauce is almost a carbon copy of Tabasco. The spice is a wimpy drop in a salty, waterybucket. Very conventional, very boring, and, unfortunately, a flavor that's dramatically overexposedhere in the USA already. Too much vinegar and water with anything can produce a bit of an unpleasantsmell, and that's what you get when you open this bottle. The spice is weak, the sauce is a little thickerthan water, and you won't taste any sweetness of  the Scotch Bonnet. There's a chance they just used apinch of cayenne pepper like Tabasco does and subtly advertised otherwise.Grace makes this and one other OFFICIAL Scotch Bonnet Sauce. Get that one. This sauce isn't worth yourtime, effort, or taste buds. 3 Pods

I have been looking for a hot sauce that was pure and good, I have no ideas where I bought the Grace hot sauce and I found what I have been looking for for many months. Thanks this is one of the best for sauce ever. please don't change them. My Walmart does not have them , but some store carry them.
I just returned from Jamaica yesterday and my bottles of hot sauce broke in my luggage I was so upset because it was the best I ever had. Good thing you can order almost anything on amazon.

This is the best hot sauce I've ever had.  I enjoy spicy foods, and I would rate my tollerance around an 8 on a scale of 1-10, with 5 being your average person off the street.  This sauce is spicy, but the best part is its fantastic flavor.  It's deep and satisfying; much more complex than the average hot sauce.I grew up a Tobasco lover and discovered Grace only a few years ago.  Since then, it has replaced Tobasco, Texas Pete, Frank's, Cholula, and every other hot sauce I've ever tried.  It's the only thing I buy, now!

This tea is very good. It's perfectly balanced. The lemon doesn't overpower the tea taste but compliments it nicely. The tea leaves much bigger than you'd get in tea bags which use powder but it's not whole leaves that are dried that you can get with premium tea.  This is more like chips of tea leaves but that's understandable at the price and this taste great regardless.  There's a good range you can brew the tea leaves too without it tasting bitter.As others have mentioned, this is a lot of tea.  I've been drinking 3 or so cups a day and this will probably last 2 months. Be sure you have a proper way to store it cause it's not a good idea to leave it in the bag it comes with for that long. Overall this is great and I'll be trying other Davidson's tea.

I must preface this review with one thing: Taste is subjective. I believe reviews for edible or imbibe-able products on amazon should always be taken with a grain of salt. Having gotten that out of the way, let me also say that I believe this tea deserves more in the way of a 3.5 or 3.7. The price per pound is very good for the quality of tea. After having drank this tea for a couple of months, I must admit that I am quite tired of the taste. - My typical experience with this tea has been to brew a large pot, to fill my 24 ounce vacuum thermos, and to bring it to the library for long hours of studying. It suffices well for this. Due to the large quantity, I never have any issue making too much as I can just pour it out with little harm. - It is very easy to over brew this tea. For the first two weeks I did this constantly; the tea is awful when overbrewed. Take care with the quantity of tea and length of steep. Better to under steep than over steep. - There is a very fine powder along with the rest of the tea. Be sure to use a decanter with a fine weave or simply shake whichever decanter you use with the tea in it to get as much of the powder out as possible. - The taste, when brewed correctly, is good. The lemon comes through and adds a nice olfactory touch to the experience.All in all, a good product, and recommended for green tea lovers. Do not judge the tea off of the first brew, like I did, but fiddle around with the quantity of tea brewed and the time steeped until you decide whether or not you enjoy this product.

This tea tastes wonderful and one bag will go a very long way! Great hot or cold, our whole family loves it and we make it by the gallon daily. I was never much of a green tea fan until trying Arizona brand green iced tea with ginseng. After enjoying that tea so much I started searching for a tea with a similar taste that I could brew at home. First we tried lipton brand Lemon Ginseng green tea bags and although it had a great taste, dealing with tons of small single serving bags to make a gallon each day was a pain. Then we found this particular brand by Davidson's and it was perfect, just what we were looking for! As some other reviews mentioned, this tea has a distinct lemon flavor. If you enjoy lemon in your tea, you will enjoy this as it compliments the green tea and subtle ginseng flavors perfectly. Quick and easy to make in a home iced tea maker with a filter. This is definitely a staple in our home.

I've tried many different green teas as iced tea in an electric brewer, all with good results. This seemed like something worth trying, since I've always liked jasmine green tea, so I'd probably dig lemon flavor as well. And if any of ginseng's benefits for the body are real, why not? But while this one was brewing, the entire kitchen smelled less like lemons and more like Lemon Pledge furniture polish. I figured that was a fluke and the flavor would probably be subdued after it was chilled. I was wrong. The flavor was practically caustic, beyond bitter, making my lips numb afterwards. I ended up pouring out the pitcher and trying to figure out what to do with the rest of the bag. Based on an earlier review, I'll probably buy an infuser and try using this for hot tea at a lower temperature. Unfortunately, I can't control the temperature of my brewing machine, so if you're doing the same this tea may not be the best choice.

This smells, looks and tastes like HAY - not like any tea, let alone green tea, not like Ginseng, and not like lemon. The weird smell is overwhelming!  I've never thrown out anything before, but this goes into the trash.  I cannot find a decent green tea from Amazon anywhere- I'm going back to importing my own.  This is the first tea I've rated below 2.5 stars- I would rate it a zero if I could.  Does not look like tea leaves, and it looks oxidized.  Maybe it's extremely old.  Maybe they gave me barn sweepings instead. Who would have thought green tea is so difficult to produce? Please take this off the market.

My fiance and I hated this tea. She wouldn't drink it and I eventually got sick of its overly fruity flavor and threw it out.It is really really lemony.To quote her, "this is $&!+y tea for people who don't really like tea."Maybe that is wrong or harsh, perhaps folks who like lemony tea will love this.

column9: Great tastng tea when brewed right.
column10: I am still working to get the right combo that results in a non bitter tea.It is hit or miss for me. I ususally brew 1 gallon iced at a time. I use 4TBS. Sometimes I set it to Max strength other times in the middle other times at the weakest settings. I still need to keep working on perfecting it.Overall when I get the brew right it has great flavor, and even when it does turn out a bit bitter it is not terrible just not as good as I know it can be.

First off I am no tea connoisseur, although I do enjoy a good cup of tea prepared under the right conditions. I was disappointed, probably because of higher hopes, but the tea leaves I received are almost powder form like in tea bags. High quality leaves when it comes to appearance are complete leaves or almost complete. I'm not sure what quality the other reviews are talking about.  Second the taste isn't to my liking, seems rather flat, but again i am no connoisseur.
ORGANIC!HEALTHY.Amazing price.Lemon and Ginseng are refreshing.  I also bought the Moroccan Mint.  BOTH are so delicious I will definitely buy more.

column9: Some of the Tastiest Green Tea
column10: I am new to loose-leaf tea and have been really put off by the high price of Teavana. The Davidson's tea was a great purchase, and tasted a lot better. This grean tea is awesome, and you get A LOT of it. I even transferred some to small jars to let my friends try (this would not have been possible with the 2oz you get from Teavana for the same price).TIP: make sure to follow the brewing instructions. You only need 2-3 minutes to steep this tea. Too much steep time can stew the leaves, messing up the flavors.
Terrific value for the $$$$$  - organic at 1/2 the price of other brands.  Not large leaves but good quality, organic, and makes a good pot of tea.

My stores of Teavana and Tea Geschwender teas had run low and I needed to re-order but hated to spend the money. I wanted try a bulk tea option from Amazon to use my Prime shipping option. I bought Davidson's Earl Grey with Lavender and their Green tea with Lemon and Ginseng. Both were just as good as anything I bought from the other stores and around 4-6 times cheaper. I was a little worried about some of the reviews which implied some differences in quality batch to batch. I guess I got lucky this time. The Green tea was smooth and the lemon was a nice complement. Not a strong "grassy" green tea  I'm very happy so far, the main problem is going to be drinking 2 pounds of tea before they go stale (12-18 months is usually reccomended when in air tight containers). Then I will see what the next batch is like

I love this tea! It's very well balanced. I tend to like very strong tea, and I made this up using a mix of techniques. I basically made a gallon at a time, put 1/3 cup of tea in a gallon jug, 1/3 cup splenda (which as a percentage is very small), and filled the jug with water almost to a boil (microwaved it). This all done at 9AM, and then set the jug in the sun. At 5PM, I brought the jug in and set on the counter to cool. In the morning put it in the fridge, and by late afternoon, it was amazing. I make a jug up about every 2 days. The whole family loves it!1 Gal almost boiling water1/3 Cup tea leaves1/3 Cup SplendaPut tea, splenda & water in glass jugSet in the sun for 2+ hoursSet on kitchen counter to cool overnightStrain contents into another jugPut in fridge for 4+ hoursServe!A lovely, just perfectly sweet, cold tea that my family can drink all day.

column9: Results are up to you and how you brew!
column10: I enjoy this tea.  Let me start off by saying that the results you get are largely determined by how you brew it.  The first batch I made I got distracted and let it over steep by a minute or two and probably used water that was more like 190 or more than the 180 degrees you should use for green tea.  This resulted in a bitter brew and was not enjoyable.  I could certainly see where people would get the "dish soap" idea.  I have other green tea that does the same thing if you over steep so I knew that this was my negligence and to give it another try.  The second batch, wow, completely different flavor and taste!  The second time I let it set for two minutes, let the water cool to 180 before I poured over it and wow, this made the flavors quite enjoyable and no bitterness.  It was completely different than the first batch.  I really enjoy this tea and do not find the flavors overwhelming at all if you brew it properly.  I drink a lot of different teas, and this has become a daily staple for me.I couldn't agree more with the other review that says to watch steep time and temperature with this tea.  If you do this, you will enjoy this tea, if you do not, you will get bitter, dish soap tasting tea.  I'm also looking forward to trying this as iced tea as I think it would be great as well.  This is a great value for organic tea.

I enjoy the occasional tea, and am a fan of organic foods. This lemon ginseng tea tastes like neither. I'm sure it's very healthy, but the taste and consistency makes you feel like you just swallowed a mouthful of 409. The fruity lemon aftertaste isn't enough to offset the very 'non-tea' flavor. Davidson's brand makes several flavors, and maybe some of the other flavored teas are better, I don't know. But this lemon ginseng flavor is awful stuff. Unless you're a hardcore tea aficionado I'd steer clear of this one.

column9: My Daily Green Tea ~ Excellent taste and value
column10: This ends up being my daily green tea. Many times I will mix the Green Lemon Ginseng 50/50 with a Gunpowder green tea, or some other unflavored green or white tea and add a tiny bit of Agave syrup when brewing for 3-4 minutes; this makes a great cup of tea in the morning. It is pretty lemony by itself, but mixing it with a plain green or white tea makes a delicious custom blend. I usually keep out an ounce or two of the tea for daily use, then vacuum seal the rest and store in the freezer. This large bag will last me 7 or 8 months, but the vacuum sealing & freezing trick keeps it fresh. It's an incredible value, and I have no problem with the quality of this product. I switched from coffee to green tea several years ago, and this continues to be my favorite tea. I have also used this tea to brew large batches of iced tea that I store in the refrigerator in the summer, again brewing it with a little Agave nectar and it makes a great, affordable refreshing summer drink.

This is my favorite of the Davidson's Bulk teas. If I make it right, it actually has a slight taste like the white of watermelon rind. Just clean and crisp over ice. I make it with honey and a little Splenda. Good hot too, but I like to chug cooler at work.
This is a great product!!  Delicious!!  ....and packaged in a foil lined, resealable package!  Will become a staple for me!!

I purchased this tea earlier in the week and it arrived today, getting quicker than another product I ordered at the same time, which is always a plus. Initially I had been afraid it would arrive in a plain paper lunch sack like the picture shows. I was incredibly relived to see that it came in a sealed and lined pouch instead. All the same I did put it in an airtight container because I didn't really trust the Ziplock like seal all that much.I've only had one cup of it so far (mostly because it's August and pretty hot out) but for the price the taste is wonderful. You get a nice taste of the green tea, and just a hint of lemon, that I quite like, it isn't overpowering at all. I felt that the tea was just a little on the weak side, but that might have been because of how long I brewed it. I think that this would also be very good as iced tea.I read one review where the buyer said that their tea was practically powdered, but mine was whole and in good condition. The leaves are big enough that very few escape through the holes in my infuser like a couple of other loose leaf teas that I have tried.Overall I am very satisfied with this product, and I would recommend it. I would probably buy it again but maybe next time in a smaller package, an entire pound of tea seems to be a bit much.

I ordered several bulk teas from Davidson's  (Silver Needles, very low quality 1 stars, Chamomile 2 stars, Green with Lemon Ginseng &  Oothu Green a bit better 3 stars) 3 packaged very poorly and looked like very old stock. I didn't like the taste of any - but this not about my subjective taste just the quality of the product. I have been on a tea kick and have purchased about 15 different bulk teas from several different sources and everyone was superior in quality and taste many were less expensive as well. All were brewed according to accepted standards -following the directions did make a big difference in taste
This tea tastes great!  You will be happy with this tea if you want a slight lemon flavor.  Reminds me of I Love Lemon by Bigelow Tea but this is Organic and at a great price.

This is my second sampling of Davidson's organic teas, the first of which was the fantastic organic gunpowder green, and I must say that Davidson's has now completely won me over. I am not usually a huge fan of lemon, but I find the lemon myrtle provides the perfect touch. I don't notice the ginseng, but I don't care either way; in Chinese medicine, they say that ginseng is wasted on young people. $12 for a pound of quality loose tea is an incredible bargain, but the fact that it's organic makes it even better, and the 15% off from "Subscribe & Save" knocks this one out of the park!

I use Davidson's tea constantly.  I find that all of their teas are very high quality.  All of them are always fresh and tasty, but the Lemon Ginseng is my favorite.  Subtle Lemon taste with a nice light green tea flavor.  Nothing overpowering, yet still fullfilling.  I was a die hard Harney and Sons tea drinker until I tasted Davidson's...now I am a die hard Davidson's tea drinker.  I have it automatically sent to me thru Amazon so I never run out.  This also brews great the second time around.  Try it on ice this summer.

The best sauce I've eaten to date that comes from a jar.  It is a pricey product that is not found in every store, but I still put in effort to get this sauce to my table.  Tastes sooo good try the Filetto di Pomodoro, fresh flavors no artificial flavorings.

column9: Great for dialysis patients, wish for better packaging
column10: I have suffered from Renal Failure and been on dialysis for 11 years.  Controlling liquid intake is of the highest priority with this condition...too much water can lead to very bad consequences.  I have tried every trick nephro-dieticians have recommended; sucking ice, eating frozen grapes, avoiding all forms of sodium, but none of these have either quenched my constantly dry mouth or helped me control my liquid intake.  I came across quench gum and now swear by the product.  It has helped me control my constant thirst and dry mouth which have made my treatments much more effective.  I also find them helpful at those moments in grad class when I get a little tired -- I pop a quench and they are a great wake up call.  It has worked so well for me that I shared a tub with all the patients in my treatment center and a number of them have found the same positive effects and now we all chew quench.  All of the above complaints about the packaging are true.  Don't keep them in your pocket long or they'll meld to the paper.  Also pieces tend to get hard to chew, but a small complaint for all the positive it gives me.  I have used the sugarless, but I just think the taste is horrid.  I love this product.

column9: Does The Job - But Too Much Sugar
column10: I have allergies and take meds to keep myself from constant sneezing and itchy-eyes. The antihistamines however, really dry me-up. I work-out daily and even well hydrated I still get terrible dry mouth. Quench gum has the citric acid, the tartness to keep my mouth fresher. The sugar blast along with the tart, is almost too much. I'm very health conscious and one piece is more sugar than I care to pop at the gym between 4-6 times in an hour & half time frame. I've not checked for a sugar-free version of Quench gum, or something along those lines. If sugar is not an issue, it works well to hydrate your mouth. CONS: (1) not really a good chew. The gum seems to soften and begin to disintegrate within a twenty mins. or less. This requires you to pop another piece. I like a gum I can really masticate while running on treadmill, and (2), Quench gum can't be kept very long in a pocket or anywhere it might be too warm and a tight space. It will stick like glue to the wrapper, never to peel off. I have, really, had to pop gum, wrapper and all in mouth while running. Just my spin.

On long bike rides ,hikes or, sessions in the gym I always use gum to keep my mouth "Clean" and to keep pace. Tried Quench gum and im blown away. This stuff keeps its flavor a long time and keeps your salivary glands flowing. Making it great for not having to stop and get a drink as often I found for boxing its invaluable! It Means less breaks and more stayin in the groove when u workout. Best gum for sport on the market.
Quench gum is the only gum similar to the old gatorade gum. I hope quench gum is here to stay!
This is what you would expect. a bucket of quemch gum.The only downside is that the flavor does go away quite fast but it does quench your thirst
I'm a distance runner and never go out for a long run or race without it.

If you've never tried Italian Yoga Juice, you're missing out on something seriously spectacular. I tried one of these in Italy and drank nothing else for the entire trip. In the states we have nothing that even remotely compares to Yoga Juice. No juice has been able to satisfy the longing I feel for Yoga. I searched high and low trying to find an affordable way to have it shipped to me, because sadly this juice cannot be purchased in the U.S. My last resort was to have my family over there ship it, which would have been extremely expensive and unreliable. Then Ditalia made my YEAR. Offering three different flavors in two different sizes, Ditalia took great care in the packaging of these glass bottles to make sure that they arrived in tact. I ordered my Juice, and a week and a half later they were waiting for me outside of my apartment. I couldn't be happier. Bravo Ditalia!
Fast shipping!! I only take 1 bag a day. I sleep so well at night^^  i need to get mor for my friend also.

We use this stuff where I work, and it's amazing. Dear sweet baby Jesus, it's delicious. Recommended for use in hot tea, apple cider drinks, and even to put in milkshakes with a bit of caramel for a caramel apple treat(or just an apple treat, if you like).
Love Stacy cinnamon chips.  Have them every day with yogurt for lunch.  Wish they would have more sales as I order them all the time.

These have to be the best snacking chips ever made.  The cinnamon chips are addictive.Since becoming very popular they are now hard to get from Amazon.  I bought two cases and am one happy chip eater!
Had been looking for this pita for a while and found it online. Ordering was the best thing I ever did!!!
These are the best on the market.  I absolutely love them.  The chip has just the right amount of sugar and cinnamon coating.  I love the chips as an evening snack.  Thank you Stacy's.

I really like these chips.  My husband tried the Nearly Naked, Plain ones at a pot luck supper. He loved them and asked what they were.  We could not find them in our local stores so we have been ordering them from Amazon by the case. I decided to try the Cinnamon Sugar Chips because we loved the plain ones.  The Cinnamon Sugar ones are a great snack when you feel you need a little something sweet.  They are sweet but not as sweet as eating candy or a cookie and better for you.  Great with coffee for breakfast.  They are a healthy choice since you do not over eat with them.  They are very crunchy and filling, a little goes a long way.  The nearly naked, or plain ones are great with hummus.  Stacy'Stacy's Pita Chips, Simply Naked, 1.5-Ounce Bag (Pack of 24)  pita chips are a good alternative to potato chips and other junk food snacks.

column4: Sandra M. Fodi "S Fodi Hopeful Work in Progress"
column10: I love Stacy's Cinnamon Pita Chips!  I can get them at AMAZON - have them delivered to my front door in a giant supply and I don't have to share themwith anyone!  They arrive ON TIME -- AS STATED, IN A BOX, UNBROKEN, PRICED BETTER  THAN AT THE GROCERY STORE  AND  BEST OF ALL  I CAN ORDER AHEAD WHEN I'M GETTING LOW - - - - SO I DON'T RUN OUT!!!  IF YOU HAVE A FRIEND OR A RELATIVE WHO IS A CINNAMON FREAK --- THEY MAKE A  SUPER BIRTHDAY OR HOLIDAY PRESENT. YOU CAN SEND A DOZEN!

Receive a raving review from my brother and family. They said it was the best thank you they had ever received. It was waiting for them when they got home from school. The boys opened it and they had breakfast for dinner. They called me while they were preparing their feast. It was a big hit.
The best tea experience ever!  Full flavored taste treat.  Just makes moments in the day heavenly.

I've been a fan of this yerba mate for several years.  It's a great way to wake up in the morning, not overly sweet with nice chai flavor.  In fact, I love it so much, I signed up for the auto-ship feature!

For quite a while, I have been taking a chai tea bag and a plain yerba mate bag and brewing them together in a large mug with a little stevia to start the morning.  Since this has a chai flavor, is sweetened with stevia and is yerba mate, I thought it would save me a step or two.  Unfortunately, while tasty, the flavors are weak and it takes three bags to equal the flavor of the two I used to use.  It doesn't matter how long I let it steep either.  It's cheaper my old way and that flavor is dependable.  I won't be buying this again.

I too wondered if the quality slipped a while back so I decided to hear it from the Horse's mouth.  I wrote to the Renfro company and asked about the issues that were stated by the previous posters here.  This is the reply I received:Hi David and thanks for contacting us.We did have an issue with taste for a short while, but have since changed vendors and everything should be back to normal.Since mid-Nov to mid-Dec, store shelves have probably been 99% with the "newer" product.If you've had a chance to taste the "new" peppers, please let us know what you think.Best,Jane Cohen for Renfro Foods/Mrs. Renfro's SalsasI say I'm glad they recognized the problem and fixed it.  I am back in their camp now with thanks to the Renfro group all around.David -

I agree completely with the other commentors. Mrs. Renfros jalapenos used to be the best available in a jar by far. I have stopped buying them now since the change. Can't stand them anymore. I hope I get notified when they go back to the original recipe. I will buy them by the case when they do.

I got hooked on eating jalapeno peppers as a snack several years ago. Yup, just eat them right out of the jar. A regular part of my grocery shopping trips was to come home with a jar of whole jalapenos. And unless they were out of stock, I would get Mrs. Renfro's because they were hands down the best tasting, freshest and most crisp.Once I moved out to California, I couldn't find them anymore. I was very happy to see I could order them on Amazon, so I got a box. However, between the time I'd lost them and re-found them again, they've completely changed! The recipe is different or something because they don't taste the same as they used to. They're just not as good. They're still fairly crisp and the new flavor isn't terrible, but they just don't have that zest that they used to. They're sweeter now, and the heat is a lot milder.They're still a good pepper, but they're not the best anymore. I think they should go back to their old recipe.

Aside from being hard to find, Mrs Renfro messed up a good thing. Reminds me of the Coke recipe change years ago.Why change the best pickled jalapenos on the market. I loved them the way they were. About 2 years ago they became impossible for me to find even on their own website. Then when I find found some to order and had them shipped to me, the label was different and so were the peppers. They are now smaller and less mature and they have also removed natures handle (the stem) from them. Maybe they had to change suppliers, don't know.I have been giving away the jars I received and now gone back to buying Trappey's, next best thing. I hope they go back to the original like Coke did. I'm guessing their sales are off but are stuck in a contract.I loved the flavor and texture the way they were. Now I buy others.
Many American recipes use cooking sherry instead of sweet rice wine.  Where ever you see sherry in an Asian recipe use this to create a much more authentic flavor.
This is as expected. Its Mirin. Use it in a wide variety of things. Good quality, as I expected, from Kikkoman.
This makes my brown rice taste good, which means I eat more of it.  This is great stuff; just add this and a dash of soy sauce to short grain brown rice :)

Makes fabulous sauce for stir fry.  Just sweet enough, just pungent enough.  Mix with corn starch, Raw Blue Agave, soy sauce, fresh ground ginger and add when veggies just about cooked, then stir and serve.

The supplier should be ashamed for doing business this way.  As of yet I have had no response from my e-mails and no product.  This company should be banned from doing business with you.  Is there anything that can be done?

column9: Very low quality. Do not buy.
column10: First, the package does not look like the one in the picture. Very dark plastic bottle and the label was printed with some black and white printer without much inkleft.And more importantly, it smells bad. And it turns yellow after a couple months.Amazon should be more careful about the food they are selling.

I purchased this when I couldn't find raw goat milk cheddar in local natural stores.  I purchased near spring of the year and was able to munch on feta with strawberries for quite some time.  I will reorder this year.  And, despite having four packages per shipment, it did not go rancid.

The package label looks different than this one but it says Mount Sterling Goat Milk Feta Greek Style. I USED TO buy lots of it because I loved it. It was nice and crumbly for salads and omelets and a bunch of other recipes. Flavoful with a long shelf life.NOT ANY MORE.I was surprised when I opened a package to crumble it into my salad and it wasn't crumbly. No different than any sliceable cheese. I figured it just a labeling mistake and returned it to the store. A while later, same thing and I returned it to the store. I dug down to the bottom of the heap and found the last 3 packages of REAL feta. You can even see the difference from the outside of the package. This is part of the description on their own website, "This DRY,CRUMBLY cheese is excellent in dishes with vegetables". The label picture is exactly the same as the one I buy (and I just looked again today).I emailed Mount Sterling, politely explaing the situation. I figured they'd want to know. I received a curt reply telling me that I was welcome to return it to the store. Then about a month ago I decided to try once again, even though it still didn't look like feta through the package. I bought it anyway and it isn't nice crumbly feta so I returned it again. I have checked other cops and it is the same.I like their cheeses including the raw milk chedder but I'll not be so likely to buy from a companythat doesn't care about either explaining or correcting a problem. It doesn't exactly make me trust the quality.They may sell this feta now, but as soon as the buyers try to crumble it, they won't be buying any more. I am very disappointed, as I loved this cheese.
Fantastic,I always have enjoyed goat cheese,and this one is really something..Beside you can keep it a long time in your fridge, it doesn't get rancid...Enjoy:))

Gold coins are a Christmas stocking tradition in our house (from Santa, of course) and, let's face it, most look cute but taste horrible. I bought these for my son's birthday party pinata and they arrived promptly, in a plastic bucket, all in great condition. The coins are large, the foil bright and tight and the chocolate just so-so ... But not terrible and better than a lot of gold coin chocolates I've had in the past. All in all, a good price for a good product, just don't go in expecting gourmet. You're paying for the fun factor, not the candy itself.
We used these for a St. Patrick's Day themed party. They arrived in good condition and tasted pretty good. Would definitely order again.

These chocolates were for my nephews pirate themed party. We put them in the giveaway bags and when the kids opened them up they had obviously been sitting along time as the chocolate had turned white and stale. Gross.
Delicious chocolate and just what we needed for our Mario birthday party. Kids won them in games and then used them to get bigger prizes.  They loved them, even before they ate them.

I just received the product today but the bucket within the delivery box was broken. So there were coins strewn all over the box and under the bottom flaps of the box. Fortunately, the coins don't seem to be damaged (though 1 coin looked like the wrapper was kinda loose. I guess I'll eat that one instead of giving that to the kids). column9: The best kept secret for the best spaghetti sauce
column10: Spatini used to be available to the average American in little packets sold in boxes of three at the supermarket.  Unfortunately, the company making Spatini was bought by the evil conglomerate Unilever, which dropped consumer Spatini in favor of their 2 Lawry's (inferior) spaghetti sauce mixes.  For some secret reason, though, Spatini has remained available in these 'restaurant' sized packages and that's a good thing!  Buy it like there's no tomorrow because Unilever is not to be trusted. 3 tbsp are approximately equivalent to 1 packet of the old product.  In response to the other reviewer, add a little sugar or agave to desalinate the taste of the current product and to decrease the acidity of the tomatoes.

noticed the difference of ingredients in this 15 oz pkg versus the old smaller pkgs.  the newer one lists salt first whereas the older pkgs listed sugar first than salt.  Being that I do not use salt, i noticed the saltier taste in the 15 oz pkg.  now trying to figure out how to cut the salty taste.  add more sugar?  someone suggested putting a piece of potato in while cooking to absorb the salt.  otherwise good to have the spatini back.

It's unfortunate that you can only buy Spatini in quantities to feed an army. One family sized batch only needs 3 Tablespoons of Spatini mix, but the minimum order is 4 packages of 15 oz (each pkg is enough for 60 servings).  This has a wonderful flavor, though, and if you are cooking for any large group, or a church soup kitchen, it is also easy and inexpensive.  Spatini sauce is delicious made with tomato paste and water so you don't have to carry the 10 pound cans of tomatoes to cook for a big group.

She is not very good on the computer so I did the research and ordering for her. We received the product quickly and her father was very happy. Especially after it was made. He was unable to eat alot but it made him happy and that is all that matters.

column10: This food was really a miracle for our cat! column9: MUCH better than the cheese powder in boxed mac n' cheese
column10: I first tried this with macaroni, and it was fantastic. Much smoother, tastier and creamier than the boxed macaroni and cheese. I also topped popcorn with it and it was just as good. SodaStream soda syrups may be a bit more expensive than off-brands, but this sampler pack is a great way to try out their different offerings and decide for yourself which (if any) flavors of theirs you like the most without committing to an entire 12 liter syrup bottle.  Included in this pack are one trial-size, single-use "vial" of the following flavors:-Orange (Like "Crush)-Diet Dr. Pete (Like "Diet Dr. Pepper")-Energy (Like "Red Bull")-Diet Pink Grapefruit-Diet Lemon-Lime (Like "Diet Sprite")-Root Beer (Like "Barq's")-Diet Cola (Like "Diet Coke")-Dr. Pete (Like Dr. Pepper)-Diet Cranberry-Raspberry-Fountain Mist (Like "Mountain Dew")-Diet Root Beer (Like "Diet Barq's")-Lemon-Lime (Like "Sprite")Each "vial" makes one liter.  The instruction say to "twist-off" the tops, but I find this impracticable and it is much easier to simply cut the tops off with a pair of scissors.  Also, though the box states that it contains "Dr. Pete" and "Diet Dr. Pete," it actually contains "Pete's Choice" and "Diet Pete's Choice."  The name may be the only difference, but I find that these flavors taste more like "Mr. Pibb" than "Dr. Pepper."Finally, if you like "Red Bull," you will be pleasantly surprised with how close this syrup comes to the real deal.  If you buy the SodaStream solely as a "Red Bull" maker, you can save alot of money!All in all, this is a great way to try out the best flavors SodaStream has to offer.  If you do not mind off-brand flavored drinks, you will not be disappointed.  A name-brand soda purist may be able to tell the difference, but I find these quite palatable.

However, if you're really sensitive to artificial sweeteners, you might want to pass on Sodastream's regular and diet flavorings. (Their website provides nutrition information on all of their flavors, so you can check to see what sweetener is used in each flavoring.)

Buy this ONCE...to discover what flavors you like and dislike.  Then just buy the larger individual bottles..and shop around..the prices vary.  Some of the Amazon prices are HIGHER than the prices available from the vendor and the vendor has a "tenth one free" policy

I vowed never to buy commercial pasta sauces ever again, but this certainly changed my mind. This is very close to making a sauce from scratch, in my opinion. If you're skeptical, I would suggest buying a jar from your local health food store before buying in bulk...you won't regret it!
Received my Sumac on time,in good condition. Price is reasonable,taste is wonderful!Sumac is indispensible for making Fatoush,and not always readily available at the market. Thank you! Linda
I couldn't find this in any grocery store around here, so turned to Amazon. This is just what I wanted and it turned out to be very tasty!

Entenmanns's Donuts are the perfect solution when you need a sugar kick for extra energy when you're on the run; and they go very well with coffee or tea. I've been eating these for ages; and they never fail to do the trick!The box is sealed so when you open the box for the very first time you will need to pull away the side and the front box covers; this ensures freshness and quality control. I would store these in a refrigerator either before or after opening. They are pretty tasty when cold. However, you can serve them or eat them yourself when they are at room temperature as well. In addition, these donuts are kosher if that matters to you.These donuts offer variety: three of them are chocolate covered with a yellow cake filling; three are plain; three are glazed and three more still have sugary crumbs on them to really give you a treat! I love them all but occasionally the plain ones can be a little dry for my personal taste. Their small size makes them easy to carry when you're on the go; and the individual donuts easily fit into a child's school lunch box, too. I would recommend wrapping the donuts in some sort of paper or small plastic bag so that any donut crumbs won't go all over other food or anything else that a person is carrying.These donuts, predictably, have their drawbacks. They are loaded with sugar; and sugar can turn to fat inside your body if you don't get enough exercise. Check the nutrition facts label before buying to see if the carbohydrate content is "OK" for your diet. As for me, I would not eat these donuts every day because of my diet.Overall, however, these donuts are some treat! They make for the perfect snack when you're on the run; and they can be an after school snack, too. They even go well with coffee or tea when company comes to visit! Pick up a box and enjoy these tonight!

column9: A Very Delicious, VERY Versatile MULTI - TASKER
column10: I like to make my positive reviews as educational, encouraging, helpful and authentic as possible. My sugar-loving, ultra-nit-picky, processed-food-loving family members have all flown the coop so I'm FINALLY re-learning high-nutrition cooking (like Mother Earth News had inspired me towards 20+ years ago) and these Bob's Red Mill products are making my transition super-easy, tasty, creative and fun. This Natural Granola was the first `Bob's' item that I had tried out because I knew it would be more versatile for adding into other recipe's and I could simulate his other granola mixes because I always keep spices and dried fruit bits on hand (for adding to foods AND ESPECIALLY to reconstitute for natural sweeteners).~ THE #1 THING THAT I"VE LIKE THE BEST ABOUT THIS GRANOLA is that it seems so filling to me that I've naturally and effortlessly reduced my portions, which is important for getting our stomach's back to a healthy / natural size without unpleasant brain associations or, in my case triggering my hypoglycemia).  THE #1 ADVANTAGE FOR EVERYONE ELSE WOULD BE HOW PHENOMINALLY VERSATILE THIS NATURAL GRANOLA IS FOR COUNTLESS DISHES & MEALS, SOOooo NEVER assume that healthier eating has to be tasteless, bland or boring !!~ Breakfast Suggestions:  For my taste I didn't need to add much sweetener at all, it's great either with just cold milk, or when I cook it I add in a little ginger and/or cinnamon (VERY health-benefitting spices) plus either a bit of honey or a sparse touch of molasses (bolder flavor and much cheaper than honey), or I sweeten it with a touch of stevia leaves or reconstituted dried fruits (in winter).  BUT, I also add some granola to my pancake mix, muffins and sprinkle it into my cooked 10-grain cereals to add some interesting texture.~ Snacks: After realizing how filling (AND nutritious) it was, I tried out several of the easy, home-made granola-mix recipe's that I found online and saved it in the smallest Rubbermaid containers; it always filled me up when I was debating between a snack, a sandwich or a `meal'.  It's so much-healthier-than-cookies and far more environmentally friendly than the over-priced 100-calorie snack-packs, I also learned to add it to yogurt cups to make it more filling and to feel fuller longer, and I've begun trying some very-healthy low-cal cookie recipe's which I've added this granola (only making them about the size of most cookies)~ Cooking:  You can add this granola almost ANYWHERE you use fillers or bread crumbs, including (but not limited to): adding some to the coating for your veggies or meats before frying, definitely add some to your stuffing / dressings to add flavor to FINALLY retain a better-than-mush texture, experiment by adding some to soups, stews or even chili for more substance and for a passive thickener (no kidding!), it made my sloppy-joe's and meatloaf more awesome than ever, it can add healthy nutrients and texture to almost any casserole (replace those unhealthy French-fried onions!) and it definitely goes great in goulash;~ Baking: FIRST, if there's any chance that anyone is allergic to nuts, use granola for a fabulous substitute.  I've been having so much fun, success and getting raves by adding this granola to muffins, breads, graham cracker crusts, carrot / coffee cakes, BREAD PUDDING, cookies, pies (again acts somewhat like a mild/passive thickener), into the filling of bundt cakes, it's phenomenal in carmel/sweet-rolls, IT'S FABULOUS in frostings like caramel-coconut over german chocolate, and I'd better stop before your drooling shorts out your keyboard :)~ SOME FINAL TIPS:#1): When whole-grain portions are adjusted DOWN to natural, nutritional-needs-sized portions (and you'll see this echoed across numerous product revives) these cereals ACTUALLY ARE LESS EXPENSIVE than the mega-processed, bloating cereals we've been media-blasted into becoming addicted to.#2): We humans DO have the adequate brainpower to begin incorporating healthier ingredients into our families diets within your means; such as: we can purchase JUST ONE PACKAGE of most of the Bob's products at most local grocery stores for trying them out, experimenting and adjusting to them,  then save money by ordering, pantry-ing and saving money via the larger quantities here on Amazon.  I've now purchased several more of the `Bob's' products like the 10-grain cereals, Flaxseed, etc., WHICH I've also been adding into my recipe's; the point is that WE CAN find numerous ways to add a little more nutrition to our meals.#3):  IT'S FUNNY how my family members (and their boyfriends/girlfriends) have been liking my healthier recipe's so much that they've begun to ask more about the recipe's and ingredients.  And after their initial shock that they actually liked things that were very nutritious, they're needed to address their negative prejudices about genuinely healthy ingredients and foods and have begun opening their minds (I WISH THAT I HAD INSISTED ON MAINTAINING MY VALUE OF NUTRITION BEING THE HIGHEST PRIORITY WHEN MY CHILDREN WERE SMALL). #4): I'm betting that Bob would agree that whether we choose his products or a similar product or the most nutritious that we can afford, we've all got to realize that there are countless reasons (the health care crisis being only one reason) why we absolutely must improve our eating habits AND try to be as environmentally considerate as we do so.#5):  I have successfully tried several of the recipe's that are printed on the `Bob's' packages, but while I was at the library the other day I noticed a Bob's Red Mill Cookbook and `Baking Book'!  Although I was too short on time to investigate them, I knew that if I had found dozens of ways to successfully incorporate these healthier ingredients into my dishes and meals, imagine what they could offer with all their experience and resources, I ordered it here on Amazon and I'll recommend that everyone at least consider look into their cooking books if you're serious about learning to incorporate healthier ingredients into your dishes and meals.

This granola is great tasting and filling. I enjoy it cold with skim milk. It is sufficiently sweet tasting so that I do not need to add any other sweetener. I will order more when I finish the 4 pack.

Granola is either too fruity, to sweet, too nutty, to hard, to powdery. There is never just the right, plain, simple granola. Until I found this. Unfortunatly, its difficult to locate in supermarkets and health food stores. I'm now buying this online, in bulk.
I got the Gold Box deal on this granola and found it to be very tasty on its own and mixed with yogurt.

So many granolas are high in fat and calories. This great brand tastes wonderful without fat and is not too high in calories either. It has a pleasant vanilla flavor which I love and I will surely purchase it again.

column9: Just four small bags of plain hard oats.
column10: I have tried many granolas. This is not like a granola at all. It is just plain hard oats. That was a lot of money for four small bags of plain hard oats.

Love this stuff. Not overly sweet, but packed with flavor. I keep mine in the freezer, and it's a quick, cold snack on hot days. I will never buy the crappy big box granola again (you know what brands I'm talking about). For me, the taste, quality, and health aspects are well worth the price.

I love this granola! It is true that if you have been accustomed to those sugar-loaded granolas that it may, at first, seem less flavorful. Once your palate gives up the sugar granola, your tastebuds find that there are actually other flavors to taste and you won't go back. This natural granola is crunchy and rich in flavor. When I want a sweeter addition to my granola I add fresh blueberries, strawberries, peaches, or bananas to my morning bowl of Bob's Red Mill whole grain natural granola.I have a subscribe & save subscription for this product so that I never run out!Bob's Red Mill Original Whole Grain No Fat Natural Granola, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)

column9: Too sweet...and the flavor tastes "off" to me
column10: Now that I'm stuck with 4 bags of this stuff, I'm trying to muscle through it (can't bring myself to throw it away)... but I really miss my old granola.  This product is too sweet, and has another taste (vanilla?) that I can't quite place but I find distracting from what should just be a good granola taste.  On a positive side, it's of good consistency and arrived tasting very fresh.  But usually I just can't eat enough granola, and with this product I feel like I'm taking medicine - it's not tasty.I'm mixing this in with cereal... perhaps this granola would be better suited for baking.  Sorry, I can't give this oatmeal my full endorsement.

I am not much for Earl Greys; to me, they tend to be average. This one is not. It has a great, but not at all overpowering, bergamot flavor. The bergamot flavor is smoothed out by the slight hint of vanilla and cream that is barely noticeable, but effective). I normally drink tea with milk but prefer this one on its own because it is so tasty, smooth, and absolutely well balanced. It avoids the bitterness often gotten from black tea and from lesser Earl Greys. Because of its flavor and its (relatively) decent price, I think this tea will become a mainstay in my house.

column9: The Devil's snack - addictive and amazing!
column10: These little bits of nuts and dark chocolate have to be the WORST thing for me to keep in the house when I am dieting.  I am sure they are pretty good for you, but because they are nuts and chocolate they are high in fat.  I will eat these little gems until I am ready to burst.  They are absolutely wonderful, and I HIGHLY recommend them to those of you with will power.  :)

I was a little hesitant to try these because of the price, but I am so glad I did.  These are incredible!  The almonds, pistachios, pepitas (pumpkin seeds), and cashews are roasted in a way that makes them almost crispy.  They are bound together into little bites with a fragile coating of delicious toffee, and then dipped into dark chocolate.  I wish I could describe how they almost shatter in your mouth with a very pleading crunch.  The combination of the different nuts, toffee, and dark chocolate was much better than I expected too.  These were just too delicious!  The four of us ate the whole large bag in one sitting.  They were that good!  They aren't inexpensive though, so save them for holidays or special events.  I found it amusing that they came in a resealable bag.  I challenge anyone to not finish them once they open them!
the jelly beans came in a flimmsy plastic baggie with tape/it did not come in a container as described/not sanitary at all gross
Beans arrived in a plastic bag instead of plastic container, no big deal.Same quality as the ones in the grocery store.Other reviewer has no idea what 'sanitary' means and should be ignored.

column9: Finally a wet food without meat by-products!
column10: I have been giving my 9 year old Min Pin Beneful Dog Food Prepared Meals. My Min Pin gets constipated and sometimes will not even eat her food. I bought the new Rachel Ray Nutrish at WalMart since it is all natural and the main ingredient is NOT meat byproducts (trash  meat) like beneful. Way to go Rachel Ray, my dog loves this food and so do I. My Min Pin is like a new dog, she eats this up and has more energy!

I recently bought a sno-cone machine to help me cut back on calories yet cool me off when the weather heats up over 100 degrees outside. To save even more calories, I wanted to use sugar-free syrups. I have tried the Back to Basics Sugar-free syrups and they are pretty watered down tasting. I was pleasantly surprised how sweet and tasty the Jelly Belly Sugar-Free Apple was! I am in love and will be buying the 3 pack next time to save money.
Kids love the syrup but you can get it at Bed Bath & Beyond for $2.99.  We have also tried blue raspberry and green apple.  Nice thick syrup.

We recently bought a snow cone machine for my daughter.  I wanted to join in the fun, but I have been on a low-carb diet for almost 2 years.  I noticed there were a number of manufacturers making sugar-free snow cone syrups, but I chose Jelly Belly because I assumed that they would make a great-tasting syrup.  I was not dissappointed.  This one tasted as good as I have ever tasted a sugar-free product.  I have since ordered several other of their sugar-free flavors.  Thank you Jelly Belly.

column9: Ack! Did they not test this flavor?
column10: I bought Very Cherry and Berry Blue from a local retailer and they were horrible.  I tried the Cherry twice and the Berry once before I dumped them in the sink and refilled the bottles with home brew syrup made with Kool-Aid.  Don't waste money on this, especially at this price.
Do not buy the sugar free versions! They impart a strong chemical after taste. Kids hated it and never finished the snowballs.

Its OK. It tasted more like sugar than pina colada :( i was a lit bit dissapointed. maybe because it was sugar free so it wasnt as tasty or good as I have expected it. But it really tasted like watery sugar.
I tried the product since I can no longer eat sugar thinking it would be a good substitute. It tasted too heavy and too sweet I did not enjoy the product and will not purchase again.

In a word,  HORRIBLE.  This stuff no more tastes like Apples then do my hiking shoes.  This stuff is nasty, it has a sweet chemical-like taste that is just yucky.  Can I say anymore about how I dislike the taste of this overpriced product?  How anyone could buy this stuff more than once is beyond me.
You can get the exact same product at Wal Mart for 2.50 why would anyone pay almost 13.00 dollars for snow cone syrup?....crazy!

This mushroomy mix of dehydrated veggies and spices makes a sauce that you might have in a village restaurante of the wooded hills of Tuscany. Comes with real mushrooms and well proportioned spices and vegetables that simply need to be reconstituted in 1 cup of boiling water.  Add some olive oil to saute' a couple of minutes, then add some tomatoes or canned tomatoes.  Cook it down for about 15-20 minutes at a medium flame and serve over penne or other pasta that was cooked separately.  This is real food for 4 people and a gourmet meal that will beat what you might find in your local Italian restaurant.  My family absolutely LOVES this mix.

column9: A real, authentic, and truly useful Italian cheese!
column10: Fontinella is splendid. It is a very strong-flavored cheese, but therein lies its use and versatility. It can be eaten straight as an after-dinner course: let it come to room temperature, and serve it with (believe it or not) very strong coffee... the combination is exquisite (though perhaps not to every taste!).  Moreover, Fontinella is a wonderful cheese to cook with. It can be grated and added to tomato sauce (for a really authentic Italian flavor!), to ravioli, manicotti, lasagne, and more. Chopped it adds a great flavor to a nice mixed antipasto (with olives, artichoke hearts, roasted peppers, onions, garlic, celery, parsley, eggplant caponata...); it tastes wonderful just grated over spaghetti like parmesan (let it get quite cold to facilitate the grating).  This used to be available at the higher-end grocery stores; but lately it seems nowhere to be found locally. So it is wonderful to have it via Amazon marketplace! And worth the extra effort of buying mail-order.Buon appetito!

I asked for some of the deep fried peanuts for Christmas, and I am not overly impressed. I guess I expected them to be more candy like, but alas they are just as you would think. The shell is in fact deep fried to an edible consistency and the peanut brittle is by far the best of the 2 flavors I received. (Cajun are not so Cajun)Nice novelty snack that I would not buy on my own or ask for again.
I've ordered Larry's beans twice now, the Sumatra and the Sumatra decaf. They're excellent. I'm picky and grind my own beans and do French press brewing.
My wife is the coffee drinker and she likes this one pretty well. She's had some better, but this one is up there.

column9: Maybe not my cup of coffee
column10: UPDATE(7/9/12):  After experimenting with this coffee, I finally got it to brew properly.  I used one heaping scoop (or 1 heaping Tbsp) of ground coffee per cup (or 1 Tbsp for every 6oz).  I was initially doing 1 scoop for every 4 oz (what I usually do because I like strong coffee) but this coffee needed to be treated differently.  I now like Tim Hortons coffee :)I've actually never heard of Tim Horton's before, and I saw 5-stars from 24 reviews and thought "wow, this must be really great!  And such a cheap price!"  So I went ahead and bought it.  I don't necessarily like the flavor of the coffee, but that could mean 1 of 2 things:1: I'm not brewing the coffee properly2: I really just don't like thisNow, this is not a review saying "Don't buy this coffee."  This is more of the review of me saying "Not my favorite cup of coffee."  I've become so accustomed to buying from a local roaster right down the street, I usually don't buy this kind of coffee.  But if you like this brand, the price is great!

This was my first time trying this coffee, and even though I like my coffee beans brewed a little bit darker, this is a good cup of coffee.The coffee is reminiscent of old fashioned diner coffee.I think I'll try to roast these beans myself until they get just one shade darker, that may or may not work, I'll try it and see.Edit:  I roasted a half cup up one level of darkness, and although the coffee smelled better, I prefer the taste of the original roast.Still very good coffee both ways.

Simply put, this coffee is the nectar of the gods as far as I am concerned. I like it better than any other coffee I have ever made at home. It tastes very similar to McDonald's Coffee, which is my favorite coffee to purchase pre-made outside of the home. As of this writing, it is out of stock and I sincerely hope it becomes available again. The closest Tim Horton's is about 1,200 miles from my house. That would be almost worth the trip to me, but not quite. I ordered the ground version and hope it comes out the same.

I fell in love with Tim Horton's coffee on a trip in Canada. Tim has a very full flavor for a medium roast.  Good with fresh ADL half/half or good black.Tim is better than Dunkin's, Tully's House, and the Starbucks Blonde, and until he left us, Tim was much cheaper than all of the aforementioned.Tim Horton is so good that the rumor on PEI was that they put an extra addictive substance in it.  This is not true, but the point is that it is really good coffee.And for $12.88 for 2 pounds of beans (yes, beans!) shipped to my door in the Western U.S. for free (w/Amazon Prime)... I simply thought that we'd be together forever.As you can see, Tim has left us.  I'm rationing the beans in my cupboard and praying that maybe one day Tim will come back to us on Amazon so that we can all have a cuppa Tim's in the morning and forget for a brief moment that the day just started and enjoy the hot steamy cup of fresh ground Tim Horton's coffee.Tim, please come back to us... soon!!
4th time I'm ordering this coffee from Amazon... great deal for a good breakfast coffee!  Coffee is rich with a full body.  I agree, I think this is a well kept secret on Amazon.

Shhhh..........don't tell just everybody how good this coffee is; it doesn't need more fans.  I hope you're a fan of one of the "better" brands that has that over-roasted, burnt taste.  All the more Hortons for me.  Thanks, Amazon, for making it available.  I'll be back for more.
I am going to keep this short and sweet. It is a good tasting coffee at a great price. I am reordering again. The price will keep me coming back to buy more.

First off, I am a little bit of a coffee snob.  I use a burr grinder and french press and don't add any cream or sugar.  I usually buy single-source coffee beans from a local guy that roasts them fresh in his house.  My girlfriend however, likes iced coffee with milk, sugar, and chocolate.  When she would come over and want coffee, I hated the feeling of using nice beans that would not be appreciated.  It felt like a waste.But... I didn't want to be rude and tell her that, and I didn't want to obviously use one bean for my coffee and one for hers.  This is exactly what I wanted.  It is an inexpensive coffee bean that makes good iced coffee, but that I can also enjoy black.  I disagree with some of the other reviewers because I would not want to drink this everyday.  It's not bad, it's just a decent, boring cup of coffee.  However, given the price, it was exactly what I was looking for and expecting.
Has a nice,mellow flavor.Not too harsh...and a great buy too.Will definately re-order when this supp;y is exhausted. I wish Tim Horton's were in my area!

I have tried many brands of coffee here on Amazon , some really good , some not so good and most were many more $$$ per pound. I have to honestly say I think this may be the best tasting coffee I have had in a long time. Great breakfast coffee, I would call it a medium roast,holds up well to cream and sugar. I am stocking up this time because this coffee is  often sold out.I think what makes this coffee so delicious is that it is really Really! freshly roasted. Try it, the price is certainly reasonable right now.

If you haven't tried this coffee before it has a smooth taste, nothing too distinct.  The coffee is a medium roast, certainly not a dark roast, but something you can easily drink every day (which many people do)...Unfortunately, Tim Horton's hasn't radiated to all parts of the US yet so if you're not lucky enough to have one close to you it is pretty tough to get any of their products without having family or friends bring it or ship it to you.  I am extremely happy to see that Tim Horton's is selling coffee/hot chocolate mix etc on Amazon.  So far, the prices are the same as what is stated on the Tim Horton's website.  I had only ever bought the ground coffee before so wasn't sure how the whole bean would compare but I find the flavor is pretty much the same.  I like that the whole beans will stay fresher for longer, and that I can grind them the way I want to.  Compared to other brands (where you might pay 2x as much or more for the same amount), the two pounds of whole beans is a really great value!

The quality of Tim Hortons coffee beans is evident, as the unmistakable fresh aroma wafts from the bag to your nose. Kind of intoxicating really, in the sense that you just want to stand over the bag of beans and keep inhaling! Each time I grind and brew, these beans produce a rich, full-flavoured cup of coffee without the bitterness that some coffees offer. As to the value, this 2 lb. bag of beans at Amazon for $12.88 is very economical when you consider that another well known coffee house bean is being sold in 2.5 lb bags at my local warehouse club for $21.99. If you do the math, that's a significant cost increase for an additional .5 lb. of coffee beans! As a Canadian now residing in the states, I'm SO pleased that I can now get my Tim Hortons coffee delivered directly to my home(S&H free) without having to stock up when I go back to visit, or bother my family to send it. Thank you Amazon for allowing me my "taste of home" each day. As some of us would say back in Atlantic Canada, "Yes by, it's some good!" Enough said!

I must say, I was truly excited to see Tim Horton's coffee on Amazon!! The last time I was able to purchase some was when I was in Detroit, and had to ship it home! This was so much easier and faster!!! I really love this coffee, and I can smell it clear back in the back of the house!! Thanks so much for making this highly addictive coffee available online! Wow! I'm drooling thinking about having a cup!

Tried Tim Hortons coffee for the first time after reading all the rave reviews. Thecoffee is good but certainly not the best i've tasted. I have to put twice as much coffee in the pot to get a good cup of coffee, otherwise it taste weak. So technically I just bought a one pound bag, for that price I will stick to the Gevalia coffee I usually buy.
Smells wonderful and is soooo delicious!! Very happy with this purchase.Great price - about half that of other brands of coffee beans!  Will buy again : )

Tastes like coffee should taste like and maybe even better! Great smell right out of the bag, great smell while grinding, great smell while brewing, and again GREAT taste.This will be my GO TO coffee from now on.
Love, love, love Tom Hotton's coffee! We wish they would expand to the West Coast! It came fast & fresh!

column9: Excellent coffee but now way too expensive!!
column10: I just LOVE this coffee; the Canadians produce truly excellent coffee and the last time I bought it from Amazon, it was at a great price, $12.88 for a 2 lb. bag.  But I went to re-order and discovered to my shock that now the price has gone up to $29.99 for the same item - for just one 2 lb. bag.  That's ridiculous.  I have removed this item from wish list until the price goes back down!!
Good Coffee, at a Great price. My only complaint is that it seems to be out of stock fairly often.

column9: This is the best coffee ever
column10: My only complaint is that they are sold out of the whole beans, I want moreThis coffee is so good.
This coffee is very good.  Wonderful aroma, mild but full flavor.  We  don't like the dark, strong type of coffee.  This was a light breakfast type coffee.  I am ordering it again.
Wow, taste great!! Was impressed with everything about this coffee. Great taste and very good price! Will be buying some more soon.
This coffee has a great flavor. And it doesn't even cost very much. My friend likes it so much she says she doesn't even need to add sugar.
GREAT PRICE EXCELLENT TASTE WE WILL ORDER THIS AGAIN. WE DO NOT HAVE A TIM HORTONS IN THE AREA SO TO BE ABLE TO TRY SOMETHING THAT SO MANY PEOPLE HAVE COMMENTED ABOUT WAS ALSO GREAT.

Tim Hortons coffee beans are great. Everything I would expect in a great coffe. It is nice to know that I can order these beans through Amazon and have delivered. We love Tim Hortopn's coffee but it isn't available locally where we live. I will definatley order this again.
Excellent service, and packaging is excellent. And excellent quality and sent on timeI will deal with them all the timeMy advice to deal with them
Got addicted to this stuff on a trip to Canada this summer! This is a special roast, you will swear they add a touch of chocolate to it.

They are always running out of stock.  "They say" it's because of a hold-up at the border.  I say - who's checking inventory?  They were out of stock in April and again in August.  I was told on August 16 that they would have coffee in their warehouse on 8/17.  Today we still have no coffee.  How can a coffee company be out of coffee?  This is a recurring problem with Tim Horton and I'm getting really tired of it.  Perhaps you - Amazon - can do something to get them to fix this problem once and for all because they sure don't pay attention to their customers.  I'm surprised that you have any coffee left.  Usually when Tim Horton is out of coffee, so are you.

We lived in Canada for three years and it is the only coffee we drank while there. There was a Tim Horton's on every block. It's good coffee and once you get the taste for it you just want to always have it around. It became my every day blend. Then we moved to Texas where there is none to be found.Needless to say when I discovered it here several months ago I jumped on it. We like to grind our own beans so I bought a 2lb bag. Then I went to order again just to find it was unavailable. Bummer we were out for a while. Then I saw the 12 1lb bag case become available so I decided to spring for the $83.00 and got the case of 12 1lb bags. That was pretty convenient. We just opened one and kept the rest in the spare refrigerator unopened. I did not wait to run out this time so I went to re-order the 1lb bags and found them unavailable.Well look here now, its the 2lb bag again so I bought several of those. Bottom line. If your into the beans stock up and start looking to reorder before you run out.Now all we need is the K cup version for the times I just want one more cup.

column9: Tim Horton's Coffee beats Starbuck's by a Landslide
column10: I lived in Canada for about a year and while I was there I fell in love with their Tim Horton's coffee.  It has Starbucks beat by miles and miles.  Everytime I go to Canada for visit a I bring home coffee with me.  It was nice to find a reasonable source for the coffee at Amazon, now I don't have to lug it home in my suitcase!

Although this coffee smelled so great when ground, tasted even better, I do not think I will order it again.  I am so spoiled by using already ground coffee that I most likely will not order it again...but it is a fabulous coffee.

Maybe I am a coffee snob?  We brew Starbucks House Blend properly; 2 Tablespoons/6oz water. I wa looking for something more affordable but I guess you really do what you pay for. We brewed a pot of this and my wife and I looked at each other and she used the perfct word to describe it:  "SOUR" !!!I drink it black, she with cream but the cream couldn't conceal the sourness. Amazon is my first place to go for reviews but never again for coffee!

As with all Academia Barilla products, these tomatoes are a bit pricey. That being said, THESE TOMATOES ARE INCREDIBLE. They're sweet and fresh-tasting with no "canned tomato" aftertaste. They have an incredible flavor on their own, and unlike with cheaper tomatoes, you don't have to disguise unpleasant flavor tones with an excessive amount of spices.So while I think these tomatoes are too pricey for everyday use, I'd highly recommend them anytime you want to make a meal particularly special.
I LOVE these new baguette chips.The sundried tomato ones are good also.Nice and crispy with a ton of flavor.Absolutely delicious.Recommended.

column9: An Earl Grey Tea for Earl Grey Tea Lovers!
column10: *****St. Dalfour's wonderful Certified Organic Earl Grey Tea is made from hand-picked, organic Ceylon tea. The flavor is enhanced by "the all natural flavor of bergamot orange", which added interest and made my tea experience delightful. The orange flavor was subtle, not overwhelming at all.
