This Matcha is awesome and you can't beat the price! I drink it iced and I  also mix it in my vanilla protein shakes. Buy it!

It is very good! I just wish I had a green tea whisk so it would come out foamy ahaha. Instead, I blend it in my blender to incorporate the bubbles. Not as good as with a whisk, but still really great! Thank you.

column9: I was wary, but it's delicious!
column10: I am trying to get healthy having a myriad of health problems, so I thought some green tea might be of use to me.  While I can't vouch for any miracle healing, I CAN say it tastes good based on what I did.  I used a spoonful of powder with the spoon that came with it and put it in my water bottle.  I added 2 packets of Truvia sweetener, and filled the bottle 3/4 of the way with lukewarm water and shook until the powder dissolved. I added ice to it, and it was really tasty.I will return in a month, hopefully with good health news.

This stuff is very fine. It is a little bitter if only mixed with water but great with vanilla almond milk. Takes quite a bit to get it mixed without clumping.Great sustained energy. Great price. Pretty similar to the stuff I drank at Joyful in Japan.

This make delicious green tea. It tastes fresh and delicious. It's way better than the green tea at my local sushi restaurant.  I can't wait until the weather warms up so I can make some green tea ice cream with this product.I usually enjoy green tea in the afternoon for a kinder gentler caffeine buzz, but I might start drinking this in place of my morning coffee, too!I was on the fence about ordering this product. I'm glad I finally did.

column9: exactly what I was looking for
column10: Looking for green tea powder to imitate your favorite smoothie or tea latte drink?  This is it!!  It was perfect match (had to do some trial and error with recipes first).  Excellent choice and worth every penny.

Very green and mixes very easily, no chasen needed. Definitely has a good taste. It is packed well and includes a coffee-like bag with the powder inside of a very nice cardboard box. Included is a plastic spoon conveniently sized for portioning. I use this for green tea lattes and will use it for baking because its so affordable. For $3/oz its hard to beat the price.I previously purchased Maeda-En's Shiki Matcha (...) which is around $12/oz and it required a chasen due to difficulty in mixing and was slightly more bitter than I was used to. I've been to several tea ceremonies in Japan and the Maeda-En product tasted about right.However, this product by Vita Life seems to serve my purposes well (tastes very good and mixes very easily) but with my wallet in mind. I'm a very happy customer!
I still have it since the day I bought it !!! Its still fresh and healthy and great on anything!

column9: Just like Starbucks with less sugar! Better at home
column10: This is a great powder. It's my first time buying online and attempting to make Green Tea Latte's at home, so I wasn't sure. I didn't want to go with anything too cheap or too expensive. This powder will make a Green Tea Latte JUST like Starbucks. It is not sweetened, so I recommend adding Agave syrup or just getting the Torino Vanilla syrup if you want it sweetened. The great thing is that I don't have to make it as sweet as Sbux makes it and I can make it at home with Almond Milk.SOOO good. I will definitely buy again when I'm out. Great size and you don't have to put too much Matcha in there. It should last me at least a couple of months. Excited for tomorrow's latte.Store in refrigerator to keep it fresh.
I was nervous about spending so much money on this product, but the amount is actually very generous and it included a handy scoop.  The packaging is very attractive.

I'm in love with Starbuck's green tea lattes but the cost starts to add up so I tried looking for matcha powder to do it myself and this stuff tastes the same except it doesn't have added sugar which I love anyway because I can sweeten to my liking. I just use a couple scoops and dissolve it in water with sugar or honey, then I add organic vanilla sweetened soymilk on ice. Yay!
The tea was just what I was looking for. Service was great and delivery quick. I will be a return customer.
I have ordered this particular product many times.  It is an excellent quality, good color and flavor.  I will reorder again.

I am new to matcha tea (this was my first) but I am very happy with Malden's powdered green tea. I bought it based on the other positive reviews and a little research, and was very pleased. Sixteen bucks for 1/2 a pound puts it in a league of its own. Most of the other matcha powders are much more expensive. I've been drinking it daily for over two weeks (even sharing it with others) and still have well over half of it left.Now if the matcha quality wasn't good then it wouldn't be worth it. After the sensory overload of my very first cup, I learned to prepare it properly and have grown to really enjoy the taste and extended "lift" it provides. It might not be "ceremonial" grade, but it blends well, has a lovely green color and has a bright, fresh flavor. Some people have said it has a fishy smell but I don't detect that. It is really more akin to freshly mowed grass. The added bonus is the health benefits associated with consuming the whole tea leaf -- win win!I highly recommend getting a bamboo whisk and proper matcha bowl, but for quick office preparation, some hot water in a mug and a small spoonful works fine. Just be sure to stir it up a lot, and re-stir if you let it sit for a minute or two. It isn't bad with a little vanilla creamer and honey/sugar in the raw either. Matcha may not be to everyone's taste, but for those that enjoy it, Malden's bulk Matcha Powder is hard to beat.
Great product for the price.  Love it.  Quick shipping.  Great seller!  Many thanks!

My husband drinks Matcha Tea and especially likes the Green Tea Powder. The tea is excellent (if you like green tea) and the service quick and efficient. We have been ordering this product for quite a while.

This is a really good alternative to the expensive matcha that I have tried before. I used to work in a gym/smoothie bar. I wanted to make a shake that was similar to the one I would make at the gym so I bought this powder and I was very successful in doing so. This powder gives me energy all day and it is delicious. I do tell people that it does have a slightly bitter after taste but with milk added it is hardly noticeable.Here is a blender recipe I came up with1 Teaspoon of the green tea powder (First dissolve the green tea in 3 tbs hot water make sure clumps are out)1 Small banana1 Cup vanilla rice milk2-4 drops Vanilla extract2 Packets of Splenda6-8 Ice cubesFor a meal replacement I like to add 1 scoop of vanilla whey protein
Though it lacks the intense green of Starbucks matcha powder, thankfully it isn't full of sugar like Starbuck's powder.

This stuff is barely acceptable. I have some Starbucks Tazo Matcha powder and thought this might be a close match in flavor. But, it's really funky tasting. I'd describe the taste like a cross between grass clippings from a lawn mower and a really strong fishy taste. I know the Starbucks Matcha has sugar mixed in there but even still, with a pound of sugar and cream you can still easily taste that fishy flavor. I pretty sure I would not buy again. BUT, the seller shipped it VERY fast and there were no problems otherwise.

column9: Best tea I have ever had!
column10: Best tea I have ever had.  I actually feel better (health-wise) when I drink it.

I agree with the other reviewers that this matcha is a good value. I don't need the tea-ceremony-quality b/c I use this primarily in smoothies. I would buy it again. My only concern is that it is from China (I recall one reviewer suggest that Taiwan wasn't in China -it isn't on the mainland but it is part of China). I hate to say that but I am concerned about China's poor record of quality control ( not  Chinese equivalent of our FDA).

Prepackaged Chinese medicinal tea can be dangerous--it is completely unregulated, and people get sick all the time from bad ingrediants and unforseen reactions. I am asking for my money back and notifying Amazon.

I love this sweet brown rice.  I had never tried it before, but it's the greatest sticky rice.  Tastes good, sticks together for stir-frys. Makes a great breakfast.  I mix it with Quinoa and oat groats, add some agave, fruit, and a little raw milk -- delicious and nutritious.
My daughter loves this sticky sweet rice.  I use it in my own mixes to sweeten up regular brown rice.  Good product, good flavor, good price.

I bought these because the only ingredient listed was organic cranberries.  They are however very very sweet and I question the accuracy of the product label.  These are just as sweet (if not sweeter) than Newman's or conventional Ocean Spray dried cranberries.  The taste is fine, but I did not want to buy sugared cranberries.  Perhaps they really are naturally sweet, but I've never had fresh cranberries that were even slightly close to being this sweet.  Klein's website did not open for me and they do not offer a phone number so I cannot call to verify if sugar has been added or not.  I suppose I could write them!  They are labeled as USDA Organic.  A one ounce serving has 90 calories and 18 grams of sugars.  The other odd thing is that most dried cranberries have a little oil added.  There is a slight oily residue inside the container, but again, oil is not listed as an ingredient.  Does anyone know the facts on the ingredients for this product?

Klein's Natural's Dried Cranberries as described do not mention sugar as an ingredient. For this reason I purchased a six-pack box only to discover upon reading the list of ingredients on the bottom of a container that sugar was listed second.  As one who needs to watch my sugar intake I find this disappointing.

column9: Crunchy and Cheesy With a Catch
column10: Saw these locally on an end of the aisle display and impulsively threw a box into the cart. We often eat packs of cheese crackers for lunch; this is a brand I hadn't tried before.The light colored crackers contain a generous amount of "cheese". They are very crunchy and flavorful, so much so that when finished I wanted to open another pack but resisted.Some things to consider:The crackers are filled with "cheddar cheese flavored filling."One package is 210 calories, 100 of which are from fat.The sodium content is 370mgBy comparison, a package of Lance cheese crackers has 190 calories and 270mg of sodium.A package of Ritz cracker sandwiches has 200 calories and 440 mg of sodium.I wouldn't eat the Munchies on a daily basis, but for an occasional snack or lunch they are quite tasty.
This is a superb Tea. I am not a fan of fruity teas in general but this light tea is very good. Being caffeine-less, it's great to drink throughout the day.
Although this vanilla powder is not as powerful flavor-wise as I'd expected, I can't complain. It's great for those times when extract isn't practical.

I use a ton (okay ... exaggerated) of this vanilla powder.  Lattes, tea, coffee, baking, oatmeal, cold cereal ... anywhere you want that sweet floral goodness that is vanilla.  Plus it doesn't have the alcohol AND it doesn't drip.  Perfection!  I even keep it in a shaker bottle right next to the salt and pepper 'cause I use it so much.Highly recommended!Bourbon Madagascar Vanilla Powder 16 oz.

I use this salt for this Kalua Pig In A Slow Cooker recipe I found, and man is it delicious. 4 pound pork butt, 1 tablespoon of this salt, and 2 tablespoons liquid smoke. Put it in a crockpot/slow cooker for 20 hours, and you have one of the simplest and most delicious dishes ever. I used regular sea salt my first time cooking it, but then ordered this to try it the "real" way, and it was even better.

This salt's grain is pretty large for table use, but has a really nice flavor and attractive color.  I have recommended this to my friends who need to watch their salt intake because you can "see" just how much salt you are using.
I really like this sea salt -- has a different flavor, and it's very colorful to use on veggies.

Used it in a recipe for pulled-pork.  Had never heard of it before and couldn't find it locally.  Ordered it and Himalayan sea salt from Fairies Finest.  I'd procrastinated and was afraid it wouldn't arrive in time, so I called and they promised to get it in the mail right away.  Showed up in 3 days.The salt has undertones of clay, which gives it a deeper flavor and was used as a rub it the recipe.  The liquid smoke overpowered it, but the flavor was there.  I think it best used as a rub or finishing salt.There is also black Hawaiian salt... somehow mixed in with lava!  Have to try that next...P.S.  The salt was well packaged in a jar.

This made the best kahlua pork for my son's luau party - tasted great. I will say, this is a lot of salt - be prepared to store it for a while. I have also used it in a salt grinder for smaller grain salt. Tastes different than Kosher or other salts. Nice product.
Great taste if you like snow cones and peaches...you'll love this.  Also bought Bubble Gum and that is also delicious!!!

column9: A true treat even without a martini!
column10: I have gotten these olives on two different occasions. They come in three arousingdelicious flavor's. Their often used in martini's, though their a great treat on their own merit!
If you like Martini's, Maynard&Child Premium Variety stuffed olives are a must.  They have great flavour and do well on an olive pick in vodka and gin martini's.

column9: These are fantastic and would make a great gift!
column10: All three of these are delicious. The are meaty and fresh-tasting. I honestly can't decide which one is the best. All three are very addictive. They come nicely packaged and would make a great gift for the olive lover or martini drinker that you know.

column9: Maynard& Child Premium variety gift pack stuffed olives
column10: I would never purchase again! Flavor was not to my liking! Shipping came quickly but who wants them if they were did not taste good!

Charlee Bears are small and low calorie, so you can use them en masse for training.  We use them both for standard training (sit, stay, drop it, leave it) and behavioral training (no bark).  They're not stinky or messy, so you can put them in your pocket, purse, or car without worry.  We keep a small bag in the car for travel to reinforce when our puppy doesn't bark at people walking by, one by the door to reinforce when she goes to the bathroom outside, and a bunch of treats in a treat bag for travel.The one downside to these is that because they're not as stinky, it can be harder to use them to get your dog's attention if he or she is distracted, like at the dog park or if you have a bunch of visitors.  Our trick to get around this is that we put some stinky treats in the treat bag with these, and they'll take on some of the scent (We use Pro-Treat Beef Liver, Freeze Dried Dog Treats, 21 Ounce).Our dog loves all flavors.

Buy this if you're looking for a unique gift; shipping was blazing fast and was in perfect shape when arrived.

Wow! My friend Tina comes up to me with this herb tea, to which she's added, of all things, SUGAR and CREAM... I was maybe skeptical, but it was delicious. I need to cut the carbs so I substitute Splenda, but it's still excellent. Just try finding it in a store...

I have read reviews of this being a weak tea...I find it full of flavor and the aroma just wakes up the whole house...it is like drinking gingerbread cookies...and no sugar or honey is needed...this is one of my winter staples

column9: Best Tea I have ever had
column10: I instantly fell in love after taking a teabag from the box. Right away the scent hits you and just makes you think this tea will be very spicey and sharp.Once it's made, it seems to have a warm "fresh baked" flavor to it but still a very strong (pleasant) ginger-spice flavor. Just make sure you only steep it UP to 5 mins. (I find that Sugar Cookie Sleigh ride can be steeped as long as you want, and only gets better. This one can get a bit too strong very quick.I was afraid to try it for the longest time, since I'm not a HUGE fan of gingerbread, but wow. I just ordered 6 more boxes and will keep it in my house forever!If you like spice teas, or even warm "cinnamon" type teas, Please give this one a chance!The only con to it is that I have never seen it in a store, even very hard to find around Christmas.

I have purchased several boxes of this tea locally, and enjoyed it. The two boxes I purchased from this vendor did not have the ginger/cinnamon scent...in fact they have a strange chemical smell. I am afraid to drink it.

The Keurig system has brought me back to drinking coffee and tea. I went from having one cup of coffee a year to having a couple of cups each week.I have to stick to decaf, so I was very happy to see that there are flavored decaf coffees for the K-cup system. I especially enjoy Timothy's brand of Hazelnut decaf over Gloria Jean's version. Timothy's seems to have a richer, fuller and a bit smoother taste over Gloria Jean's. The Gloria Jean's tastes watered down to me. The hazelnut flavor almost disappears when I add milk. Timothy's holds it flavor even with half and half added.

This is the only flavored k-cup coffee I like enough to order again and again.  It's good enough that I choose it even when my husband has caffeinated coffee brewing in the next pot over.  I tried Green Mountain flavored k-cup coffee and didn't like any of the flavors much, even though I do like those same flavors when I get it sometimes at the local coffee shop, brewed not k-cup.  This is a mild coffee but the flavor is enjoyable and realistic.
I really like Timothy's k-cups.  The choices for decaf, flavored coffee is limited, and I was glad to find one that has such a great taste.

We have now owned a Keurig (actually three of them: home/business/RV) for almost two years.  We don't always drink flavored coffee, but when we do this is one of our very favorites.  As a rule, Timothy's brand is our favorite K-Cups in any variety.  Amazon offers one of the most competitive prices, and paired with the accumulated savings our Amazon Visa offers, we don't buy our coffee anywhere else!
I don't drink decaf often, but now that I've found this K-cup, that might change. It's very flavorful and actually tastes like quality coffee. I liked it enough to "subscribe and save."

I've never run across a Timothy coffee - I use decaf - that has failed to satisy me, and this is no exception.  Plenty of body and a nice hazlenut flavor - I mix it with French or other dark roasts to get the strength I like, and I really don't mind decaf at all now since I've switched to premium brands such as this.

This is a great tasting coffee for those who like to go caffeine-free later in the evening.  I like the hint of sweetness from the hazelnut flavoring, and the coffee has enough flavor to make the 10 oz. size without tasting watered down.

I have purchased a Keurig Coffee maker this Christmas for my family who all like different flavors of coffee. We also have a Keurig at work and my company supplies another brand of Hazel Nut Decaffeinated which I drink daily. After researching K-Cup coffees online, I found Timothy's World and because of the great rating from users, I purchased it. Well, it is great tasting,flavorful and I enjoy it more than the brand we have  at work. I will continue purchasing this coffee for home and I recommend it for others to try. I can't drink caffein, but I am guessing that the regular Hazelnut is even more flavorful.
I find Timothy's Hazelnut a good buy and a very good product.  The flavor is as good or better than the more expensive products.
This is my 2nd favorite coffee since I have to drink decaf. My first favorite is Hazlenut CREAM decaf, but I cannot always find it.

Coffee lovers have very individual tastes. Recognizing that, all I can say is that for me and my family this is the best decaf hazelnut coffee that we have found. For us it has a nice aroma and tastes great.Update November 12, 2009: This is still the best for us, and we have tried several others.

column9: Dirty confessions of a husband whose wife LOVES this coffee
column10: Personally, I (the husband) perfer BOLD regular coffee, and I am constantly shoppoing around, trying different flavors from different companies.  My wife drinks mostly decaf.  We stumbled onto this Hazelnut Decaf brand from Timothy's many months ago, and she LOVES it.  So much so, that I am fearful of the day when she will report with glee that it is 'better than sex'.Being as I am always trying new coffees, and I am the one that orders our coffee since I am on the computer all day, once in a while I order her something different...BIG MISTAKE.While she would agree none of the others have been 'horrible' (I always read all of the reviews and get a pretty good sense from the Amazon gang before I pull the trigger), according to her, I've nearly committed the unpardonable sin.  She silently pouts until she runs out of whatever it is, but until then, meals become bland(er) and our sex life mysteriously suffers.SO I LEARN MY LESSON!...and I order her Timothy's Hazelnut Decaf...for a few orders...THEN I REMEMBER THAT I AM A MAN AGAIN!I'm bold, adventerous, and want to see what I can get by with...(similar to my ad on [...]) so I sneak in another order of something else...GARGANTUAN MISTAKE!The blood-curdling scream could be heard exactly at 6:20 AM downstairs.  I heard words that would drive a sailor wild with passion.  There is stomping, crashing, howling, glass breaking, and of course the scariest of all...the sound of the shotgun being pumped.  I'm trembling and scared to death and dare not look, knowing I will see her head spinning and green vomit flying everywhere.-----------So my dear beloved male friends out there in Amazon Reviewland, if your wife LOVES this coffee, be faithful to her and stick with it.Sincerely,Faithful in Tulsa
Mom and I enjoyed this coffee very well and I wanted to get more, even monthly, but the price is ridiculous now! That is so sad for me.

I drink coffee mostly at night now so I was looking for a good decaf for my Keurig.  I like this one the best so far, the hazelnut adds enough flavor that I don't even use sweetener any more.  I'm not a coffee connoisseur by any means, I just like something not too bitter with some kick.  This one fits my needs.

I enjoy drinking a good cup of hazelnut flavored  decaffenated coffee. This product is  smoother than Dunkin Donuts, and a little richer than McDonalds. You can not beat the price of less than 50 cents a cup.Thanks again Amazon
We have found k cups tend to make weak coffee, but Timothy's is better than others. We like the hazelnut flavor

column9: sorry to say, this is the worst hazelnut coffee i ever bought
column10: after years of enjoying my keurig coffee maker with all kinds of coffees, this is the worst coffee i have ever bought from you guys. it is weak, thin underbodied, no nut taste whatsoever. hardly even a coffee taste. no wake up feeling at all. what a dissappointment never again will i buy this one

I drink de-caf only. I like a stonger decaf, like Coffee Peoples Decaf Donut Shop Blend, Extra Bold...  I usually like TImothys Decaf Columbian, so when I saw that Timothys had a decaf hazelnut, I figured I would try it.Its ok. the flavor is not bold. keep in mind, I have a Keurig mini, so there is only 1 cup size as an option, and thats the smallest size there is, and even using the smallest cup size, this coffee is weak by the time you add milk or creamer.The good thing is, its not bitter..  but, I can only imagine how weak this would taste if you set your Keurig for any size other than the smallest-- I bet the coffee would be undrinkable.As for the hazelnut flavor itself, its ok, as well..  Definitely not too strong, and the hazelnut flavot itself leans a *bit* toward the weak side. if you want more hazelnut flavor, I would say add hazelnut creamer.Again, overall, its just ok. I have 44 of these K-cups.. I will evenntually drink them, but it will take a long, long time... I dont hate it, although when I run out, I wont be buying this flavor again.
Wow!  Timothy's Hazelnut decaf is one of my favorites.  It's smooth tasting andnot bitter.  Great for an afternoon coffee break.

I'm not usually a fan of flavored coffees...but Timothy's Decaf Hazelnut-flavored coffee is awesome...I like a milder coffee with plenty of flavor and this one fits the bill.  I just put it on auto delivery today!

column9: Still searching for my lost cup of decaf java
column10: I need to have a decaf coffee, and in this new, one-cup coffee-world I now embrace where regular coffee reigns in default, Timothy's hazelnut decaf rates an okay.  I would like to have the coffee stronger, for it is a bit thin and watery.  Yet I've surrendered and have gotten used to it, would buy it again, and find I need less cream or calories.  So this is a plus.  But overall I am still searching for my great cup of decaf.

Found the coffee to have a lush aroma of Hazelnut.  The coffee was not as strong/bold as I prefer however, with the option to brew at a smaller cup size I'm completely satisfied.  Fits my requirement of decaff and flavored.  I give it four stars.
I was looking for a decaf coffee for late afternoon with just a little flavor.  This is just perfect, it is not too flavored, with just a hint of hazelnut.

column9: very smooth, great tasting cup of coffee
column10: I really enjoy this coffee.  I brew it on the the "middle" size.  In the morning I prefer a stronger cup of coffee (unflavored), but this is the perfect coffee for after dinner.

I am very happy with the coffee.  It was sent in a timely fashion and was exactly what I ordered.  You  made it very easy to order and I will be getting re-orders at the appropriate times as initially specified in the original order.
Very good flavor for decaf. Somewhat sweeter than others I've tried.  Would buy again.
This coffee is very good. A nice rich smooth flavor.The coffee has a nice creamy flavor also. One of the best there is!
Great aroma and flavor as good as the regular coffee selections. Very convenient and economical.
This lightly flavored decaf is perfect for that last cup before bed time. It is smooth and flavored enough to forget it is "just" decaf. It is good black or with a touch of cream.
It is very hard to find flavored decaf coffee for the Keurig coffee.  I have really enjoyed it and the price is great.
This Canadian Company puts out a great product. Smooth and rich with just the right amount of hazelnut taste.
This is not a bad coffee, but it is a little more bitter than I like my coffee to be.

I have been a K-coffee user for some time and I especially like Timothy's. I ordered this flavored coffee and the regular decaf at a very good price with the Amazon 1-day sale.  All the K-cup varieties are good and your K-pot makes a fresh cup in 30 sec.  Amazon delivered the coffee in just a couple of days and I'm still enjoying it.  Thanks, Amazon and Keurig.  When are you going to have another sale?  I don't hesitate to purchase at the regular price because I really enjoy the coffee, but sales allow us buy more!

I've explored a lot of coffee sites and can not beat Amazon's price once you consider shipping and handling costs with other sites. All my k-cup purchases ship free because I'm willing to wait a few days (and I mean just a few days!) and with subscribe & save I get an even better deal.If you use a lot of k-cups like me, then this is a sweetheart of a deal you should really consider!!
This coffee is not great. It has burned, sour, and bitter taste to the skip. I will skip it next time.
Timothy's seemed to be the only Hazlenut decaf available for the Keurig.  It is delicious.  We are very pleased and recommend it highly!

Based on the average review, I decided to try this coffee because I was hoping to find a better decaf hazelnut than the Green Mountain which tends to be a little weak.  The taste was not appealing at all and it had a syrupy quality to it.  I do not recommend this product and now I am stuck with a lot of coffee I'll never use.
I was looking for a decaf that was not bitter and with the hazelnut flavor and this one hits the spot.

This is a great coffee, and you would never know it was decaf without reading the box. It is a medium body roast, and the hazelnut flavor comes through nicely. I often drink it in the late afternoon/early evening, when I am craving a cup of coffee but do not want to be up all night long. It tastes just as good as it smells while brewing, and is great hot or iced.
This decaf coffee is delicious and the price was super and the delivery was very fast.  I will order from them when my current supply is running low.  Thanks!

I liked the flavor of this coffee, but it seemed to clog up my Keurig coffee maker about 25 percent of the time; this meant that I had to waste fifty cents about once every other day.  I'm not sure if this happened because it is decaf coffee, but I've never had a problem with any of the other brands and I clean my coffee maker out regularly.  I do not recommend buying the decaf version until the Timothy brand has figured this problem out.  Money wasted for sure!
I love all the Timothy's coffee but this one is my favorite. It has such a great taste. I will continue to buy this product.

column9: Decaffeinated coffee that actually tastes good
column10: Timothy's hazelnut is the first decaf coffee that I have tasted that is really good on its own.  With the Keurig, you must use the small cup button or the coffee becomes weak.  Sometimes I add 1/2 packet of hot chocolate, and it is delicious.
One of the better decaf coffees that I've enjoyed.  Decaf is difficult to find in the stores.  Glad to purchase it here.
Timothy's hazelnut flavored decaf coffee K cups are the best coffee I've made with my Keurig Brewer.  Really delicious and decaf!

I have tried Green Mountain and Gloria Jeans decaf hazelnut and Timothy's beats them hands down.The Hazelnut flavor is stronger and smoother and it has no chemical aftertaste.  Smells good while brewing, tastes good and does not keep me up a night!

This is a decent coffee that's not to acidic or bitter and for me has a better hazelnut flavor then a few other's I've tried like Gloria Jean's and Green Mountain. I'm sure that could change at any time but for now if you can find it for under 50 cents a cup it's worth the purchase. I haven't tried the Van Houtte but like anything else you get what tastes best for you and then complain it's too expensive.

This is one of my everyday coffees.  I find Timothy's coffees to be full bodied and the flavoring not overdone.  There are limited choices in flavored decaf and this hazelnut flavor makes for an enjoyable morning cup.

It took a long time, and several tries, to find the right hazelnut decaf k-cup. And this is IT. The hazelnut flavor doesn't overwhelm, but stands up to milk or cream and certainly works without either. This, BTW, is the first hazelnut decaf to fool the non-decaf drinkers in our house, so it must be as good as I think it is.
I have tried many brands and flavors of the K-Cups and this by far beats them all in my opinion. This is the only one I order on a regular basis. Try IT!! You will not be disappointed.
The Hazelnut flavor was very weak and the coffee was a little bitter.I have tried other coffees by Timothy's World and was happy with those.

I love the taste of this product.  However, in a standard 24 count pack, you can expect to lose 3 cups due to the fact that the quality of the internal filter fails.  Your coffee mug will be full of coffee grounds.  I thought my machine was faulty at first until I opened up the k-cup to find that the filter had collapsed from the walls and caused the grounds to go all over the place.  I've decided to move on to another brand.
It's so nice to have a good flavored coffee in decaf.  This is a good brand.
This is one of the best tasting flavored coffees I have every purchased. I am very satisifed and will order again.
There aren't many flavored decaff K-Cups available.  This one was good, just a little strong.
Timothy's Hazelnut decaf  is the best, Great flavor, smooth, just wonderful.  Everyone loves it.  Thanks for a great decaf hazelnut.  Love the K cups, I drink more coffee and love it.
Timothy's has real hazelnut flavor, no bitter aftertaste. It is delicious no matter what cup size it is brewed at.  Also this product priced just right.

After reading all the reviews I decided to give Tomthy's Decaf Hazelnut coffee a try. The reviews were right. I use the k-cups at work. I love the aroma and even after adding half and half it maintains the delightfull hazelnut scent. I also like it because it is not overly strong or weak. I plan on getting the monthly subscription. The price is right and you can't beat the convenience of having it delivered to your home. I was spending over $50 a month and that was just for 1 large cup of Hazelnut coffee 5 times a week. Now it will cost me less than $26.
great flavor for a decaf in hazelnut. Really glad to find such a good flavored hazelnut in a decaf. Highly recommended.

This brand was not my first choice, but the price was right, so I thought I'd give it a try. I really enjoy it late in the day!! It's smooth and not bitter. Just the right amount of Hazelnut flavor...not too overpowering!

If you like a bolder blend of coffee, this blend is wonderful without an overpowering Hazelnut flavor that takes over the coffee.  It is very smooth even though it is a bolder blend.  I prefer the large mug button on my Keurig, more for your money, right?  I loved the Columbian decaf by Timothy's so I thought I would like this as well.  Just awesome is all I can say :)

I am a fan of the Timothy's line of Keurig K-Cups, and the Hazelnut Decaf is one of its best products.  Unlike some flavored decafs, Timothy's Hazelnut is full-bodied in taste.  Its pleasant, nutty flavored edge is a bonus, and those who enjoy flavored coffees will love this one.  It is the perfect decaf to serve after a lovely dinner or first thing in the morning.  Once you have tasted it, Timothy's Hazelnut Decaf will be an important part of your life with coffee.

Mom is 87 years young. She was not a coffee drinker but after sipping Tim's Hazelnut Decaff K cup it quickly became her favorite.The smooth taste and rich aroma are pleasent to the taste buds any time of day. Other flavors come and go but Tim's Hazelnut Decaff is a keeper.

Timothy's Hazelnut Decaffeinated Coffee K-Cups are convenient and a flavored respite from regular decaf coffee.  A bit more hazelnut flavor would really make this a 5-star product.  It's not bad, but it's not the best flavor we've found.

This is really awful coffee.  For some reason, Amazon stopped carrying the Gloria Jeans hazelnut decaf, which actually tastes like hazelnut, and coffee.  This coffee is weak, even on the strongest brew selection, and the vanilla and hazelnut taste very similar.  I don't know if Timothy's is at fault, or whether Amazon shipped five year old stale cups, but I can't in good faith recommend this product.
I do not use this, but my wife does.  This coffee is okay according to my wife.  Sher perfers Green Mountain version which is not offered by Amazon.

column9: not a strong coffee, but good flavor all around
column10: I have to drink decaf coffee right now because I'm undergoing chemo, so I'm always on the hunt for decaf K-cups, especially flavored ones (no choco flavor, please--blegh!). I ordered these and put them on subscribe and save to reap even more discount benefits.My usual coffee tastes run to medium strength coffees, not bold ones or too-mild versions that look more like tea when done brewing. I usually make the largest size cup of coffee my Keurig will make, and these hazelnut K-cups are a little mild when done that way. However, they're excellent with the medium-sized cup option, and I really get a stronger hazelnut flavor that way.The hazelnut flavor is not overpowering regardless of cup size, and it blends nicely with the usual coffee flavors to create a cup that is fragrant and tasty without being overwhelming. I sweeten mine with agave nectar and add a little organic milk to the cup, and the combo is delicious.I do recommend this coffee for anyone who doesn't want a bold cuppa.
I was very happy to see that K-cups came not only in decaffeinated coffee but flavored decaffeinated as well.

The product is probably fine, but I failed to note that it was DECAF.  I got excited about the price and flavor (my wife's favorite) and failed to notice the DECAF.  Unfortunately I am now stuck with several unopened boxes I can't return due to the return policy that would not exist if I just paid regular price in a store.  No problem with the coffee (my wife loves the regular), just be careful as you can't correct for quick reads.

This makes a great cup of coffee.  I do not drink alot of coffee so having a single coffee maker is perfect cup every time.  I love it.I highly recommended. It makes so much easier because you don't have toclean the coffee ground, all you have to do is throw the K-cups out tothe trash and your done.
This is a great price, and to have it have it delivered by weekly can't go wrong, and the coffee is good

I received an email from Amazon that the product I have on order has to be modified to a larger quantity (2 24s to 50) . I followed their instructions and it didn't work. I also noticed that when they ship on repeat orders they raise the price on you

column9: Finally used this product, and I like it
column10: I bought this for my daughter, thinking she might want some cereal as a change of pace in her school lunches. Didn't happen, so the item sat in my kitchen cabinet for several months. I had to get a lunch together for myself in about two minutes' time last week, and I thought of this product. It holds just the right amount of cereal and milk, and the milk stayed cold. I took it to a "working lunch" with my ladies' organization, and quite a few of the ladies said they wanted one, too. My only advice is to be very careful when taking the top off of the cereal compartment, because the cereal could go flying if you're not careful with the snap-on lid. If it had been made with a screw top, I would have given it five stars.I'm glad I bought this, and that my daughter didn't want it.

I absolutely love this cute little cereal holder.  It works like a charm.  I've been using almost everyday.  I don't like to leave open cartons of milk at work, so this gadget allows me to bring my milk from home each morning.  Plus, it doesn't leak at all!

column9: EZ-FREEZE STAYFIT TM CEREAL ON THE GO

It was the most intense heat I have ever experienced, and it left me not wanting to breath.  My sinuses were instantly cleared.  I now use a level teaspoon instead of a heaping teaspoon, to great effect.I'm sold!

column9: look like a genius in the kitchen
column10: Every time I make this for guests, it gets rave reviews.  I use chicken breast tenderloins and cook that with sauteed onions.  Boil up some bok choy till tender and throw that in when you add the seasoning (I use the whole packet for one pound of chicken) and coconut milk.  Serve with white rice for a sure winner every time.A Taste of Thai products consistently has the best and freshest tasting seasoning mixes.  Also recommended:  Spicy Peanut Bake.

This makes an amazingly delicious red curry! I add 1 packet of paste, 2 cans coconut milk (the real stuff, with the fat), 2 Tablespoons fish sauce, 3 chicken breast, 1 red pepper, 1 can of pineapple, 1 small can of bamboo shoots, and 1/4 cup sugar. Chop and simmer it all for about 30 minutes, and serve over rice. It has just the right amount of heat, and tastes like something you would get from an authentic Thai restaurant. Of course, you can use whatever veggies you have on hand, these are just my favorites. I make a large pot, and freeze it in individual containers for a super-fast meal. Taste of Thai Red Curry Paste, I don't know what I would do without you!! (Actually I do, and my Thai take-out bills would be outrageous!)

column9: good stuff at a good price
column10: I enjoyed having the opportunity to stock up on this Thai Red Curry Paste, which I've used before but which tends to be more expensive than I'd like when purchased in the local store.  It keeps well, and with a couple of cans of coconut milk and plenty of veggies, I've always got the makings of a good, spicy, satisfying meal on hand.

This is a great and delicious way to eat Thia food at home.  Just "melt" the entire packet (if you like it spicy) into two cans of coconut milk in a pan.  Then add your favorite meat and veggies.  I usually use chicken strips and a bag of frozen asian veggies.

If you like hot, this is hot.  My wife used to buy this in a local store but it is no longer available.  I checked on Amazon.com where I make most of my internet purchases and there it was.  This stuff is GREAT!

While the restaurants always do it best, these curry pastes are pretty tasty. It's easy to use,  fast, and you can add the meat and veggies of your choice. For those of you scared of something spicy, you might use a little less, but for most, it's just right, and for those that like it spicier, you can add a little crushed red pepper. Since the coconut milk has to be added separately, you can also control the fat content--you can go light or go with the much yummier, creamy stuff.

A Taste of Thai has become increasingly my favorite brand for pastes and mixes. Their Red Curry paste is thick with a rich, robust flavor. Excellent in curries, it is also great as a marinade for grilled chicken or beef. I've also used it in a blend with soy sauce, Lee Kum Kee's premium oyster sauce, and lime juice for fried noodles. Depending on your palate, you may find the level of spice mild or a touch spicy. Being Asian, I find it on the mild side. A few American friends who have tried my curries and fried noodles made with this paste have declared the spice has just the right amount of zing. Your mileage may vary.

I'm quite picky when it comes to my curries. I've tried many American products and found them bland and washed-out. I've also tried many curry pastes imported FROM Thailand that I had picked up at my local Asian store... but this is by far the best out there.

column10: OMG this is delicious! Easy, quick and very yummy, I ate some leftover straight from fridge and it was still wonderful cold. Husband loved this as well, try it, try it!

I have a great recipe for Thai Red Curry Mussels (foodnetwork) that is easy and delish. But I have also used this with "non recipes" such as adding a tablespoon to my mac & cheese to kick it up, or a tablespoon to my plain white rice.  Just doing that makes you a food genius.

*So* simple to use. Makes one of our favourite easy home cooked meals. Cut up chicken (breast or thighs) into cubes, then fry up the paste briefly, add one or two tins of coconut cream, stir, when that starts to simmer add in the chicken. Leave to simmer until chicken cooked - maybe 15 or 20 mins. Use more paste for a hotter dish, less coconut cream if not making a lot.... use the 'lite' coconut milk if you want it to be a little less heavy..... add in vegetables if you want..... a red capsicum/bell pepper goes well with it.... if you have some fresh corriander, throw that in as well. If you don't use the whole packet of paste, just keep it in the fridge - it lasts for a while. Serve on basmati rice with some corriander on top if you have any. At this point I'd also note the wonders of an automatic rice cooker - throw in a few cups of rice, match that with the same amount (or possibly a little more depending on the cooker) and press the 'go' button.Basically, ten minutes of effort at most and you end up with a beautiful tasting meal within 30 minutes. Both the rice and curry left overs freeze well too [in separate containers].We can't get this curry paste locally any more. We now buy it in bulk, getting enough to last us for a year or so. Thank you, Amazon!

I am so happy I read the reviews here! I had bought a red curry paste from another brand before and I was very disappointed with the results but then I started reading the reviews here and decided to give this one a try and I am thrilled I did. This paste has very good flavor and I feel that the heat is just enough for me and my husband. I absolutely loved it and I am happy that I got the 12 pack. Now I am set for a while.

Used to use another brand (that changed), in a jar, but this is so much better!  Has a very pleasing spicy taste with a hint of lemon/lime and a fair amount of heat.  It is a little too salty though, if you like to use a fair amount to "spice it up".  We wish it had a lower sodium content.  While, made from scratch with fresh ingredients is always better; this is the next best thing!  Really good with shrimp, imitation crab/lobster, chicken, beef, pork and veggie dishes.  Quick and easy to make good-for-you meals.  We don't like the packaging and wish it were in a jar, but other than that and the sodium content, we like it.  Will buy again!

This red curry paste is indispensable for yummy thai-style dishes.  It makes the process so easy.  Just look at the short directions on the back of the pkg. and use your own chicken, shrimp, veggies or whatever you like.

column9: Great solution to pilling your cat!
column10: I love pill pockets. They are a much more pleasant way (both for me and my cat) to give my cat her pills.I have two qualifications, though. First, I would recommend using the chicken flavor over the salmon. Recent lots of salmon pill pockets have contained fairly large pieces of bone, which might have caused problems if I hadn't caught them and my cat had swallowed them. I contacted the company, and they were very nice and refunded my money, but they did say it was due to the salmon meal and didn't seem to be very worried about it. So, I stick to the chicken now.Secondly, I think the pockets as made are too large. If I put a big pill in the full pill pocket, my cat just eats around the pill pretty easily. So I usually break the pill and the pocket into smaller pieces, so my cat just pretty much swallows them whole. Not a big deal, and a solution if your cat figures them out as quickly as mine did.

column9: BE CAREFUL WHAT YOU ARE ORDERING

column10: love the product. always moist and my 15 y/o male kitty is now on meds twice daily and this makes medicating soooo easy. he comes calling for his "medicine" every morning and night. will purchase again!

column9: Easy to give even large pills; how to increase its appeal
column10: I've never bought a six-pack - I buy four at a time from an amazon.com store. But I've used this product regularly for well over a year, and it will usually administer even a large pill (Azodyl, which is very large for cats) without a fuss. His Majesty will then eat it willingly, nineteen times of out twenty.In fact, I have to cut this short because he's pawing at me. He has food, so no doubt I need to get an Azodyl and fix him a doctored Pill Pocket.Good stuff!! Thanks for making it, Greenies!

column9: No more problems with my cats medication
column10: 6-PACK Pill Pockets for Cats SALMON 9.6 oz (270 pockets) Every day was a battlefield at home triying to medicate my cats because the medicine is extra bitter, and the problems gone with pill pockets. They enjoy to eat them.
Not easy to give pills to my stubborn kitty.  She didn't notice pills were inside of Pill Pockets.  My cat approved!

If you have problems giving your cat medication, this is the best thing ever made. My cat loves the taste and even seems to know what time he is to take his pill. I would recommend this product to anyone who has a problem getting pills into their cat.
Its a great way to get yopur cats to take their medecine
My old kittie has heart and thyroid trouble and is on four pills morning and night. These pill pockets make it so much easier to give him the medication! He gobbles them right up!

column9: Pill time has never been so easy
column10: My cat loves these almost as much as I do. You just slip the pill in the hollow and push the pill pocket to cover the pill. It's pliable so it will accommodate any size pill. We have to give her three capsules a day and I simply put each in a pill pocket and put it in front of her. She gobbles it right up.Update 5-30-12: I have taken to splitting these in half and they still cover my cat's pills just fine, are easier for her to swallow, and it saves me money.
Great price for an excellent product.  My cat takes 3 pills twice a day and he takes them well in these pockets.

column9: Pill Pockets make my kitty happy!
column10: Easy way to give the kitty her pills. She doesn't even try to eat around the medication!

We've used Greenies pill pockets with our elderly kitty for his three daily pills for over a year.  He considers medicine a treat.  He has hardly any teeth now so I only use 1/2 a pocket per pill and this works fine, too.

Though these pill pockets are very effective (and tasty) for dispensing medication to my cat, the Amazon web page clearly shows the ingredients to include probiotics. The 6-pack of Greenies which I ordered and received from Pet Vet Vitamin Shop do not list any probiotics in the ingredients on the packages. This merchant was unable to explain the discrepancy.

Before discovering pill pockets I had to have my cat's medications compounded into liquid form at a specialty pharmacy.  This proved to be more expensive than the pill form which he wouldn't take. Additionally, administering the meds was difficult for me as I had to pry his mouth open twice daily to unload the syringe.With the pill pockets I just drop them atop his food and they are the first thing to go... Also, he is elderly with very few teeth and is able to "gum" them.They are the best thing to happen to pet meds since the aerocat!

These Pork Chomps seem much easier for my 10-month-old beagles to chew than regular rawhide.  They both get very excited when they see me with the bag!  I like the fact that they seem just the right saw to hold in their paws and there is never anything left when they are done chewing!

column9: Easier to digest than beef rawhide and dog just as happy!
column10: I have a black Toy Poodle that has been chewing on beef rawhide bones practically since the day he was born.  However, his tummy always got a little upset from it and I heard the pork is easier for them to digest, so I switched to these Pork Chomps.  He loves them just as much (if not more) and now his tummy is more settled.  Plus, just like all-natural beef rawhides they do not stink or break into smaller pieces or discolor my blankets/sofa, like many other kinds of treats/bones .  They are odorless, they have no color and they stay in one piece until eaten in full.  Conclusion:  They ROCK!!!  My other "can't-do-without" dog supplement is called "Missing Link."  That product is A-MA-ZING as well and, along with a diet FREE of grain/flour/soy/sugar/preservatives, it has completely stopped him from scratching himself and knawing on his paws).

I've been giving these pork chomp knotz to my Shiba Inu puppy since he was just 3 or 4 months old. He is 11 months old now and these are by far his favorite thing to chew on. He's about 30 lbs and these 3-4" knotz are perfect for his mouth size. I just got a 9 week old puppy and I've gotten him the mini knotz as well and he really enjoys chewing on these. It's perfect for teething pups and for older dogs as well. They love the taste as far as I can tell and always chew through the whole thing! Highly recommend!!

I was about to run out of some very good saffron from Spain when I ordered this product. I looked up the company that packages the saffron before ordering it, "Bahraman" saffron, to make sure it is a legitimate company (it is).I would say that this saffron is about 20% darker, and the threads about 30% longer than the one I had from Spain, which was a very nice surprise. The threads are all a deep brick red and there are no cheap yellow threads to lessen the cost for the supplier or the quality for the consumer.The aroma, flavor, and coloring ability are all excellent. I could even smell it slightly through the packaging that it was mailed in.The only thing I would change is for it to be packaged in a hard acrylic case or glass bottle (as long as it didn't raise the price more than a dollar). It comes in a sealed bag, which must be transferred to another container once opened.There is no reason whatsoever to buy old and bad saffron from the grocery store for many times the price of this one. This would last most people at least a year (unless you make paella or Persian food frequently).Salud!P.S. Just a tip, never buy powdered saffron unless you have bought whole saffron from that company before. Not only will it lose its aroma sooner, but there is a reasonably high probability that it has been adulterated and isn't pure saffron. Also, if you sneeze, there goes $20 all over the kitchen counter!P.P.S. If you want to make a serious "foodie" happy, buy this for them but transfer it to a nice glass spice jar. They'll think you spent many times more than you did. I know it would make my birthday a great one.
Haven't tried it yet, but it looks beautiful. No yellow strands or mysterious red dust in the bag.And even through the packaging I can smell how wonderful it will be!

I uploaded a photo here (see images) of the packaging in which my saffron came.The color is much redder than shown in my photo and the subtle nuances of high quality saffron are apparent when you cook with it. I use it to make risotto and sometimes with aged basmati rice (garnishing the rice with summac when it is ready to serve.)Because this product is not always available I sometimes use Iranian Saffron (actually labeled as Sharifian Saffron on the packaging).  Either product contains enough saffron to last between six months to a year for normal usage.
Amazon-Japan just stopped selling dolphin meat. I have not tried the advertised product, but I appreciate Amazon's (a) selling dolphin-safe tuna in the US, and (b) showing good judgment abroad.

****Stash's Wild Raspberry Caffeine Free Herbal Tea is strong and fruity, great if you love the taste of raspberry and hibiscus, which I do. It contains hibiscus, orange peel, lemongrass, rosehips, natural raspberry flavor, licorice powder, and citric acid. The package says it also contains soy, but that makes little sense to me. It is a fine tasting herb tea.If you like a more subtle tea, you may not be crazy about Wild Raspberry. But if you like Celestial Seasonings and other commercial teas, I think that this is a good one. column9: If you like lime you'll love this mild sauce
column10: This is my favorite sauce and I use it frequently. Piri Piri is a lime-flavored hot sauce. You will enjoy it if you like hot sauces for their flavor. It does have the vinegary, salt, chile flavors one associates with hot sauces, but do not look to it for heat because it is not very hot.I would rate this product 5 stars if not for its packaging. Individual bottles are very small, although this particular product comes with six bottles. One good thing about the packaging is that the top has a small opening so not too much comes out at one time. The cap stays relatively clean.I seriously cannot get enough of this hot sauce and I put it on everything. I hope it becomes your favorite hot sauce too!

column9: A good hot sauce with a lemon twist
column10: Piri Piri sauce is like tabasco sauce with the addition of a few ingredients, in the case of this item, lemon, onions, garlic and "spices".  Piri piri can be used for anything you would use tabasco or any other hot sauce, especially if you wanted a little lemon zing.  I especially like to use it in gumbo or rice with beans and especially seafood.  Take a can of coconut milk, a can of drained pineapple chunks, two chopped tomatoes, a finely chopped onion and one finely chopped clove of garlic, bring to a simmer and add a pound of shrimp and piri piri sauce to taste.  Simmer until the shrimp is done -- when it turns pink.  Serve over white rice.

column9: Not a fan of caramel...but I love me some Rolos!
column10: This pack of Rolo candies comes with four 12-ounce bags with each bag containing 56 Rolos.  I wasn't able to find a better price online for this many, so I really think they're a great deal.Rolo's have always been one of my favorite candies.  Surprisingly, I don't like caramel but these candies are an exception, the caramel in Rolo's is very light and not overly sweet.  Although they're great at room temperature, I highly recommend refrigerating them and eating them chilled...the firmer consistency and taste is addicting.  I hope you enjoy them as much as I do!!

At McDonalds I always have the Rolo Mcflurrey for dessert and I go nuts when I eat it. Then I found out who sells Rolo chocolates and bought them right away. I was jumping as high as the ceiling when I was opening them. When I tasted them. I fainted. Anyway this is a great party favor and a great snack for all ages!

Kids will munch on them while playing video games or doing homework, and well, I guess a few before supper won't spoil them *too* much. :)
I love Rolos but in large quantities they those that special spark. Just stick to the little packs at the store and save the pounds and keep the taste

column9: Arrived promptly, great condition.  Love rolos!
column10: I purchased these to put into treasure chests for a theme party.  So much more fun than chocolate coins (for adults).  Chocolate and caramels -- what's not to like?  Yum!

I buy this candy everytime I go on a long road trip. It keeps the kids happy and quiet for the ride to and from Grandma's house. I always try and buy different candies or treats to take on the trip with us but my two sons always scream for Rolo's!

column9: Updated: Broken pieces, no returns, but some salvalgable
column10: I've tried Tiger Tiger's "Puppodums" before and enjoyed them. They're fun to nuke, tasty (though not really spicy) and pretty healthy as snacks go. I was psyched to find them on Amazon, especially with a subscribe and save option. Unfortunately I received the first box with each of the 12 packages crumbling around the edges, cracked and broken. If you've tried these before you know this makes them pretty useless. You need the whole 'sheet' to be intact to oil on either side, then bake or nuke. Small pieces are really no use, and large cracked off pieces are a pain. I'm so used to Amazon being great about returns, I was rather shocked to realize (somewhat understandably) food items are on the No Returns list. So I'm stuck with this big box that I'll probably just toss out. And out twenty bucks.Although I get why food can't be returned, given that this is dry packaged imported goods I wish Amazon wouldn't blanket ban returns. In fact, I'll probably think 3 or 4 times before ever ordering a grocery/food item again.Sorry to say I suggest skipping this item. If you receive it as I did, you too will be out a twenty spot with a box of perfectly good useless food to throw away.UPDATE 1/12: As I didn't want to actually throw away this big box of poppodums, I've been slowly working through them. There were a few packages in the middle of the larger box that were unbroken. The broken ones, mostly around the edges, so they've lost 10 - 20%. But I'm still enjoying them. Changed to 3*. Still tasty and a good protein substitute for a starch.

column9: Are they suppose to be gross?

When microwaved, puppodums provide a nice savory snack without too many calories!  We like them with dips of various kinds or chutneys but they are good with many kinds of Indian foodsYes, these are quite expensive, but compared to the retail price locally (if we can find them at all), they are extremely reasonable -especially on Subscribe and Save.  They taste every bit as good as the ethnic sort.  To me, a great advantage is that these Tiger Tiger puppodums puff up beautifully in the microwave (a little spray of olive oil or cooking spray is all they need)which is something that the cheaper equivalents from ethnic stores do not do reliably. I think that the smaller package size may keep them in better condition.

column9: So Far, I Haven't Eaten Any

I use this honey as conditioner for my hair and I put it in my homemade conditioners and I just love it. I don't fancy the taste but I don't fancy the taste of many kinds of honey so I use this strictly for my hair as it stays in the shower. . . .it's phenomenal!!
I have purchased this honey and it is wonderful!  Tastes so good I need to restrain myself from using too much in one day.

I've had problems with honey and other sweeteners causing heartburn, but after reading about manuka honey, I thought it might be different. I chose this brand to try because it wasn't quite as expensive as some others. Unfortunately, it still gave me heartburn.And it tastes awful! Like cough medicine perhaps. column9: The Chocolate Notes of Hawaiian Coffee
column10: This medium roast blend has all the flavors of Kona or Kauai coffee, especially the chocolate notes, and at a much lower price. We used to buy Kauai Coffee beans at Costco in Lihue on our trips there, and then started ordering it directly from Kauai Coffee, but at over $65 for 5#, we looked for a less expensive alternative, and found this. Excellent coffee and great price! We still serve our favorite Kauai Coffee at holiday time, but for everyday use, this is perfect.

Received the coffee and have been trying it out for a few days. I use an espresso machine to make my coffee..the bag doesn't say how much Kona is in the blend, but I can't imagine too much. The coffee doesn't have the smoothness of the real Kona, is a bit on the harsher side. Probably ok for a run-of-the-mill cofee, but not much better. Wish I had bought a smaller bag first!

This is a light roast Kona blend, known as "city roast".Light roasted beans have no oil on them and they smell a bit different - that is typical and normal.Dark roast is what everyone is used to drinking - dark roast is used to hide how old and rancid the beans are.  They began to only sell us old coffee in 80s and they began to roast it all dark then, to hide the fact that all the coffee was old, stale, rancid, etc.  If you get a good fresh coffee that is lightly roasted, its a whole different cup of coffee!  This is what I remember coffee tasting like, before they decided to feed us all only 1 type - old rancid dark "french" roast and worse.This is Good Coffee!  I highly recommend this.Check their site (coffee bean direct)for the correct info.Buyers are not always informed or correct, so check the site.

We loved the KONA we had in Hawaii last year and subsequently purchased some at home. When I saw this product, it seemed like a good deal . Though we have played around with the water: ground bean ratio, it still does not have the body and flavor we expected. Again, should have paid attention that it was a KONA blend. Its good but not great.
This is the best Kona coffee we have purchased and we have tried every brand that we have came across. And of course the price can't be beat either....

My husband and I went to Hawaii for our 30th anniversary and loved the Kona coffee that was offered in every restaurant! After returning home, and missing the great coffee, I decided to check on Amazon to see if they offered it. Much to my dismay, the "real" Kona was outrageously expensive. After reading the reviews about "blended" Kona coffee, I decided to try this one...and I'm glad I did! We just love getting up to the fresh aroma of this Kona Blend and feel like we are back on the Island enjoying the sun and surf and relaxing time! I have this on auto ship so I will never run out!
This inexpensive blend is among the best I have purchased. I have been trying others, but none of the others has been significantly better than this one.

I have been buying this brand for the past 3 years. I have had many different variants of Kona, ranging from pure to similarly labeled blends - none of which were so bad.  This is dry, bitter and bland - probably the worst of all worlds.To put things into perspective, Costa Rican from the same vendor is an infinitely superior coffee that I have as a subscription mainstay for my house.Again, I like this vendor, but despise this particular coffee.  Don't waste your money . . . After Eight from your local grocer would be 100 times better.

We just opened our 5lb bag of coffee and the first thing we noticed is that the beans had no oil left on them. Not a good sign. The smell was a bit off and you didn't get that enjoyable aroma that you do from fresh beans.Then we brewed a pot.Rancid is the kindest word I can use. Flavorless but for the sour taste, we couldn't stand to drink a cup. We immediately went and bought a bag of something else NOT from Coffee Bean Direct as the thought of drinking this stale bean for a month made us sick. We've had good results with The Bean Coffee Company, Le Bean but they seem to be running low on inventory. Time to search again.

column9: Great coffee at a good price.

Since these seemed to be a very similar alternative to our usual lentils, we went ahead and ordered a case.However, we have not been pleased with the results through the first three cans. the Scarlet Runners were exciting to see when they first arrived and cooking them turned out to be a bit challenging. I does take a little getting use to after years of eating processed garbage but it is well worth it. It's about time truly healthy real food snacks are available.

I am not sure what I was expecting, but this was not it. The item was blander than I expected, but it was not bad. If it were not quite as expensive, I might keep some on hand for quick snacks, but not as treats.

This is the same chemical that is present in acid rain, which can eat the paint off your car, deteriorate buildings, etc.  This product is the only one I've ever seen that doesn't contain this chemical.  This product tastes better and fresher than any store-bought dried pineapple and the fact that it contains only natural ingredients is a big plus.

I originally tried these when visiting family in Boston and started looking for them back in Pittsburgh.  My grocery store carries the brand, but not this product.  The quality of the pineapple is wonderful and they taste great!  It's so nice to be able to have a taste of sweet pineapple duringthe winter!

column10: I came across this delight at an acclaimed German Tavern with a baron of beef and carved meat sandwiches.  I asked the brand and am extremely pleased with this horseradish.  It is nearest to homemade you can get.  Excellent breadth of flavor and heat.  Definitely the real horseradish so prized by Germans.
Its hot, but if you are into hot things you should look at the 666+6 horseradish, this stuff is definitely better than the junk in the grocery star and a good value.

This stuff is awesome. It has the best flavor, consistency, and heat of any horseradish I've ever had and it beats the hell out of the store bought stuff. It's plenty hot and will get some tears going, but admittedly the heat can vary from jar to jar. Make sure to keep it refrigerated and sealed as often as possible as warm temperatures and air can deaden the heat fairly quickly.This particular brand is often only used in restaurants (I found out about it when I ate at a steakhouse not too long ago), so it's nice to be able to use it at home.To those who don't think this is hot enough, the only option left for you is Nasal Napalm, which is unequivocally the hottest stuff out there. You can search for it in Google.
best horseradish I've ever had! Much better than store-bought! I use it in cooking and on sandwiches. Not for the weak at heart.

When I opened up the box, I was greeted with the smell of horseradish, not exactly what I wanted after purchasing sealed containers. I do not like the flavor of this horseradish. I've opened 2 of the 4, and both tasted overly salty and hot, but with very little horseradish flavor. I enjoy hot horseradish, but not when it comes at the expense of flavor. It ruined a batch of horseradish mustard I made at home.I'm going to stick with Helluva Good horseradish from now on. It's not very hot, but the flavor is there.
I got the order very quickly(in three days), but it did leak a bit.  I love this stuff.  Very hot.
absolutely the best horse radish we have ever tried, and we have done them all. Price is right and the service is great

Love good horse radish, and this is the BEST!!!  Always looking for the hottest I can find,  and I finally have, again.  Having worked in Restaurants, "Atomic" was available, but only in Costco size containers...I would always take a little home (with permission) when needed.  But, now it is available for purchase...SWEET!  This will clear your sinuses!  Love this product!
This horseradish is fabulous.  Excellent taste, the heat will bring water to your eyes.  Suggest mixing with sour cream for a milder taste and smoother consistency.

This is the best tasting green tea on earth.  Believe me, I have tasted my share of green teas.  Sweet Leaf Mint & Honey is the best.  It actually tastes like real green tea.  The sweetnes is perfect, not too sweet.  There is a hint of mint.  I recommend this tea to everyone!!

My son brought this home..the mint and honey organic..I was skeptical, but wow, it's great.  We go out of our way to find places that have it in stock in the large jugs.  The mint flavor is just right and so is the honey..not too sweet or minty.  You will be surprised at how good it is, it's addictive.

Sugar Ray's Honey Chipotle is my absolute favorite jerky available in average/common stores.  Its not too soft or too hard. Just enough density to give a satisfying chew without overworking my jaw muscles. And the flavor is fantastic! A little sweet with a gentle kick of spice. You say "gentle kick", what is that? Enough spice to warm my mouth, but not tear me up or make my nose run. Also enough spice to keep the vultures (my kids) from wanting more than just a taste.The only reason I'm giving this 4 of 5 stars is the price.  This jerky is a little bit more expensive than comparable products...I just can't resist the flavor! Haha.  So if you don't like the price, don't try it.  Like me, you might not be able to go back to your old jerky.

I was looking for a snack that was high in protein but low in fat so I started looking at Beef Jerky, but all the other brands have at least some sort of fat in them, usually a minimum of 1g, which may not sound like much, but when you're dieting, every gram counts. So when I found this brand I was very pleased. It tastes great and did I mention it has zero fat? Oh yeah, I did. But each service (28 oz) only has 50 calories, no carbs and some good protein. Switch to this brand/style. You won't be displeased.

I have been on a beef jerky kick lately, and this is one of my new favorites. It starts with the tenderness of the meat. The meat is on the soft side but still has a nice chew to it. It's real pieces as apposed to the artificial looking variety. The flavor has a nice smoky BBQ base and the sweetness of the honey and the mild heat from the chipolte is perfect. I've tried multiple Sweet Baby Ray products and have yet to be disappointed. Grab a bag or two, you won't be disappointed.

They carry this at Walmart and it's outstanding.  It tastes just like sweet baby rays.  I especially like it because the jerky is on the softer end... none of those endlessly chewy pieces.  It has a really great after taste too. Try it out!

This is the best jerky I have ever tasted!  To the guy who gave this a two star rating because they changed the flavor from the 80s?  They didn't mass produce Sweet Baby Rays until the mid 90's so your product review is based on a completely different product or you clicked on the wrong link/product to review.

They had to go and change the recipe. I used to buy this in the smaller package when I would travel to work back in the early 80's. I guess they've new and improved it because it isn't the same and doesn't taste near as good.

These pods do not fit easily into my Seneo coffee maker. I had to use the double pod holder which was a bit too much room.  As a result the coffee was not as rich or frothy as I had hoped.  Also, at least 3 pods were not properly sealed in each box and had to be tossed out.

I got a couple of these jelly-filled pods in a variety pack from a third party vendor.  My first impression was, quite simply, how could this possibly be good?  Boy was I in for a shock.The fact that I'm giving a five-star review on a coffee pod should speak volumes.  I like my coffee freshly roasted and ground, but when some flavors are added to coffee, the experience takes on an entirely different level.  I had no idea that the flavor of jelly could be infused with the flavor of coffee to create such a blissful experience.  Let's just say that it's a good thing that my variety pack only came with two pods of this flavor.  Otherwise, I might have drunk the whole package in a single day.The flavor and the aroma are somehow familiar, but I can't quite place them.  What I do know is that they both just simply put a smile on my face.  I would gladly go the rest of my life drinking no other coffee but this.  That's how much I like it.And the other thing I think needs to be pointed out is the fact that when I use Senseo pods, I have to use two pods on the single cup setting to get a decently strong result.  With the Donut Shop coffees, I can use a single pod on the single cup setting to get a decently strong result.

a very nice product, good for the body and soul that in turns make a nice product, worth the purchase and i needed it. a purchase that you couldnt get a better price for and cheaper than other retailers products online. excellent product and a recommended buy
Weird taste...a better alternative would be Kraft's velveeta shells and cheese, also sold here; it has no meat but much more delicious without the canned flavor.
After finding out that Zsa Zsa Gabor has gone to the big screen in the sky, I turn to the Chef in these hard times. This is the best beefaroni on the market. Full of hurr and baww.

I make large pans of banana pudding (40+ servings) for church and work functions and go through mega amounts of cream of tartar to make the meringue that folks rave about. Cream of tartar makes it stiff enough to peak up and brown nicely in the oven. Now I won't go broke buying the small containers (that only yield about 2 uses) at the grocery for $3.89 a pop. Great value!!! ~Ruby~

I bought this dog food because the bag showed pictured of veggies and chunks of meat, and with a name like "Beneful" I thought I was purchasing a nutritious brand of dog food. My dogs did eat this food, but after reading the ingredients I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my dogs. The first three ingredients are Ground yellow corn, chicken by-product meal, and corn gluten meal. How disgusting is that?! The main ingredient is a corn filler. One thing my vet told me a while back that I never forgot: "When you eat corn, what comes out of the other end? The same thing happens with dogs." Basically, dogs cannot digest corn, it is just a filler and causes them to actually eat more to feel full, poop out more, and retain less nutrients. The only meat in Beneful at all is a by-product, its not even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product to anyone, for any reason, ever. It is an absolutely awful dog food. I can't believe the pictures of veggies and full chunks of meat on the bag can be allowed to be on the packaging of such a disgusting product; it is very misleading and should be considered false advertising.I recommend to stay far away from Beneful, and most Purina products. When purchasing a dog (or cat) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for,  I usually buy my pets all natural, organic foods such as Blue Buffalo, Halo or Wellness.

I am consistently challenged by them in attempting to avoid both (1) getting crumbling granola all over my desk and floor and (2) having the chocolate melt all over my fingers.
